note: Shared glossary for every part of Hesiod's Theogony and Works and Days. Entries keyed by the lowercased word form as printed in Evelyn-White (1914). Lemma — meaning; parse. Seeded on 2026-11-20 with the Iliad's and then the Odyssey's entries for every form Hesiod shares with Homer; a run broadens an entry where Hesiod uses the form differently.

glossary.αἰήταο: Αἰήτης — Aeetes, Circe’s brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰγίδα: αἰγίς — aegis, Zeus’s tasselled storm-shield; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰγιόχου: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (of Zeus); adj., masc. gen. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’holding the αἰγίς (goatskin shield)’, other derivations were proposed in antiquity
glossary.αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰδοίοισιν: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἰδοίῃ: αἰδοῖος — revered, august; fem. dat. sg. (Ionic η = Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.αἰδοῖ: αἰδώς — reverence, respect, modesty; fem. dat. sg., with εἴκων (+ dat.): ’to respect, to deference’
glossary.αἰδοῖον: αἰδοῖος — revered, worthy of respect; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Μενέλαον
glossary.αἰδώς: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame, reverence; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰδὼς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. nom. sg., in exclamation: ’shame!’ · also fem. nom. sg., subject: ’shame, restraint’
glossary.αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame; fem. acc. sg.; of what is covered, ’the shame’, i.e. the private parts
glossary.αἰειγενετάων: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), epithet of θεῶν ’gods’
glossary.αἰετὸν: αἰετός (Attic ἀετός) — eagle; masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.αἰζηὸς: αἰζηός — vigorous young man (properly ’lusty’); masc. nom. sg., epic adj. used as a noun, with ἀνήρ in apposition
glossary.αἰζηῶν: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. gen. pl.: ’young men’
glossary.αἰθέρα: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰθήρ: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰθιόπων: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Ethiopians’
glossary.αἰθομένοιο: αἴθω — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’blazing’
glossary.αἰνή: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. nom. sg.: ’fearsome’
glossary.αἰνείαν: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader; masc. acc. sg.: ’Aeneas’
glossary.αἰνῆς: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. gen. sg.: ’fearsome’
glossary.αἰνῇ: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with δηϊοτῆτι
glossary.αἰπεῖα: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with κολώνη
glossary.αἰπόλια: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπύν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; of toil or ruin, grievous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον
glossary.αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰόλον: αἰόλος — glancing, quick-moving (sheen or colour uncertain); adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἰῶνος: αἰών — life, life-force, lifetime; masc. gen. sg., of separation after ἀμερθῇς: ’of life’
glossary.αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’ · also fem. nom. pl., in αἱ μὲν … αἱ δέ: ’some … others’
glossary.αἱμυλίοισι: αἱμύλιος — wheedling, cajoling; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἱρεῖ: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’seizes’
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (αἳ δὲ γυναῖκες ’and the women’)
glossary.αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
glossary.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fiery, flashing (of wine; αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’look’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴθωνι: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming (of metal); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σιδήρῳ: ’gleaming (iron)’
glossary.αἴσηπον: Αἴσηπος — Aesepus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (with τε, in a simile) · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl., with γε: ’they, those’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, of the Trojan women: ’who’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with κε + subj., of the Trojan women: ’those who may be’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., without τε, of ships: ’which’ (αἵ οἱ ἕποντο ’which followed him’) · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, continuing a list: ’those which’ (αἵ τ’ ἀπ’ ἐπισσώτρων ’and those from the tires’) · also relative, fem. nom. pl., without τε, of door-leaves: ’which’ (αἵ ῥα πύλας εἴρυντο ’which guarded the gates’) · also relative, fem. nom. pl., without τε, of the women standing about her: ’who’ (αἵ ἑ μετὰ σφίσιν εἶχον ’who held her among them’)
glossary.αἵδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες: ’these (cattle)’ · also fem. nom. pl., agreeing with κύνες: ’these (dogs)’
glossary.αἶαν: αἶα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic γῆ), object of ἐπικίδναται · also Αἴας — Ajax; masc. voc. sg. Αἶαν, in address
glossary.αἶνον: αἶνος — tale, saying; praise; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἶσαν: αἶσα — due measure, portion, lot; fem. acc. sg. (κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure’; ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’)
glossary.αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, at once; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
glossary.αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, at once; adv., accented before the enclitic τοι · also accented before the enclitic κεν (αἶψά κεν ’quickly … would’) · also accented before the enclitic κε (αἶψά κε ’quickly … would’) · also accented before the enclitic τε (αἶψά τε ’quickly’, in a general statement)
glossary.αὐγὴ: αὐγή — ray, beam, gleam of light; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐδή: αὐδή — voice, speech; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐδὴ: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐδὴν: αὐδή — voice, speech; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in voice’
glossary.αὐλῆς: αὐλή — courtyard, fold; fem. gen. sg., with compounds of leaping: ’over, out of the fold’ · also fem. gen. sg., with ἔνδοθεν: ’within the courtyard’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the court’ (ὑπ’ αἰθούσῃ … αὐλῆς ’beneath the portico of the court’)
glossary.αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject, 1st person: ’I myself’ (ὃν τέκον αὐτή ’whom I myself bore’)
glossary.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg., as a plain pronoun: ’her’ (καὶ αὐτήν ’and her too’) · also intensive, fem. acc. sg.: ’itself’ (κανόνας τε καὶ αὐτήν ’the rods and the shield itself’) · also fem. acc. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐπί, of a thing: ’to it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτήν ’to it’) · also intensive, 1st person, fem. acc. sg., with the speaker as object: ’me myself’ (μ’ ἐλέησον αὐτήν ’pity me myself’)
glossary.αὐτονόην: Αὐτονόη — Autonoe, a maid of Penelope’s household; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive, in apposition to the subject ’we’: ’we ourselves’
glossary.αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form) · also intensive, masc. acc. pl., in apposition: ’themselves’ (καὶ αὐτοὺς Ἀργείους ’the Argives themselves’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοὺς … ὑπεκφυγέειν ’ourselves to flee’)
glossary.αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self, same; masc./neut. dat. pl., intensive with a noun: ’the very …’ · also plain pronoun, masc. dat. pl.: ’them’ (ἐν δ’ αὐτοῖς ’among them’) · also plain pronoun, neut. dat. pl., of things, after ἐγκείσεαι: ’in them’ (ἐγκείσεαι αὐτοῖς ’you will lie in them’)
glossary.αὐτόθι: αὐτόθι — on the spot, in that very place, right there; adv. (= Attic αὐτοῦ)
glossary.αὐτόματοι: αὐτόματος — acting of its own will, self-moving; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg., intensive, reinforcing ἐγώ: ’I myself’ (ἠδ’ ἐγὼ αὐτός ’and I myself’)
glossary.αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’themselves’ · also personal pron. after a preposition: ’them’ (κατ’ αὐτάς) · also fem. acc. pl., intensive with a noun: ’the very’ (κατ’ αὐτὰς … πύλας ’through the very gates’)
glossary.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a second person: ’you yourself’
glossary.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’, or intensive ’her herself’ · also with the article, fem. acc. sg.: ’the same’ (τὴν αὐτὴν ὁδόν ’the same road’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’ (ἀμφ’ αὐτὴν ’around it’, the pyre) · also fem. acc. sg. intensive, of a thing: ’itself’ (χεῖρα … αὐτὴν ’the hand itself’)
glossary.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’) · also intensive, agreeing with a noun: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν βασιλῆα ’the king himself’) · also plain personal pronoun, direct object with no preposition: ’him’ (αὐτὸν ἐπαΐξαντες ἕλοιμεν ’rushing on, we could take him’)
glossary.αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
glossary.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a name: ’Hecuba herself’ · also fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive: ’of yourself’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · also fem. gen. sg., plain pronoun: ’it’ (ὑπ’ αὐτῆς ’under it’) · also fem. gen. sg., intensive in the sense of a possessive: ’her own’ (αὐτῆς μήτηρ ’her own mother’) · also fem. gen. sg., intensive with a common noun: ’itself’ (ἀσπίδος αὐτῆς ’the shield itself’) · also fem. gen. sg., intensive after a pronoun: ’yourself’ (σεῖο ἐξ αὐτῆς ’from you yourself’)
glossary.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dative: ’to her herself’ (αὐτῇ περ νοεούσῃ ’even though she herself understands’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἅμα: ’with her’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐν, of a thing: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ ’in it’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after παρά: ’beside her’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after σύν: ’with her’ · also intensive, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a thing (πήληκι): ’the helmet itself’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐπί, of a thing: ’over it’
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’) · also plain pronoun, gen. pl. after ἀήθεσσον: ’them’ (ἀήθεσσον … αὐτῶν ’unused to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with σφῶν: ’of themselves’ (σφῶν τ’ αὐτῶν ’of themselves’) · also gen. pl. standing for the men as against the ships: ’of the men themselves’ (νηῶν τε καὶ αὐτῶν ’of the ships and of the men themselves’) · also gen. pl. partitive, with an indefinite pronoun: ’of them’ (τιν’ … αὐτῶν ’some of them’)
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, with a verb of leaning: ’on it’ (αὐτῷ σκηπτόμενον ’leaning on it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with ἔοικα: ’to him, like him’ (αὐτῷ … ἐῴκει ’resembled him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’with it’ (φρένες αὐτῷ ἕποντο ’the midriffs followed with it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a person, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’him’ (ἕπετ’ αὐτῷ ’followed him’)
glossary.αὔριον: αὔριον — tomorrow; adv. · ἐς αὔριον ’until tomorrow’
glossary.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’ · also in ὣς δ’ αὔτως, ’in the same way’: ’likewise’ · also ’just as one is’ (ἀλλ’ αὔτως … φάνηθι ’but as you are, appear’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε) · also αὖθι elided: ’there, on the spot’ (αὖθ’ ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’right there at the ditch’)
glossary.αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
glossary.αὖον: αὖος — dry; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’with a dry (hollow) ring’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj., agreeing with ξύλον: ’dry’
glossary.αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
glossary.αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
glossary.βάζειν: βάζω — speak, say, chatter; pres. inf. act.: ’to speak’
glossary.βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
glossary.βέλεα: βέλος — missile, shaft; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic βέλη)
glossary.βέλτερον: βέλτερος — better, preferable (epic comparative of ἀγαθός, = Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) better’
glossary.βήσσῃς: βῆσσα — glen, wooded mountain valley; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic βήσσαις)
glossary.βήσσῃσι: βῆσσα — glen, wooded valley; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.βήσσῃσιν: βῆσσα — wooded glen, mountain valley; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg. · also periphrasis for a person, nom. subject: ’the might of Helenus’ (= Helenus himself)
glossary.βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself) · also periphrasis for a person, acc. subject of an infinitive: ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself) · also periphrasis for a person, governed by ἀμφί: ’around the might of Diomedes’ (= around Diomedes himself) · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὄπασσον: ’strength’ (ἴσην … βίην ’equal strength’) · βίη — strength, might; fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’(his) strength’ (βίην χραισμησέμεν ’that his strength will help’)
glossary.βίης: βίη — strength, force, might; fem. gen. sg. · also periphrastic gen. with a proper adj.: βίης Ἡρακληείης ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself)
glossary.βίηφί: βίη — force, might; instrumental case in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’by might’
glossary.βίηφι: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’in might, by force’
glossary.βίον: βίος — life, way of living; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
glossary.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. in a periphrasis: βίῃ Ἡρακληείῃ ’by the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles) · also dat. sg. of means: ’by (your) strength’ · dat. sg. of respect: ’in might’ (βίῃ δ’ ὅ γε πολλὸν ἀμείνων ’in might he is much better’)
glossary.βαθυρρείταο: βαθυρρείτης — deep-flowing; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Ὠκεανοῖο
glossary.βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
glossary.βαρύθει: βαρύθω — be heavy, be weighed down; pres. 3 sg.: ’is heavy’
glossary.βαρὺν: βαρύς — heavy, deep-toned; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
glossary.βασιλευέμεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; pres. inf., epic ending -έμεν (= Attic βασιλεύειν)
glossary.βασιλεὺς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. used as vocative in address: ’king!’
glossary.βασιλεῦσι: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.βασιλεῦσιν: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. pl.: ἐριζέμεναι βασιλεῦσιν ’to strive with kings’
glossary.βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
glossary.βασιλῆας: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic βασιλέως)
glossary.βελέεσσι: βέλος — missile, shaft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic βέλεσι), of cause or means
glossary.βελλεροφόντης: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.βιότου: βίοτος — life, livelihood, means of living; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.βλάψας: βλάπτω — hinder, hamper, harm; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βλεφάρων: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. gen. pl., after κατά: ’down from the eyelids’ · also neut. gen. pl., after ὑπό: ’from under the eyelids’
glossary.βολάων: βολή — throw, cast (of a missile); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.βορέαο: Βορέας (Βορέης) — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
glossary.βορέην: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind, personified; masc. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic Βορέαν)
glossary.βορέω: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -έω (= Attic Βορέου)
glossary.βουκόλον: βουκόλος — cowherd, herdsman; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βουλὰς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βουλὴ: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βουλὴν: βουλή — counsel, plan, advice; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object: ’a plan’ (βουλὴν ὑποθησόμεθ’ ’we will suggest a plan’)
glossary.βουλῇ: βουλή — counsel, plan, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐν βουλῇ ’in council’) · also fem. dat. sg. of respect, no preposition: ’in counsel’ (βουλῇ … ἄριστος ’best in counsel’) · also fem. dat. sg., object of πείθομαι: ’counsel’ (βουλῇ … πίθοντο ’obeyed the counsel’)
glossary.βουλῇσιν: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic βουλαῖς), of cause: ’by the plans’
glossary.βουσὶ: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl.: ’among cattle’ (after ἐν) · also dat. pl. of means, with κυκλήσομεν: ’with oxen’
glossary.βουσὶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; masc./fem. dat. pl.: ’cattle’
glossary.βοός: βοῦς — ox, cow; masc./fem. gen. sg.: ’of an ox’ (ῥινὸς βοός ’hide of an ox’)
glossary.βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow; gen. sg.: ’of an ox’
glossary.βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
glossary.βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; fem. acc. pl. ’cattle’ · also nom. sg. (same spelling): ’the ox, the heifer’
glossary.βοῶν: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., contracted (= epic βοόων): ’shouting’ · also βοῦς — ox, cow; fem./masc. gen. pl.: ’of cattle’ (βοῶν δημὸν ’the fat of oxen’)
glossary.βοῶπις: βοῶπις — ox-eyed, with the eyes of a cow; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Hera · also epithet of a mortal woman, Clymene: ’ox-eyed’ · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’ox-eyed (Hera)’ · also fem. nom. sg., epithet of the Nereid Halia: ’ox-eyed’
glossary.βροντῇ: βροντή — thunder, thunderclap; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.βροτοὶ: βροτός — mortal; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’mortals, men’
glossary.βροτοὺς: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. pl.: ’mortals, mortal men’
glossary.βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.βροτός: βροτός — mortal, a mortal; masc. or fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two terminations, so also of a woman)
glossary.βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg., as a noun: ’mortal man’ (βροτὸν ἄλλον ’another mortal’)
glossary.βροτῶν: βροτός — mortal; masc. gen. pl., partitive after τίς: ’of mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl. after ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl., gen. of comparison after περί: ’above all mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl., possessive, dependent on γλῶσσα: ’of mortals’ (γλῶσσα βροτῶν ’the tongue of mortals’) · also masc. gen. pl., possessive, dependent on μῆλα: ’of mortals’ (μῆλα βροτῶν ’flocks of mortals’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive after a superlative: ’of mortals’ (φίλτατος … βροτῶν ’dearest of mortals’)
glossary.βροτῷ: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. sg., used as a noun: ’to a mortal (man)’
glossary.βωμῶν: βωμός — raised base, pedestal (also altar); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.βόας: βοῦς — ox, cow, head of cattle; acc. pl. βόας (= Attic βοῦς): ’cattle’ · also acc. pl., by metonymy hides, ox-hide shields: ’oxhides’ (βόας αὔας ’dry oxhides’)
glossary.βόε: βοῦς — ox, cow; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two oxen’
glossary.βόεσσιν: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic βουσί)
glossary.βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, causative with an object: ’made go, led out’ (not the intransitive ἔβησαν ’went’)
glossary.γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
glossary.γάμον: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γάμου: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg., after ἀντιάω: ’(shared) in the wedding’
glossary.γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
glossary.γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, arise; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
glossary.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’has come to be’ (ἐπὴν τὰ πρῶτα γένηται ’once he has been born’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after δείδω μή: ’lest … come to be’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that … may come about’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ὁππότε: ’whenever … comes about’ (μεταπαυσωλὴ … γένηται ’there comes a pause’)
glossary.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’should become’ · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that it might come to be’ · also in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might become’ · also in a main clause with κε, potential: ’would come to be, would be left’ · also in a relative clause, a man to whom much might come: ’might come to be’ · also in a wish, set beside μὴ … νοστήσειεν: ’may … become’ · also in a main clause with no particle, potential or wish: ’would come to be’
glossary.γένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγένοντο) · also with ἐν + dat.: ’reached, got to’ (κλισίῃσιν ἐν γένοντο ’reached the huts’) · also with ἄγχι + gen.: ’came near to’ (Ἕκτορος ἄγχι γένοντο ’came close to Hector’) · also with ἄγχι + dat.: ’came near to’ (σφισιν ἄγχι γένοντο ’came near to them’)
glossary.γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. (ἡμιόνων γένος ’the breed of mules’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of αἰσχυνέμεν: ’the stock (of the fathers)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’my birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι εἶναι ’I declare my birth to be’) · also neut. acc. sg., of respect: ’in birth’ (γένος κακόν ’base in birth’)
glossary.γέντο: γέντο — took, grasped (= ἕλετο); defective aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic, with no present in use
glossary.γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
glossary.γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε)
glossary.γήραος: γῆρας — old age; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρως)
glossary.γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ), dative of cause: ’by old age’ · also dat. after ἐπιτρέπω: ’(yield) to old age’
glossary.γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg.: ’comes into being, grows’
glossary.γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γαίας)
glossary.γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
glossary.γαλάτεια: Γαλάτεια — Galatea (’Milk-white’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γαλήνη: γαλήνη — calm (of the sea); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γαστέρ: γαστήρ — belly; fem. acc. sg., elided (γαστέρ’ = γαστέρα)
glossary.γαστέρες: γαστήρ — belly, stomach, paunch; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γαστρὶ: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. dat. sg., syncopated stem γαστρ-
glossary.γαῖ: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg., elided (γαῖ’ = γαῖα; Attic γῆ)
glossary.γαῖάν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
glossary.γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
glossary.γείνασθαι: γείνομαι — beget, bring into being (of a parent); aor. inf. mid., epic (= Attic γεννήσασθαι): ’to have begotten’
glossary.γείνατ: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., elided, unaugmented (γείνατ’ = ἐγείνατο): ’bore’
glossary.γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο) · also of a father: ’begot, fathered’
glossary.γεγάασι: γίγνομαι — be born, be; perf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic γεγόνασι): ’are born, are’
glossary.γεγάασιν: γίγνομαι — become, come to be, be; epic redupl. perf. 3 pl. γεγάασι(ν) (pres. force): ’they are, they have come to be’
glossary.γελάσας: γελάω — laugh; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laughed’
glossary.γενέθλης: γενέθλη — stock, race, offspring; fem. gen. sg., of origin after ἐξ, with σῆς: ’of (your) stock’
glossary.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. inf. mid.: ’to come about, be made’ · also with περί + gen.: ’to be superior to’ · also aor. inf. mid. after φημί, predicate: ’to be, to have become’ · also aor. inf. mid. after δότε, acc. subject and predicate: ’that he become’ (δότε … γενέσθαι ’grant that he become’) · also aor. inf. mid. after ἔλπομαι: ’to have been born’ (ἐν Σαλαμῖνι γενέσθαι ’to have been born on Salamis’) · also aor. inf. mid. after ὤφελλε, in a wish: ’to have come to be’ (ἣ μὴ ὤφελλε γενέσθαι) · also aor. inf. mid. with a perfect participle (πεφυγμένον … γενέσθαι): ’to have escaped’ · also aor. inf. mid. of purpose after ἔτρεφε, with predicate πῆμα: ’to become (a bane)’ (πῆμα γενέσθαι ’to become a bane’) · also aor. inf. mid. after οὐ … πως ἦν, with predicate δαήμονα: ’to become (skilled)’
glossary.γενεή: γενεή — race, kindred, family; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενετῆς: γενετή — birth; fem. gen. sg.: ἐκ γενετῆς ’from birth’
glossary.γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, generation; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γηθήσειν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; fut. inf. act.: ’will rejoice’
glossary.γιγνώσκων: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’recognising’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδα: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain), epithet of Athena; fem. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’the gleaming-eyed one’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδος: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (standing epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γλαυκῶπιν: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.γλαύκη: Γλαύκη — Glauce (’Grey-green’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλώσσης: γλῶσσα — tongue; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γλώσσης/γλώττης)
glossary.γλώσσῃσιν: γλῶσσα — tongue; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental: ’with tongues’
glossary.γναμπτοῖσι: γναμπτός — bent, flexible, pliant; adj., neut. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.γνῶ: γιγνώσκω — recognise, perceive, know; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔγνω): ’recognised, perceived’
glossary.γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα)
glossary.γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα) · also neut. acc. pl., object of λαβέ and λάβε: ’knees’ (λαβὲ γούνατα ’take hold of the knees’)
glossary.γυμνὸν: γυμνός — bare, unarmed, naked; masc. acc. sg., predicate of the object: ’naked’
glossary.γυνή: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γυναικί: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg., after ἀμφί: ’about a woman’ · also fem. dat. sg., object of ὀάριζε: ’with a wife’ (ᾗ ὀάριζε γυναικί ’talked with his wife’) · also fem. dat. sg., with μίσγεσθ’: ’with a woman’
glossary.γυναικὶ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg., after ἀμφί: ’about a woman’
glossary.γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a woman’ · also fem. gen. sg., possessive: ’of the wife’ (γυναικὸς … παρειαί ’the wife’s cheeks’) · also fem. gen. sg., objective, after ἔρος: ’desire for a woman’
glossary.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive after δῖα: ’the divine one among women’ · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on χερσί: ’of the women’ · also fem. gen. pl. after πρό: ’in defence of the wives’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’in front of, for their wives’) · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on φῦλα: ’tribes of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., in apposition to ἀνθρώπων with ἀνδρῶν: ’of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., with ἤτε … ἤτε, dependent on θέμις: ’of men or of women’ (θέμις … ἀνδρῶν ἤτε γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl. after περί: ’for the women’ (περὶ … γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl., of origin after ἐξεγένοντο: ’of women’ (ἐξεγένοντο γυναικῶν ’were born of women’) · also fem. gen. pl., partitive after οὐδέ τις ἄλλος: ’of … women’ (πρόσθ’ ἀνδρῶν … γυναικῶν ’of men or of women, first’)
glossary.γυναῖκά: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γυναῖκα: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
glossary.γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’the limbs were loosened’ (λύντο δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of an intransitive active verb: ’the limbs trembled’ (ἔτρεμε γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of εἰμί with a predicate: ’the limbs were firm’ (ἔμπεδα γυῖα … ἦν) · also neut. acc. pl., of the part affected, after ὑπήλυθε: ’the limbs’ (τρόμος ὑπήλυθε γυῖα ’trembling crept over the limbs’)
glossary.γόμφοισιν: γόμφος — peg, bolt, a wooden dowel; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γόνον: γόνος — offspring, child, stock; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative with an infinitive: ’the offspring (of Zeus)’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of a verb of fulfilling: ’offspring’ (γόνον ἐξετέλειον ’brought offspring to fulfilment’)
glossary.γῆ: γῆ — earth, land; also Γῆ, the goddess Earth; fem. nom. sg. (epic γαῖα)
glossary.γῆμαι: γαμέω — marry, take as wife (of a man); aor. inf. act.: ’to marry’
glossary.γῆμεν: γαμέω — marry (of the man); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔγημεν): ’married’
glossary.γῆν: γῆ — earth, land (epic γαῖα); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γῆράς: γῆρας — old age; neut. acc. sg.; with λιπαρόν: ’a sleek old age’, the object of ἵκοιο ’reach’
glossary.γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐς: ’(into) old age’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἐλεήσῃ: ’(have pity on) old age’
glossary.γῆς: γαῖα (γῆ) — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Attic form γῆς (Homer usually γαίης)
glossary.δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
glossary.δάμναται: δάμνημι (δαμνάω) — overpower, subdue; pres. 3 sg., epic mid. form with active sense (= Attic δαμάζει)
glossary.δάσσαντο: δατέομαι — divide, share out among themselves; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάσαντο)
glossary.δάσσασθαι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= Attic δάσασθαι)
glossary.δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
glossary.δέδασται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been divided’
glossary.δέμας: δέμας — bodily frame, build; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in build’
glossary.δέμνια: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition to εὐναί: ’bedding’
glossary.δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
glossary.δέξασθαι: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
glossary.δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of a verb of putting on: ’skin’
glossary.δέχεται: δέχομαι — receive, take up; pres. 3 sg. mid.-dep.: ’receives’
glossary.δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δήμητρος: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain; fem. gen. sg., with τέμενος: ’of Demeter’
glossary.δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δήνεα: δῆνος — plan, wile, counsel (used only in the plural, epic and poetic); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δία: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Δία
glossary.δίκαιον: δίκαιος — just, right; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) just’
glossary.δίκας: δίκη — custom, right, judgment; fem. acc. pl.: ‘judgments’, not yet the abstract ‘justice’
glossary.δίκη: δίκη — custom, right, the way things are done; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δίκην: δίκη — justice, right; fem. acc. sg.: ’justice’
glossary.δίκης: δίκη — justice, what is right and due; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic δίκης), of what is lacked after ἐπιδευές
glossary.δίκῃ: δίκη — right, justice, due course; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’rightly, fairly’
glossary.δίχ: δίχα (elided δίχ’) — apart, in two, at odds; adv. (δίχ’ ἐβάζομεν ’we spoke at odds’)
glossary.δίῃ: δῖος — heavenly, divine, bright; fem. dat. sg., epithet of Elis: ’heavenly’ · also fem. dat. sg., epithet of a woman: ’heavenly’ (Φρόντιδι δίῃ)
glossary.δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δαίδαλα: δαίδαλον — intricate work, finely wrought thing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition to the subject: ’intricate works’ (δαίδαλα πάντα)
glossary.δαίμονα: δαίμων — divine power, allotted divinity, fortune; masc. acc. sg., object of δώσω · also masc. acc. sg., after πρός: ’against a divinity’ (πρὸς δαίμονα)
glossary.δαίμονι: δαίμων — divinity, god, divine power; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαιδαλέην: δαιδάλεος — cunningly wrought, intricate; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic -έαν)
glossary.δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, uncanny; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
glossary.δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd; voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε), as address: ’strange one’ (gentle or chiding, tone uncertain)
glossary.δαιτὶ: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with a feast’
glossary.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀκουάζεσθον: ’hear of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. after ἐπιδευεῖς: ’short of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. dependent on ἔργα: ’the business of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’begin the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης ’the equal feast’)
glossary.δακρυόεντα: δακρυόεις — tearful, causing tears; masc. acc. sg., epic -όεντα, agreeing with πόλεμον
glossary.δαμάσσας: δαμάζω — subdue, tame, overpower; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having subdued’
glossary.δαμέντες: δάμνημι — tame, subdue, overpower; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl. (ἐδάμην): ’having been subdued, overcome’
glossary.δαμῆναι: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, overpower; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be overcome’, ’to be subdued’ (+ ὑπό + dat. of the agent)
glossary.δατέονται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δατοῦνται): ’share out’
glossary.δαῒ: δάϊς — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic μάχη)
glossary.δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο) · also fem. acc. sg., object of δαίνυ (’give a feast’) and of τίθει (’set a feast’) · also fem. acc. sg., cognate object of δαίνυντ’ (mid.): ’feasted a feast’
glossary.δαῖτας: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δείξω: δείκνυμι — show, point out; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will show’
glossary.δείσας: δείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with acc. object: ’having feared’ · also with μή: ’fearing lest’ · also absolute: ’in fear’
glossary.δεδμημένοι: δέμω — build; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’built’ · also δάμνημι — overpower, subdue; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’overcome’
glossary.δειλοῖσι: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δειλός: δειλός — cowardly, wretched; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δειλῷ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἐμοί: ’to wretched me’
glossary.δεινήν: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with αἰγίδα
glossary.δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with πελώρου
glossary.δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully’ · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with an understood ’him’ (the boar), with περ ἐόντα: ’though he is dreadful’ · also neut. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with θαῦμα: ’a dreadful (wonder)’
glossary.δεινὰ: δεινός — fearful, terrible, dread; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with πέλωρα · also neut. acc. pl. used as adverb: ’dreadfully’ (δεινὰ ὁμοκλήσας ’shouting dreadfully’)
glossary.δεινὰς: δεινός — terrible, fearsome, dread; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δεινὴ: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δεινὴν: δεινός — fearsome, terrible, awful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully, fearsomely’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with σάκος: ’dread’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα: ’dread’
glossary.δεινὸς: δεινός — terrible, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δειπνήσας: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having dined’
glossary.δειρήν: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. sg., epic -ήν (= Attic δέρην)
glossary.δεκάτη: δέκατος — tenth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἠώς: ’the tenth (dawn)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with νύξ: ’the tenth (night)’
glossary.δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg.; τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth (day)’
glossary.δεκάτῳ: δέκατος — tenth; neut. dat. sg., with ἔτει understood: ’in the tenth (year)’
glossary.δενδρέῳ: δένδρεον (Attic δένδρον) — tree; neut. dat. sg., epic δενδρέῳ (= Attic δένδρῳ)
glossary.δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
glossary.δεξιτερῇ: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιᾷ), with χειρί understood: ’with the right hand’
glossary.δερκομένοιο: δέρκομαι — see, look; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’seeing’
glossary.δεσμοῖς: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.δεσμὸν: δεσμός — bond, fetter, tether; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀπορρήξας · also masc. acc. sg., object of ἴηλα: ’cast a bond’
glossary.δεσμὸς: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεσμῶν: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. gen. pl., gen. of separation after ὑπελύσαο: ’from his bonds’
glossary.δεσμῷ: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δεύτεροι: δεύτερος — second, next after, behind; masc. nom. pl., with gen.: ’after, behind (me)’ · also predicate, in the order of a finish: ’second’
glossary.δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, of order in a sequence of attacks: ’second, next’ (δεύτερον ὁρμηθείς ’rushing second’)
glossary.δεῖξαι: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. inf. act.: ’to show’
glossary.δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. acc. sg. of the goal: ’to the meal’ (ἐπὶ δεῖπνον) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’a meal’ (of horses, ’fodder’)
glossary.δεῦτε: δεῦτε — come hither, come on; pl. of δεῦρο, an interjection used like an imperative
glossary.δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.δημήτερος: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain; fem. gen. sg., epic Δημήτερος (= Attic Δήμητρος); Δημήτερος ἀκτή is ’grain’
glossary.δημήτηρ: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain and harvest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δημῷ: δημός — fat; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with fat’
glossary.δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
glossary.δηϊοτῆτι: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, battle (δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. dat. sg., epic
glossary.δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
glossary.διάκτορον: διάκτορος — epithet of Hermes, meaning unknown, traditionally ’guide, messenger’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.διάκτορος: διάκτορος — guide, escort, epithet of Hermes (sense uncertain, perhaps ’runner’ or ’guide’); masc. nom. sg., adj. used as an epithet
glossary.διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
glossary.διδοῖ: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 sg., epic διδοῖ (= Attic δίδωσι)
glossary.διδοῦσιν: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic διδόασι)
glossary.διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’looking for’
glossary.διηνεκέως: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken; adv. διηνεκέως: ’continuously, from end to end, at full length’
glossary.διοτρεφέος: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.διοτρεφέων: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.διόθεν: Ζεύς — Zeus; adv. Διόθεν (stem Διο- + -θεν): ’from Zeus’
glossary.διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
glossary.διώνη: Διώνη — Dione, mother of Aphrodite; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.διώνυσον: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. acc. sg., Homeric Διώνυσος (= Attic Διόνυσος)
glossary.διώνυσος: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό) · also adv. before ἀμπερές: ’through, right through’
glossary.διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
glossary.δμώεσσι: δμώς — slave, servant; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δμωσί)
glossary.δμῶές: δμώς — slave, thrall (male); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δμῶας: δμώς — slave, servant of the household; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might give’, ’should give’ (after εἰ), ’may (he) give’ (wish) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα in secondary sequence: ’might give’
glossary.δοιὰ: δοιοί — two, a pair of; numeral adj., neut. acc. pl. (poetic beside δύο)
glossary.δολίην: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with τέχνην)
glossary.δολίης: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. gen. sg. (agreeing with τέχνης)
glossary.δολίχ: δολιχός — long; neut. acc. pl., elided (δολίχ’ = δολιχά)
glossary.δολοφρονέων: δολοφρονέω — have guile in the mind, plot craftily; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονῶν)
glossary.δούρατ: δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. pl., epic δούρατα, elided (δούρατ’ = δούρατα; Attic δόρατα)
glossary.δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they should give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. with κε, potential: ’they would give’ (κε … δοῖεν ἄποινα ’would give ransom’)
glossary.δοῦπος: δοῦπος — thud, heavy din; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δοῦρα: δόρυ — beam, timber; also spear; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοῦρα, of a ship’s timbers · also δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. pl.: ’spears’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’) · also δόρυ — spear; neut. nom. pl., subject: ’spears’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα πεπήγει ’sharp spears were fixed’)
glossary.δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δρέπανον: δρέπανον — sickle, reaping-hook; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δρυὸς: δρῦς — oak; fem. gen. sg.: ’of an oak’
glossary.δρῦς: δρῦς — oak; fem. acc. pl. (acc. pl. with long ῡ) · also fem. nom. sg., subject: ’an oak’
glossary.δυναμένη: Δυναμένη — Dynamene (’The Able’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δυσηλεγέος: δυσηλεγής — painful, grievous (traditional gloss; formation not certain); adj. of two endings, gen. sg. (any gender), epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.δυσπέμφελος: δυσπέμφελος — rough, stormy (of the sea); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’rough’
glossary.δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς: ’the twelfth dawn’
glossary.δυωδεκάτῃ: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. dat. sg., dat. of time, with ἡμέρᾳ understood: ’on the twelfth (day)’
glossary.δωρὶς: Δωρίς — Doris (perhaps ’Gift’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δωτώ: Δωτώ — Doto (’Giver’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δωτῆρες: δωτήρ — giver; masc. nom. pl. (δωτῆρες ἑάων ’givers of good things’)
glossary.δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόλου: δόλος — trick, guile, ruse; masc. gen. sg., object of a verb of forgetting (λήθομαι + gen.)
glossary.δόλῳ: δόλος — trick, guile, cunning; masc. dat. sg.: ’by a trick’
glossary.δόμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic δοῦναι)
glossary.δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
glossary.δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόμος: δόμος — house, household; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
glossary.δόσιν: δόσις — gift, giving; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δόσις: δόσις — giving, a gift; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δότε: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’grant!’
glossary.δύναμίς: δύναμις — power, strength; fem. nom. sg., extra accent on the last syllable before the enclitic γε
glossary.δύναμιν: δύναμις — power, might, ability; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δύναται: δύναμαι — be able; pres. 3 sg., + inf.: ’is able’
glossary.δύνηαι: δύναμαι — be able; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic δύνῃ): ’you may be able’
glossary.δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω) · also aor. subj. 1 sg. act., in a condition after εἰ … κε: ’go into’ (πύλας καὶ τείχεα δύω ’pass inside the gates and walls’) · also with ἀπό in tmesis, after ἐπεί κ’: ’strip off’ (ἀπὸ τεύχεα δύω ’strip off my armour’)
glossary.δύῃ: δύω — sink, set (of the sun); aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a clause with εἰς ὅ κε: ’sets’ (not the noun δύη ’woe’)
glossary.δώμασι: δῶμα — house, home; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
glossary.δώματά: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl., accented on the ultima before the enclitic θ’
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive verb: ’halls’
glossary.δώρῳ: δῶρον — gift; neut. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’for a gift’
glossary.δώσω: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give’
glossary.δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
glossary.δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δὸς: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δῆμος: δῆμος — people, community; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δῆμόν: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.δῆριν: δῆρις — contest, strife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δῆσε: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδησε): ’tied’
glossary.δῆσεν: δέω (be in want of) — lack, need, have need of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., contracted and unaugmented (= ἐδέησεν): ’he needed’ · also δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδησεν): ’he tied’
glossary.δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of a noble woman · also fem. voc. sg., in address (δῖα θεάων): ’heavenly one among goddesses’ · also fem. nom. sg., epithet of the earth (χθὼν δῖα ’the heavenly earth’)
glossary.δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the divine brine’) · also fem. acc. sg. of a land (Ἤλιδα δῖαν ’heavenly Elis’) · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of a city (Ἀρίσβην δῖαν ’heavenly Arisbe’) · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of Dawn (Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’)
glossary.δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’heavenly’
glossary.δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί · also without a preposition, acc. of the goal after ἱκάνω: ’to the house’
glossary.δῶκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
glossary.δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
glossary.δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
glossary.δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δῶρα: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of διδοῖς: ’gifts’
glossary.δῶρον: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’as a gift’ · also neut. acc. sg., object, with a dependent gen.: ’the gift (of sleep)’ (ὕπνου δῶρον)
glossary.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’) · also ὡς εἴ τε, ’as if’, in a comparison · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’, in a comparison (ὡς εἰ … πυρὶ σμύχοιτο ’as if it were smouldering in fire’) · also εἰ + opt. of a hoped-for result: ’in case, to see whether’ (εἰ … πεπίθοιεν ’in case they could persuade’) · also εἰ γάρ κ’ + subj., in a condition: ’for if … should’
glossary.εἰαρινοῖσιν: εἰαρινός — of spring; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἐαρινοῖς)
glossary.εἰδότες: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. pl. (+ gen. ’skilled in’): ’knowing’
glossary.εἰδώς: οἶδα — know, know how; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen. ’versed in’: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing, who knew’
glossary.εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰλιπόδεσσι: εἰλίπους — of rolling gait, shambling (said of cattle; traditional gloss); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι), agreeing with βουσίν
glossary.εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
glossary.εἰνάετες: εἰνάετες — for nine years; adv. (εἰνά- epic by-form of ἐννέα ’nine’ + -ετες ’years’)
glossary.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., completing τέτληκας: ’to speak out, to tell’ · also inf. after ἐπιστάμενος: ’(know how) to speak’ · also aor. inf. after ἀνώγῃ: ’to speak’ (θυμὸς ἀνώγῃ εἰπεῖν ’the heart bids (him) speak’) · also aor. inf. of purpose, after a participle of going: ’to say’ (ἰόντα εἰπεῖν ’going to say’) · also aor. inf. as an imperative, after a participle of running: ’tell’ (θέων … εἰπεῖν ’run and tell’)
glossary.εἰπόντι: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he spoke’
glossary.εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἰρημένος: ἐρέω (εἴρω) — say, speak; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’spoken’
glossary.εἰροπόκων: εἰροπόκος — wool-bearing, fleecy (= ἐριοπόκος); adj., masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’) · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ … ἕλοιεν ’until they should take’) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic εἶς (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (λελασμένος εἰς ’you have forgotten’, with a perfect participle) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (εἰς ἐνιαυτόν ’for a year’) · also + acc. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (εἰς ἀγαθά ’for good ends’)
glossary.εἰσίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl. (Attic εἰσί, with ν-movable): ’they are’
glossary.εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
glossary.εἰσὶν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they are’
glossary.εἲς: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic εἶς (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
glossary.εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ) · also εἴ πως + opt., ’in case, in the hope that’ · also ὡς εἴ τε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
glossary.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’ · also in a wish or a request: ’let there be’ (εἴη ὃς … ’let there be one who …’) · also in a relative clause: ’were, should be’ (ὅς τις … εἴη ’whoever should be’) · also in a condition after εἰ καί: ’(even) if it were’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’may there be’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a wish or assent with no particle: ’so be it’ (τῇδ’ εἴη)
glossary.εἴην: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would be’ · also in a wish or self-curse: ’may I (not) be’ · also in a wish after αἴθε: ’would that I were’
glossary.εἴκελος: εἴκελος (ἴκελος) — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐοικώς)
glossary.εἴπαθ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 pl. act., elided and aspirated (εἴπαθ’ = εἴπατε): ’tell!’
glossary.εἴπατε: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’tell!’ (also indic. ’you said’)
glossary.εἴποις: εἶπον — say, speak (aor. of ἐρῶ/λέγω); aor. opt. 2 sg. act., in a polite exhortation: ’you might say’
glossary.εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
glossary.εἴσατο: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to, take the likeness of; aor. 3 sg. mid., with acc. of respect and dat. of the person · also ἵεμαι — rush, speed; aor. 3 sg. mid., of a missile: ’darted’ · also aor. 3 sg. mid., of a man: ’made for, rushed’ (εἴσατο … ἐπ’ ἀριστερά ’made for the left’) · also εἴδομαι — appear, show oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., with dat. of the persons to whom: ’appeared (to them)’
glossary.εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’ · also impf. 3 pl., elided (εἵατ’ = εἵατο, = Attic ἧντο): ’sat’ · also ἕννυμι — clothe; plpf. mid./pass. 3 pl., elided (εἵατ’ = εἵατο): ’were dressed in’ (εἵατ’ ἐϋννήτους χιτῶνας)
glossary.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
glossary.εἵμαρτο: μείρομαι — receive a share; pluperf. 3 sg. impersonal εἵμαρτο: ’it was fated’, + acc. and inf.
glossary.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’clothes’
glossary.εἵνεκ: εἵνεκα (elided εἵνεκ’) — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἕνεκα)
glossary.εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 pl. (the form is also 1 sg.): ’they saw’
glossary.εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · εἶδος — form, look; neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’(his) looks’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος … χραισμησέμεν) · also neut. acc. sg., object of θηήσαντο: ’form, looks’ (φυὴν καὶ εἶδος ’stature and looks’)
glossary.εἶθαρ: εἶθαρ — at once, straightway; adv., epic (= Attic εὐθύς)
glossary.εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.εἶς: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
glossary.εἶσ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg., elided (εἶσ’ = εἶσι), with future sense: ’will go’
glossary.εἶσιν: εἶμι — go; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic εἶσι(ν)): ’goes’
glossary.εἶχ: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἔ- → εἰ-), elided (εἶχ’ = εἶχε): ’kept’
glossary.εἷλε: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’took, seized’
glossary.εἷο: ἕ, οὗ — him, himself; 3rd-person pron. gen. sg., epic εἷο (= Attic οὗ); after a comparative: ’than himself’
glossary.εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, stationed’
glossary.εὐκόσμως: εὐκόσμως — in good order, neatly; adv. of εὔκοσμος
glossary.εὐνήν: εὐνή — bed, bedding, lair of a beast; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐνηθεῖσα: εὐνάζω — put to bed; pass. lie with, sleep with (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lain with’
glossary.εὐνομίην: εὐνομίη — good order, lawfulness; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic εὐνομία)
glossary.εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -έα, agreeing with νῶτα: ’broad (backs)’ · also masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic εὐρύν), agreeing with πόντον: ’wide (sea)’
glossary.εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὐρεῖα: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρυμετώπους: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed; adj. (2 endings), masc./fem. acc. pl., agreeing with βόας (cattle)
glossary.εὐρυνόμη: Εὐρυνόμη — Eurynome, an Oceanid, daughter of Oceanus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρυοδείης: εὐρυόδεια — wide-wayed (fem. adj., of the earth); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with χθονός
glossary.εὐρυτίωνα: Εὐρυτίων — Eurytion, a Centaur; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρύν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν, set after its noun · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the pronoun τὸν (the mound), predicate after τιθήμεναι: ’wide (mound)’
glossary.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — far-thundering, wide-sounding (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., epic short -α · also masc. nom. sg., epic short -α (εὐρύοπα Ζεύς ’far-thundering Zeus’)
glossary.εὐρώεντα: εὐρώεις — mouldy, dank, dark (traditional gloss, uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρὺς: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐφροσύνην: εὐφροσύνη — good cheer, merriment; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔβοιαν: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔκηλος: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔχεσθαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. inf. mid./dep. · also εὔχομαι — declare, boast; pres. inf. mid./dep., as an imperative, with indirect statement: ’declare’ (εὔχεσθαι ἐμὲ νικῆσαι ’declare that you beat me’)
glossary.εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj. (with ἄν + subj.) · also with an aor. indic. in a simile: ’when’ (εὖτ’ … κατέχευεν ’when he has poured’) · also with impf. indic.: ’just when’ (εὖτ’ ἄρ’ ἔμελλε ’just as he was about to’) · also with an aor. indic. in plain narrative: ’when’ (εὖτ’ … ἐτάνυσσε ’when he stretched’)
glossary.εὖχος: εὖχος — boast, glory, vaunt of victory; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’cause to boast’
glossary.ζέφυρον: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); adj., fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, anciently also ’life-giving’
glossary.ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ζεφύρου: Ζέφυρος — Zephyrus, the West Wind; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
glossary.ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
glossary.ζυγὰ: ζυγόν — yoke; a ship’s cross-bench; neut. acc. pl., after ὑπό: ’under the benches’
glossary.ζυγὸν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., after ὑπό in tmesis with ἤγαγεν: ’under the yoke’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ὑπέρ: ’over the yoke’ (ὑπὲρ ζυγόν) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἦεν (the yoke of a lyre): ’a yoke’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἐέργει: ’the yoke’ (ζυγὸν … ἐέργει ’the yoke keeps (them) apart’) · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the yoke’ (παρὰ ζυγόν) · also neut. acc. sg., object of αἱρέω: ’the yoke’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ὕπαγον: ’under the yoke’
glossary.ζόφου: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (of the world below); masc. gen. sg., after ὑπό: ’from beneath the gloom’
glossary.ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ζῆν: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Ζῆν (elided Ζῆν’ = Ζῆνα), object of ἐξείρετο · also masc. acc. sg., subject of ἀρηξέμεν: ’that Zeus will help’ · also masc. acc. sg., after μά in an oath: ’by Zeus’ (οὐ μὰ Ζῆν’ ’no, by Zeus’) · also masc. acc. sg., object of λάθον: ’escape the notice of Zeus’
glossary.ζῆνα: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg., epic Ζῆνα (= Attic Δία)
glossary.θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
glossary.θάλειά: Θάλεια — Thaleia (’Blooming’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θάρσος: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θέμεν: τίθημι — put, set; aor. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic θεῖναι): ’to set, to pile’
glossary.θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θέμιστας: θέμις — custom, established right, ordinance; fem. acc. pl.: ’ordinances, customary rights’
glossary.θέρευς: θέρος — summer; neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic θέρους)
glossary.θέρος: θέρος — summer; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐς: ’by summer’ (ἐς θέρος)
glossary.θέσθαι: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. inf. mid., with κέλευθον: ’to make (a path)’
glossary.θέσπιν: θέσπις — god-given, inspired; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θέτ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (θέτ’ = θέτο), in tmesis (περὶ … θέτ’ = περιέθετο): ’set about’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτ’ = ἀπέθετο): ’laid aside’
glossary.θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θέτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put (for himself)’
glossary.θήβῃ: Θήβη — Thebe, city of Eëtion in the Troad; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’ · also Θήβη — Thebe (Boeotian Thebes), birthplace of Heracles; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’
glossary.θήλειαι: θῆλυς — female; adj., fem. nom. pl. (ἵπποι ... θήλειαι ’mares’)
glossary.θήῃ: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇ): ’may make (one) so-and-so’
glossary.θαλάσσῃ: θάλασσα — sea; fem. dat. sg. (Attic θαλάττῃ)
glossary.θαλίῃς: θαλία — feast, festivity; fem. dat. pl., Ionic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.θαλείῃ: θαλεῖα — abundant, rich, blooming (of a feast; cf. θάλλω ’thrive’); fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.θαλερὴν: θαλερός — blooming, lusty, vigorous; fem. acc. sg., with παράκοιτιν
glossary.θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. nom. sg.: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’an abundant tear’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’blooming, in his prime’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυ: ’abundant’ (θαλερὸν κατὰ δάκρυ χέουσα ’shedding abundant tears’)
glossary.θαμὰ: θαμά — thick and fast, often; adv.
glossary.θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θανεῖν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf. act.: ’to die’
glossary.θαρσήσας: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken courage’
glossary.θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ὁρῶμαι: ’a wonder’
glossary.θεάων: θεά — goddess; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θεῶν), partitive: ’of the goddesses’
glossary.θείην: τίθημι — put, set; aor. opt. act. 1 sg., in a condition after εἰ μή: ’if I do not put’
glossary.θεοί: θεός — god; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl., in address: ’you gods!’
glossary.θεοειδὴς: θεοειδής — godlike in form; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
glossary.θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., possessive with μῆνις: ’a god’s (wrath)’ · also gen. governed by ἄνευθε(ν): ’without a god’ · also gen. possessive with πληγῇ: ’a god’s (blow)’ · also gen. possessive with δῶρα: ’a god’s (gifts)’ · also gen. governed by ἀκούω: ’(I heard) a god’
glossary.θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεσπέσιον: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, more than human (lit. god-uttered); adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’wondrous’
glossary.θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, divine, beyond mortal scale; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by a wondrous (power)’
glossary.θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
glossary.θεόφιν: θεός — god; dat. pl., epic suffix -φι(ν) (θεόφιν = θεοῖς), with ἀτάλαντος: ’to the gods’ · also after ἐκ: ’from gods’ (ἐκ θεόφιν; -φιν marks no number)
glossary.θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
glossary.θεὰν: θεά — goddess; fem. acc. sg., predicate with ἄκοιτιν: ’a goddess (as wife)’
glossary.θεὸν: θεός — god; masc. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg. of a goddess (θεός is common gender): ’goddess’ (δεινὴν … θεόν ’a fearsome goddess’)
glossary.θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς) · also masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’a god’ (θεὸς ἔσκε ’was a god’)
glossary.θεῇς: θεά — goddess; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic θεαῖς), after ἔοικεν: ’to goddesses’
glossary.θεῖναι: τίθημι — put, set, make; aor. inf. act., with two accusatives: ’to make (toil) vain’ · also aor. inf. act. with a place-phrase: ’to lay (a robe) upon’
glossary.θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θηλυτεράων: θηλύτερος — female, of womankind (epic comparative form of θῆλυς); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.θηρσὶ: θήρ — wild beast; masc. dat. pl., short poetic form (beside epic θήρεσσι)
glossary.θνητή: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with ἀνδράσι
glossary.θνητῶν: θνητός — mortal; masc. gen. pl.: ’of mortal (men)’
glossary.θνῇσκον: θνῄσκω — die; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθνῃσκον): ’were dying’
glossary.θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θρέψασα: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having reared’
glossary.θρέψε: τρέφω — nourish, rear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθρεψε)
glossary.θρῄκης: Θρᾴκη — Thrace; fem. gen. sg., Ionic Θρῄκης (= Attic Θρᾴκης)
glossary.θυέλλῃ: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.θυμολέοντα: θυμολέων — lion-hearted; masc. acc. sg., compound epithet (θυμός + λέων)
glossary.θυμοφθόρον: θυμοφθόρος — soul-destroying, heart-consuming; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄχος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κάματον: ’heart-consuming (weariness)’
glossary.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
glossary.θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’) · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (θυμὸν ἐχώσατο ’was angered in heart’)
glossary.θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
glossary.θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
glossary.θόη: Θόη — Thoe (’Swift’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
glossary.θύρηφιν: θύρα — door; with epic suffix -φιν (locatival/ablatival; Attic θύρασι, θύραζε): ’at the door, outside’
glossary.θώκους: θῶκος — seat; masc. acc. pl.: ’seats’ (of the gods in assembly)
glossary.θῆκ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (θῆκ’ = θῆκε, = Attic ἔθηκε): ’put’
glossary.θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
glossary.θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., with ν-movable (= θῆκε), with double acc.: ’made (him) conspicuous’ · also ’laid, set’, with acc. and ἐπί + dat.: ’laid it on the knees’
glossary.θῶκον: θῶκος — seat, session (of an assembly); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’) · also κ’ + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὁπποῖόν κ’ εἴπῃσθα ’whatever sort you say’) · also κ’ + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will, in that case’ (οἵ κ’ … κείσοντ’ ’who will lie’) · also ὄφρά κ’ + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κ’ ἔτι γνῶμεν ’so that we may learn’) · also εἰ … κ’ + aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’if … had’ · also ὅς κ’ + opt., in a relative clause of purpose: ’who might’ (ὅς κ’ ἰθύνοι ’who might steer’)
glossary.κάββαλ: καταβάλλω — throw down, let fall; aor. 3 sg. in tmesis: κάββαλ’ = κατὰ βάλε run together (κατά assimilated before β), unaugmented, elided
glossary.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc./nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom./voc. pl. in abuse, with ἐλέγχεα: ’base disgraces’
glossary.κάλλιστος: καλός — beautiful, fair; superl. κάλλιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most beautiful’
glossary.κάματον: κάματος — toil, weariness, fatigue; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάπρον: κάπρος — wild boar; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’) · also neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’head’ (κάρη ἕλκεσθαι ἔασεν ’let the head be dragged’)
glossary.κάρτεϊ: κάρτος — strength, might (= Attic κράτος); neut. dat. sg., epic κάρτεϊ (= κράτει), after πίσυνος: ’(trusting) in might’
glossary.κάρτιστον: κάρτιστος — best, mightiest; epic superlative (= Attic κράτιστος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάρτος: κράτος (epic κάρτος, metathesis) — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.; object of δώσουσ’: ’strength’
glossary.κάτεχεν: κατέχω — hold fast, hold down, cover; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= κατεῖχεν), accent thrown back from the preverb
glossary.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’) · also + short-vowel subj. in a main clause: ’shall’ (ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι ἰδέω χάριν ’I shall acknowledge the favour’) · also + pres. indic. in a main clause, generic: ’would’ (καί κέ τις εὔχεται ’any man would pray’) · also εἴ κέ + long-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἴ κέ μ’ … συλήσωσι ’if … should strip me’) · also with a relative + subj. in a general clause: ’whoever’ (ὅς κέ … ἔλθῃ ’whoever comes’) · also ἐπεί κέ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’once, when’ (ἐπεί κέ τις … ἕληται ’once someone takes’)
glossary.κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
glossary.κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc. and inf.: ’I bid’
glossary.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν τις … βάλῃ ’whenever someone hits’) · also ἤ κέν + subj. (or fut.), in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ (ἤ κέν … ἐρύσσεαι ’whether you will draw out’) · also εἴ κέν + opt., in a concessive condition: ’(not even) if … should’ (οὐδ’ εἴ κέν σ’ … ἀνώγοι)
glossary.κέρας: κέρας — horn; neut. acc. sg., object of a verb or participle
glossary.κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, advantage; in pl. also craft, shrewd tricks; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic κέρδη)
glossary.κέρδος: κέρδος — gain, profit, advantage; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κέχυται: χέω — pour; perf. mid.-pass. 3 sg.: ’has been poured, lies spread out’
glossary.κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
glossary.κήδει: κήδω — distress, trouble, harm; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’distresses’
glossary.κίον: κίω — go, move; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκιον; Attic uses ἔρχομαι, εἶμι)
glossary.κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Circe!’ (ὦ Κίρκη)
glossary.κίρκην: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. acc. sg., object of ἐλήθομεν
glossary.καίετο: καίω — burn, kindle; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκαίετο), intransitive: ’was burning’
glossary.καδμείοισιν: Καδμεῖος — Cadmean, Theban; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), as noun
glossary.καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’) · also + acc., ’at, among’, of what one is busy with (καθ’ ἵππους ’among his horses’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (καθ’ ἧπαρ ’in the liver’)
glossary.καθίζει: καθίζω — make to sit, seat, convene; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’addressing’
glossary.καθεζομένη: καθέζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καιομένη: καίω — burn; pres. part. pass., fem. nom. sg.: ’burning’
glossary.κακή: κακός — bad, worthless; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κακήν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κακοῖσιν: κακός — bad, base; used as noun ’the bad’; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις) · also attributive adj. agreeing with a noun: ’evil’ (ἔπεσιν κακοῖσιν ’with evil words’)
glossary.κακοῦ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., substantive: ’of evil, of trouble’ · also masc. gen. sg., substantive: ’of the base man, the coward’ (τοῦ μὲν … κακοῦ, against τοῦ δ’ ἀγαθοῦ)
glossary.κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun in apposition to a person: ’an evil, a bane’ (τυκτὸν κακόν ’a fashioned evil’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with θυμόν: ’evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’an evil thing’ (ἦλθε κακόν ’evil came’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with πόλεμον: ’evil’ (πόλεμον κακόν ’evil war’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun, object of an infinitive: ’evil’ (φυγέειν κακόν ’to flee evil’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate adj.: ’bad’ (οὐ κακόν ἐστι ’it is no bad thing’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun, object of θῆκε: ’an evil’
glossary.κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κακότητι: κακότης — badness, baseness, cowardice; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’through baseness’
glossary.κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’ · also neut. voc. pl., adj. with τέκνα, in address: ’base (children)’
glossary.κακὰς: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with κῆρας
glossary.κακὴ: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with θύελλα · also fem. voc. sg. (as the nom.), in abuse: ’base, worthless’ (κακὴ γλήνη ’base doll’)
glossary.κακὴν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg. (κακὴν ἀπάτην ’an evil deceit’)
glossary.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a noun, subject: ’evil’ (κακὸν κακῷ ’evil upon evil’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate adj. with σῆμα: ’an evil (sign)’
glossary.κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive: ’evil’ (πόλεμος κακός ’evil war’)
glossary.κακῆς: κακός — bad, evil, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’ · also masc. gen. pl. as a noun, after ἐκ: ’of base men’ (κακῶν ἔξ ’of base stock’) · also gen. pl. (masc. or neut., ambiguous) as a noun, dependent on ἕταρ’: ’of bad men or bad things’
glossary.κακῷ: κακός — bad, evil, painful; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἕλκεϊ · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μύθῳ: ’evil (word)’ · also neut. dat. sg. as a noun: ’upon evil’ (κακὸν κακῷ ’evil upon evil’)
glossary.καλά: καλός — beautiful, fine, good; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.καλέεσθαι: καλέω — call, name; pres. pass. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλεῖσθαι): ’to be called’
