glossary.καλέεσκε: καλέω — call, name; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκε, unaugmented, uncontracted: ’used to call’
glossary.καλέονται: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦνται)
glossary.καλέουσ: καλέω — call, summon; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted, elided (καλέουσ’ = καλέουσα; Attic καλοῦσα): ’calling’
glossary.καλέουσι: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι)
glossary.καλέουσιν: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι(ν))
glossary.καλήν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλλίρροον: καλλίρροος — fair-flowing, with a beautiful stream; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλλίρρουν), agreeing with ὕδωρ
glossary.καλλίσφυρον: καλλίσφυρος — fair-ankled; fem. acc. sg. (epithet of Hebe)
glossary.καλλιγύναικα: καλλιγύναιξ — with fair women; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑλλάδα · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχαιΐδα ’Achaea’
glossary.καλλικόμοιο: καλλίκομος — with fair hair; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.καλλιπάρῃον: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic καλλιπάρειος)
glossary.καλλιρέεθρον: καλλιρέεθρος — fair-flowing (καλλι- ’fair’ + ῥέεθρον ’stream’); adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλλισφύρου: καλλίσφυρος — fair-ankled; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., agreeing with a woman’s name or νύμφης
glossary.καλούς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.καλυψὼ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, the nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island, her name built on καλύπτω ’hide, conceal’; nom. sg.
glossary.καλύπτει: καλύπτω — cover, hide; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’covers’
glossary.καλύπτοι: καλύπτω — cover, hide; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a wish: ’may (the earth) cover’
glossary.καλύπτρην: καλύπτρη — veil, head-covering; fem. acc. sg. (from καλύπτω ’cover’)
glossary.καλύψας: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having covered’
glossary.καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’ · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, without a negative: ’finely, rightly’ (καλὰ … ἔνισπες ’you told it finely’)
glossary.καλὴ: καλός — beautiful, fair; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος: ’fair (plot)’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’good, fitting’ (οὐ καλὸν … εὐχετάασθαι) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔρνος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (καλὸν ἄειδε ’sang beautifully’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’fair (shield)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λέβητα: ’a fine (cauldron)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φάσγανον: ’a fine (sword)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλεισον: ’fair (goblet)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος: ’fair (cloak)’
glossary.καλὸς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. sg., attributive (also of a harbour)
glossary.καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.καπνοῦ: καπνός — smoke; masc. gen. sg., of cause after ὑπό: ’from the smoke’
glossary.καρήατι: κάρη — head; neut. dat. sg., epic -ήατι (= Attic κρατί, κάρᾳ), dat. of means: ’with the head’
glossary.καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain, produce; masc. acc. sg.: ’grain’ · also καρπός — wrist; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καρπὸν: καρπός — fruit, crop, harvest; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καρτερόθυμον: καρτερόθυμος — strong-hearted, of strong spirit; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κασίγνητος: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’brother’
glossary.κασιγνήτοιο: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with οἷο agreeing: ’of his own brother’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’(slayer) of a brother’ (κασιγνήτοιο φονῆος) · also masc. gen. sg., of cause after χολωθείς: ’(angry) for his brother’
glossary.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.) · also + acc., ’upon, against’ (κατ’ ἀσπίδα ’on the shield’) · also + acc., ’over’ (κατ’ ὄσσε ’over the eyes’) · also + acc., ’throughout’ (κατ’ Ἀχαιΐδα ’throughout Achaea’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (κατ’ ἰγνύην ’in the hollow of the knee’) · also + gen., ’down over’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν ’down over the eyes’) · also with αὖθι, ’on the spot’ (κατ’ αὖθι) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατ’ οὐταμένην ὠτειλήν ’out through the wound’) · also κατ’ ἐνῶπα ’face to face’ (κατά + acc., κατ’ ἐνῶπα ἰδών ’looking face to face’) · also κατ’ ἄκρης, with a fem. gen.: ’from the top down’ · also + acc. of place: ’among’ (κατ’ αὐτούς ’among them’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατ’ ὄχθης ’down into the bank’) · also κατ’ αὐτόθι ’right there, on the spot’ · also + acc., ’along’ (κατ’ αὐτὸν ’along him’) · also + acc., ’about, around’ (κατ’ αὐτὸν ’about him’; κατὰ δίνας ’in the eddies’) · also + acc. of place: ’in’ (κατ’ οὔρεα ’in the mountains’)
glossary.κατά: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc./gen. · also preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, set down; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’set down’
glossary.κατέλεξε: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.καταβήσεται: καταβαίνω — go down, come down; fut. 3 sg. mid. (βήσομαι), in a simile: ’comes down’
glossary.καταγηράσκουσιν: καταγηράσκω — grow old, age; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable): ’grow old’
glossary.καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’)
glossary.καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl., epic by-form of θνητός: καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’
glossary.κατακρύπτων: κατακρύπτω — hide, conceal completely; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.καταλέξεται: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down (from λέγω ’lay’, root of λέχος ’bed’; distinct from καταλέγω ’recount’); fut. 3 sg. mid. (epic aor. subj. has the same form)
glossary.καταλείπειν: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; pres. inf. act., used as an imperative after μή: ’do not leave’
glossary.καταμάρψῃ: καταμάρπτω — overtake, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κεν in a purpose clause: ’may overtake’
glossary.καταφθιμένοισιν: καταφθίνω — perish, waste away; aor. mid. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’who have perished’
glossary.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’) · also κατὰ πάμπαν, adverbial: ’altogether, utterly’ · also + acc. of position, ’over’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’over the right shoulder’) · also + acc. of order: κατὰ τρίτα ’in the third place’
glossary.καύματος: καῦμα — burning heat, scorching; neut. gen. sg.: ’of heat’
glossary.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also ὄφρά κε + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κε … ἔλθῃσι ’until … comes’) · also + aor. subj. in a main clause, potential: ’might, would’ (τώ κε κορεσσάμεθα ’then we might have our fill’)
glossary.κείνοις: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκείνοις); masc. dat. pl.: ’to those’
glossary.κείνοισι: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐκείνοις)
glossary.κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’on that day’
glossary.κεδνὰ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with ἰδυῖα: ’trusty, knowing in her heart’
glossary.κεδνὴν: κεδνός — careful, diligent, trusty; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κεδνῇ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κεκαλυμμένα: καλύπτω — cover, hide; perf. part. mid./pass. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’covered over’
glossary.κεκαλυμμέναι: καλύπτω — cover, veil; perf. mid./pass. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’hidden’
glossary.κεκασμένον: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’distinguished (by)’
glossary.κεκλῆσθαι: καλέω — call, name; perf. inf. pass.: ’to be called’ (κεκλῆσθαι ἄκοιτιν ’to be called wife’)
glossary.κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, path; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπόεικε: ’from the road’
glossary.κελεύω: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’) · also ἠέ κεν + aor. inf., a potential alternative: ’or to perish’ (ἠέ κεν … ὀλέσθαι) · also ὁπποτέρῳ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’to which of the two … may’ · also ἐπεί κεν + aor. subj., in a temporal clause: ’once’ (ἐπεί κ’ ἀπὸ τεύχεα δύω ’once I put off my armour’) · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κεν εὕρῃ ’until he finds’) · also εἴ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’whether’ · also εἷός κεν + subj., temporal: ’until’ (εἷός κεν … πελάσσῃ ’until he brings near’) · also ὄφρά κεν + pres. indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά κεν … κεῖται)
glossary.κερτομέων: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερτομῶν)
glossary.κευθμῶνας: κευθμών — hiding-place, den, pen; masc. acc. pl.: ’pens, sties’ · also ’hiding-places, recesses’ of a cave (μαιομένη κευθμῶνας ἀνὰ σπέος ’searching out the recesses’)
glossary.κεφαλέων: κεφαλή — head; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic κεφαλῶν)
glossary.κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of a verb of lifting: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of κόψεν: ’head’ (κεφαλὴν … ἀπὸ δειρῆς κόψεν ’cut the head from the neck’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of πῆξαι and of ταμόντα: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνεῖκαι ’bring’: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., after κὰκ of the place struck: ’on the head’
glossary.κεφαλῆφι: κεφαλή — head; epic locatival ending -φι (= Attic dat. κεφαλῇ): ’at the head’
glossary.κεφαλῆφιν: κεφαλή — head; fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φιν, locative or instrumental (= Attic dat. κεφαλῇ): ’on the head’ · also with ἀπό, separative: ’from the head’
glossary.κεφαλῇ: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. sg., of the means: ’with a (nod of the) head’ · also dative of measure: ’by a head’ (κεφαλῇ … μείζονες ’taller by a head’) · also fem. dat. sg., with ἀμφί: ’about the head’ · also fem. dat. sg. of place: ’on (his own) head’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ φορέειν ’to carry on his own head’) · also fem. dat. sg., of the person feared for, with περιδείδια: ’for my head’ · also fem. dat. sg., after ἶσος, of comparison: ’as my own head’ (ἶσον ἐμῇ κεφαλῇ)

glossary.λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
glossary.λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, grievous; masc. acc. sg., with ὄλεθρον
glossary.λυγρῇ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with δαΐ
glossary.λυσιμελής: λυσιμελής — limb-loosening; adj., masc. nom. sg., of sleep
glossary.λόγοισιν: λόγος — word, speech, story (rare in Homer, whose usual words are μῦθος, ἔπος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.λόχῳ: λόχος — ambush; masc. dat. sg.: ’for an ambush’
glossary.λύκτον: Λύκτος — Lyctus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λύσιν: λύσις — release, deliverance; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λώβην: λώβη — outrage, insult, object of reproach; fem. acc. sg., predicate with ἔμεναι · also fem. acc. sg., object of a verb of giving: ’outrage, insult’ · also object of τίσετε: ’insult’ (’pay for the insult’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of τίνυμαι: ’the outrage’ (λώβην τεισαίμεθα ’avenge the outrage’)
glossary.λώιόν: λωίων — better, more advantageous; comparative (of ἀγαθός), neut. nom. sg.
glossary.λῦσαι: λύω — loose, release; aor. inf. act.: ’to loose’
glossary.λῦσε: λύω — loose, undo; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλυσε)
glossary.μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
glossary.μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. nom. pl., epithet of the gods
glossary.μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
glossary.μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
glossary.μάρναντο: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμάρναντο): ’fought’
glossary.μάχαι: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μάχας: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl., after εἰσήλυθον · also fem. acc. pl., object of οἶδα: ’battles’ (εὖ οἶδα μάχας)
glossary.μάχη: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐτάνυσσε: ’the fighting’ (μάχην ἐτάνυσσε ’stretched the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., cognate object of ἐμάχοντο: ’fight’ (μάχην ἐμάχοντο ’fought the fight’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ὄτρυνον: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., with ἐς following it: ’into the battle’ (μάχην ἐς κυδιάνειραν ’into the man-glorifying battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἤγειρας: ’the battle’ (μάχην ἤγειρας ’you stirred up the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἔχουσι: ’the fight’ (μάχην … ἔχουσι ’keep up the fight’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἔκλινε: ’the battle’ (μάχην ἔκλινε ’turned the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of δίηται and of ἀπώσασθαι: ’the battle’ (thrust or driven away) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἔρριγα: ’shudder at battle’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of θήσονται: ’make battle’ (μάχην θήσονται ’will make battle’)
glossary.μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., + dat., with ἄν: ’would fight against’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in an indirect deliberative question after δίζε: ’whether he should fight’
glossary.μέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. μέ, accented because an enclitic follows: ’me’
glossary.μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial with a superlative: ’by far’ (μέγ’ ἄριστος ’by far the best’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial with a comparative: ’far’ (μέγ’ ἀμείνων ’far better’)
glossary.μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
glossary.μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μέγεθος: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. acc. sg., after the preposition ἐς: ’to stature’ · also neut. acc. sg. of respect, joined to εἶδος: ’in stature’ (εἶδος καὶ μέγεθος)
glossary.μέγιστε: μέγας — great; superlative μέγιστος, masc. voc. sg., address: ’greatest’
glossary.μέγιστος: μέγας — great; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’greatest, largest’
glossary.μέλαινα: μέλας — black, dark; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέλας: μέλας — black, dark; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also Μέλας — Melas, a son of Portheus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μέλεσσιν: μέλος — limb; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic μέλεσιν): ’in the limbs’
glossary.μέμηλε: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force, epic (Attic μεμέληκε): ’is a care’
glossary.μέμηλεν: μέλω — be a care to (someone); perf. 3 sg. act. (pres. force), + dat. of the person: ’is a care to’
glossary.μέμνηται: μιμνήσκομαι — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. 3 sg. mid., present force: ’remembers’
glossary.μέμνονα: Μέμνων — Memnon, king of the Ethiopians, ally of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
glossary.μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
glossary.μένεος: μένος — might, fury, passion; neut. gen. sg., genitive of material or cause: ’with fury’ · also neut. gen. sg., genitive of separation after ἀπογυιώσῃς: ’(unnerve) of might’ · also neut. gen. sg., object of λάθωμαι: ’(forget) fury’
glossary.μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
glossary.μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’ · also periphrasis for a person, nom. subject: ’the strong might of Leonteus’ = mighty Leonteus
glossary.μέρμερα: μέρμερος — grievous, baneful, causing care (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’) · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with the man struck, ’through the middle’ (δουρὶ μέσον περόνησεν ’pierced him through the middle with a spear’) · also neut. acc. sg. as an adverb + gen.: ’midway between’ (μέσον τάφρου καὶ τείχεος ’midway between the ditch and the wall’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect, of wasps: ’in the middle, at the waist’ (μέσον αἰόλοι ’nimble at the waist’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with στῆθος or σάκος: ’middle’ (στῆθος μέσον ’the middle of the chest’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’mid-’ (μέσον οὐρανόν ’mid-heaven’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’midday’ (μέσον ἦμαρ ’mid-day’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἧπαρ: ’the middle of (his) liver’
glossary.μέσση: μέσος — middle; fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέση): ’in the middle’
glossary.μέσσου: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc. gen. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσου), agreeing with δουρός: ’by the middle’
glossary.μέσσῃ: μέσος — middle, mid-; epic μέσσος (doubled σ), fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσῳ), used as a noun: ’in the midst’ · also masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with a place-name: ’in mid-’ (Ἄργεϊ μέσσῳ ’in the midst of Argos’)
glossary.μέτρον: μέτρον — measure, due measure; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι) · also ’lest’ with a fut. indic., fear: ’lest he be angered’ (μή πως … κεχολώσεται)
glossary.μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (pl. μήδεα)
glossary.μήθ: μήτε (elided μήθ’ before a rough breathing) — nor, and not; conj. continuing a negative command
glossary.μήλοισι: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.: ’of flocks’ · also μῆλον — apple, tree-fruit; neut. gen. pl.: ’of apples’
glossary.μήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
glossary.μήτ: μήτε (elided μήτ’) — nor, and not; negative conj. in a command, ’let no one’
glossary.μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; negative conj. with imperatives, correlative: ’neither … nor’
glossary.μί: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg., elided (μί’ = μία), predicate: ’one (only)’
glossary.μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.: ’one (mother)’
glossary.μίμνει: μίμνω — stay, remain, wait; pres. 3 sg., epic reduplicated by-form of μένω
glossary.μίμνειν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain, hold one’s ground; pres. inf., epic (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μίμνων: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μίνωος: Μίνως — Minos, king of Crete; masc. gen. sg., epic -ωος (= Attic Μίνω)
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μακάρων: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. gen. pl., epithet of the gods
glossary.μακρά: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δένδρεα μακρά ’tall trees’)
glossary.μακραὶ: μακρός — long, tall; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βοάω: ’loudly’ (μακρὰ βοῶν) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βιβάντα: ’with long (strides)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔγχεα: ’long (spears)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with οὔρεα: ’tall (mountains)’
glossary.μακρὴν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κέλευθον: ’long (path)’
glossary.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀχῆα: ’long’ (μακρὸν ὀχῆα ’the long bar’)
glossary.μακρὸς: μακρός — long, tall, high; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μακρῇσιν: μακρός — long; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.μαλακοῖσι: μαλακός — soft, gentle; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μαλακῷ: μαλακός — soft, gentle; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μαρνάμεθ: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; 1 pl., pres.-stem form with past (impf.) force, elided (μαρνάμεθ’): ’we fought’
glossary.μαρνάμενοι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl.: ’fighting’
glossary.μαρναμένους: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’fighting’
glossary.μείζων: μέγας — great; comparative μείζων, fem. nom. sg. (the form serves all genders): ’greater’
glossary.μείλιχον: μείλιχος — soothing, gentle, kindly; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object
glossary.μείλιχος: μείλιχος — gentle, kind, mild; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate with εἶναι: ’gentle’
glossary.μεγάθυμος: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα), adj. agreeing with a noun: ’great (stones)’
glossary.μεγάλη: μέγας — great, large; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠϊόνα: ’great (beach)’
glossary.μεγάλης: μέγας — great, large; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl., with ἵπποι
glossary.μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μεγάλους: μέγας — great, big, large; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μεγάλῃ: μέγας — great, big; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἰαχῇ · also fem. dat. sg., agreeing with βίῃ: ’great (might)’
glossary.μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’) · also prep. + acc., ’among, into the midst of’ (μεθ’ ὅμιλον ’among the throng’) · also + gen.: ’with, along with’ (μεθ’ ἡμέων ’with us’)
glossary.μεθήσω: μεθίημι — let go, give up (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg.: ’I will let go of, abandon’
glossary.μειλιχίῃ: μειλιχίη — gentleness, mildness; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ): ’in gentleness’ (some read nom. μειλιχίη)
glossary.μελίτη: Μελίτη — Melite (’Honey-sweet’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μελίῃσι: μελίη — ash tree; ash-wood spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black, dark; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα, standing epithet of ships · also fem. dat. sg., epithet of κήρ ’death, doom’: ’black’ · also fem. dat. sg., epithet of night: ’black’ (νυκτὶ μελαίνῃ)
glossary.μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδῆ), agreeing with οἶνον
glossary.μελισσάων: μέλισσα — bee; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, keeping in mind’
glossary.μενοίτιον: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, son of Actor, father of Patroclus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μερόπων: μέροψ — epithet of men, ’mortal’ or ’speech-dividing’ (meaning uncertain); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’ · also + gen.: ’among’ (μετ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’among the Achaeans’) · also + acc., ’along’ (μετ’ ὄγμον ’along the swath’)
glossary.μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
glossary.μετέπρεπεν: μεταπρέπω — be conspicuous among, stand out among (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., augmented, movable ν
glossary.μεταπρέπει: μεταπρέπω — be conspicuous among, stand out among; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.μετεῖναι: μέτειμι — be among, be present among (+ dat.); pres. inf. (μετ-εῖναι)
glossary.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’) · also + dat. of place: ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσί ’in the mind’) · also + acc. of pursuit: ’after’ (μετὰ πέλειαν ’after the dove’)
glossary.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
glossary.μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
glossary.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’) · also μηδ’ εἰ ’not even if’, before a condition with the indicative · also with an infinitive after a verb of bidding: ’and not to’ (μηδ’ ἐξέμεν ’and not to let go’) · also continuing a negative oath after μή ποτε + inf.: ’nor (even when)’
glossary.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., used with an imperative to forbid: ’and let not’
glossary.μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν) · also ’and do not’ with an infinitive used as a command (μηδὲ … καλλείπειν ’and do not leave’) · also ’and not’ continuing a ὅπως clause with opt. (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν μηδὲ τρομεοίατο ’that they pass and not tremble’) · also ’and not’ + opt., continuing an εἰ-clause of hoped-for outcome (μηδὲ κατακτείνειεν ’and not kill’)
glossary.μηδὲν: μηδείς — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg., with μή-negative after a verb of refusing and an infinitive: ’nothing’
glossary.μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
glossary.μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
glossary.μηνῶν: μείς (epic μήν) — month; masc. gen. pl., in a gen. absolute with φθινόντων
glossary.μηρία: μηρίον — thigh-piece (of a sacrificial victim, burnt for the gods); neut. acc. pl.: ’thigh-pieces’
glossary.μητέρα: μήτηρ — mother; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴτωνα · also fem. acc. sg., pendent object resumed by a pronoun: ’as for my mother’ (μητέρα … τὴν … ἀπέλυσε) · also fem. acc. sg., after ὑπό of motion: ’under (his) mother’ · also fem. acc. sg., person addressed after προσαυδάω: ’(spoke to) his mother’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἐς of motion: ’to (his) mother’ (ἐς μητέρα ’to his mother’)
glossary.μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
glossary.μητιόεντα: μητιόεις — cunning, subtly wrought; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φάρμακα (from μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’)
glossary.μητρυιὴ: μητρυιά — stepmother; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ιή (= Attic μητρυιά)
glossary.μιγήμεναι: μίγνυμι — mix; pass. mingle, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic μιγῆναι): ’to lie with’ · also with ἐν + dat., ’to join, mingle in’ (μιγήμεναι ἐν δαῒ ’to join in battle’)
glossary.μιγεῖσα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; mid./pass. ’unite with’ (+ dat.), the standard expression for sexual union; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
glossary.μινύθει: μινύθω — lessen, diminish (intrans. dwindle); pres. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’lessens’ · also intransitive: ’dwindles, fades’ (μινύθει δέ τε ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων ’the works of men dwindle’)
glossary.μινύθουσι: μινύθω — wither, shrivel, dwindle; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they dwindle’
glossary.μινύθῃ: μινύθω — lessen, diminish (intrans. dwindle); pres. subj. 3 sg. act., transitive, in an indefinite relative clause: ’lessens’
glossary.μισθὸς: μισθός — pay, wages, hire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μιχθεὶς: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having mingled with’
glossary.μνημοσύνη: μνημοσύνη — remembrance, memorial, reminder; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μνησάμενοι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having remembered’

glossary.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
glossary.μολπῇ: μολπή — song with dance, play; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with song and dance’
glossary.μουσάων: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μούνη: μόνος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg., epic μούνη (= Attic μόνη)
glossary.μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
glossary.μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
glossary.μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’only, sole’
glossary.μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μοῦσαι: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of song; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: ’Muses’
glossary.μυθησαίμην: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, recount; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I could tell’
glossary.μυρία: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun
glossary.μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, nook, recess; masc. dat. sg.: ’in the recess (of)’
glossary.μόρον: μόρος — portion, doom, fate; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μύθοισι: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
glossary.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’) · also μή ποτε + fut. inf., the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μή ποτ’ … ἀλεξήσειν ’that never will I ward off’) · μηδέ (written μὴ δ’) — and not, not even; continuing a negative (μὴ δ’ ὁπότ’ ἂν ’not even when’) · also εἰ μὴ + impf. indic., past unreal: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἀνίστατο) · also εἰ μή, ’except’ (εἰ μὴ Ἀχιλλεῖ ’except Achilles’)
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’flocks’
glossary.μῆνα: μείς, μήν — month; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a month’
glossary.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’ · also object of ἐνίψει: ’cunning’ (νόον καὶ μῆτιν ’mind and cunning’) · also object of τεκτήναιτο: ’(frame) cunning’ · also fem. acc. sg. with διά: ’through the counsel (of)’ (διὰ μῆτιν Ἀθήνης ’through Athena’s counsel’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνίσποι: ’cunning, counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of φράζομαι: ’the best cunning’ (φραζώμεθα μῆτιν ἀρίστην ’let us plan the best cunning’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐμβάλλεο: ’(put) cunning’
glossary.μῆτις: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
glossary.μῶμον: μῶμος — blame, reproach; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νέκταρ: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
glossary.νέμεσιν: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, the censure of one’s fellows; fem. acc. sg.: ’indignation’
glossary.νέμεσις: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, resentment, blame; fem. nom. sg., predicate with ἐστί understood: ’(it is) a cause for indignation’
glossary.νέμονται: νέμω — mid. graze, feed on, range over; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’they graze’ · also pres. 3 pl. mid., ’inhabit, dwell in’ (ἄλσεα νέμονται ’inhabit groves’)
glossary.νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος: ’new’ (νέον ἔσσεται ἄλγος ’a new pain will be’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicate: ’young’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, agreeing with ἔργον: ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not at all new’)
glossary.νέφεα: νέφος — cloud; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νέφη)
glossary.νέφος: νέφος — cloud; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀνακλῖναι and ἐπιθεῖναι: ’cloud’
glossary.νήεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νήματ: νῆμα — thread, spun yarn; neut. nom. pl., elided (νήματ’ = νήματα)
glossary.νήπιε: νήπιος — foolish, childish, simple; masc. voc. sg., in reproachful address: ’foolish one’
glossary.νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl., in exclamation: ’fools!’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition to the subject: ’foolish ones’
glossary.νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήριτος: Νήριτος — Neritus, one of the makers of the spring; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήσοισι: νῆσος — island; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ναίειν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. inf., after ὄφελες in a wish: ’to dwell’
glossary.ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
glossary.ναιετάουσιν: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι)
glossary.ναυσίθοον: Ναυσίθοος — Nausithous, father of Alcinous; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
glossary.νεικείων: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικῶν)
glossary.νεικείῃ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rail at, rebuke; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic νεικῇ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest he rebuke’
glossary.νειόθι: νειόθι — deep down, in the depths (-θι of place); adv., + gen.
glossary.νειὸν: νειός — fallow land, fallow field; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νειῷ: νειός — fallow field; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic νέφεσι)
glossary.νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
glossary.νεφέων: νέφος — cloud; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεφῶν)
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νεφεληγερέταο: νεφεληγερέτης — cloud-gatherer, epithet of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νεύοιεν: νεύω — nod, bow the head; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’may they nod’
glossary.νεώτερος: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’younger’
glossary.νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
glossary.νηί: ναῦς (epic νηῦς) — ship; fem. dat. sg. νηί
glossary.νηδύος: νηδύς — belly, stomach; fem. gen. sg., with ἀντιάσειε
glossary.νηδὺν: νηδύς — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
glossary.νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦτορ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’pitiless’
glossary.νημερτής: Νημερτής — Nemertes (’Unerring’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg. (from νημερτής ’unerring, truthful’)
glossary.νησαίη: Νησαίη — Nesaea (’Islander’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νηυσί: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί), without ν-movable
glossary.νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
glossary.νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νικήσας: νικάω — conquer, win; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having prevailed over’
glossary.νικηθεὶς: νικάω — conquer; pass. be beaten; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having been beaten’
glossary.νιφόεντι: νιφόεις — snowy, snow-clad (νίφω ’snow’); neut. dat. sg., epic -όεις, agreeing with ὄρεϊ · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with a masc. name: ’snowy (Tmolus)’
glossary.νιφόεντος: νιφόεις — snowy, snow-covered; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νιψάμενος: νίζω — wash; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having washed (his hands)’
glossary.νοήσας: νοέω — perceive, notice, look at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having noticed, seeing’
glossary.νοήσῃ: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she notice’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’if he notices’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whoever thinks of’ (ὅς τ’ … νοήσῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὡς, with μήτε … μήτε: ’that no one notice’
glossary.νομὸν: νομός — pasture, grazing ground; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, think, consider; aor. inf. act.: οἶδε νοῆσαι ’knows how to consider’
glossary.νοῦσον: νοῦσος — sickness, disease; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic νόσος)
glossary.νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
glossary.νυκτὸς: νύξ — night; fem. gen. sg., gen. of comparison (after ἀμείνω) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἀμολγῷ: ’of night’ (νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night’)
glossary.νυμφέων: νύμφη — nymph; fem. gen. pl., Ionic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.νόημα: νόημα — thought, notion, idea, purpose; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
glossary.νόοιο: νόος — mind, thought, purpose; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
glossary.νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
glossary.νόσφ: νόσφι (elided νόσφ’) — apart, apart from, without; adv. and prep. + gen.
glossary.νόσφι: νόσφι — apart, aside; adv., also prep. + gen. ’apart from’ (νόσφι λιασθείς ’withdrawn apart’)
glossary.νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
glossary.νότου: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
glossary.νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νύκτ: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, elided (νύκτ’ = νύκτα): ’for the night’ · also fem. acc. sg., elided, direct object: ’a night’ (νύκτ’ ὀλοὴν τάνυσε ’stretched a baneful night’)
glossary.νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, after διά: ’(through) the night’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of a verb of covering: ’night’ (νύκτα … ἐκάλυψε) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἕλκω: ’night’ (ἕλκον νύκτα ’drawing night’) · also fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration without a preposition, with a participle: ’through the night’ (νύκτα φυλασσομένοισι ’keeping watch through the night’) · also fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration with an infinitive: ’through the night’ (νύκτα φυλασσέμεναι ’to keep watch through the night’) · also fem. acc. sg. after ἀνά, ’throughout the night’ (ἀνὰ νύκτα)
glossary.νύμφας: νύμφη — bride, young wife; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφην: νύμφη — bride, young wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νύξ: νύσσω — stab, pierce; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (νύξ’ = ἔνυξε) · also νύξ — night; fem. nom. sg. · also aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (νύξ’ = νύξε): ’stabbed’
glossary.νῆ: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα (= Attic ναῦν), elided (νῆ’ = νῆα)
glossary.νῆα: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg., epic νῆα
glossary.νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl., poetic ’the broad back of the sea’ · also acc. pl. of respect, ’on the back’ (ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός ’blood-red on the back’) · also neut. acc. pl., object of βάλλω with μετά: ’the back’ (μετὰ νῶτα βαλών ’having turned the back’) · also neut. acc. pl., after ἀνά: ’along the back’ (ἀνὰ νῶτα θέουσα ’running along the back’) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ’the backs’
glossary.νῶτον: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. sg. (usually pl. νῶτα)
glossary.ξανθὴν: ξανθός — yellow, fair-haired; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀγαμήδην: ’fair-haired’
glossary.ξείνοισι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; dat. pl. (epic = Attic ξένοις)
glossary.ξεινοδόκῳ: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
glossary.ξυνιόντων: σύνειμι (εἶμι) — come together, meet; pres. part. masc. gen. pl., epic ξυν- for συν- (= Attic συνιόντων)
glossary.ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ξύνισαν: ξυνίημι (= Attic συνίημι) — bring together, join; aor. 3 pl., athematic -σαν, intransitive in sense: ’they met’
glossary.οἰδιπόδαο: Οἰδιπόδης (Attic Οἰδίπους) — Oedipus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο
glossary.οἰκί: οἰκίον — dwelling, home; neut. pl. οἰκία (acc. pl.), elided (οἰκί’ = οἰκία)
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer has only neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰωνοὺς: οἰωνός — bird, bird of prey; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’) · also dat. of possession: ’his’ (οἱ ἵπποι ’his horses’)
glossary.οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
glossary.οἴδματι: οἶδμα — swell, surge of water; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.οἴκαδε: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv., οἶκος + directional suffix -δε
glossary.οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
glossary.οἴκου: οἶκος — house, dwelling, household; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οἴκους: οἶκος — house, home; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour unsettled); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἴνοπι: οἶνοψ — wine-dark, wine-faced (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
glossary.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
glossary.οἵην: οἷος — such as, what a (exclamatory); fem. acc. sg.: ’such a, what a’
glossary.οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’
glossary.οἶδεν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. (with pres. sense): ’knows’
glossary.οἶκοι: οἶκος — house, dwelling; masc. nom. pl.: ’houses’
glossary.οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, after κατά: ’in the house, at home’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after εἰς: ’into the house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after πρός: ’to the house’
glossary.οἶκόν: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.οἶνόν: οἶνος — wine; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; neut. acc. sg.: ’only, nothing but’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’alone’, agreeing with the object · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), agreeing with δέρμα: ’only’ (οἶον δέρμα ’only the skin’)
glossary.οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’ · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, printed with this accent (= οἳ): ’they’ (οἷ δ’ ἐγρηγόρθασι)
glossary.οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’such things as’ · also with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’
glossary.οἷος: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. nom. sg., rough breathing (not οἶος ’alone’); in an indirect question: ’what sort of’ · also in a simile, introducing the likeness: ’like, just as’ (οἷος … ἀστήρ ’like a star’)
glossary.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl.: ’to whom’ (οἷς … μέλει ’to whom … is a care’)
glossary.οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἅρμασιν: ’its own’ · also masc. dat. pl., used as a noun: ’his own (men)’ · also relative ὅς, masc. dat. pl.: ’on whom’ (οἷσιν ἐπὶ … θῆκε ’on whom … set’) · also relative, dat. pl. of interest: ’for whom’ (οἷσιν ἀνάγκη ’for whom there is need’) · also relative, neut. dat. pl. of means: ’with which’ (οἷσιν … ῥήγνυντο ’with which they broke’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl., indirect object: ’to whom’ (οἷσιν … ἔδωκε ’to whom … gave’) · also masc. dat. pl., agreeing with ἵπποις: ’his own’ (οἷσιν ἵπποις ’his own horses’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl., with ἀνάσσω (dat. of those ruled): ’over whom’
glossary.οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
glossary.οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
glossary.οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
glossary.οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’no (use)’ (οὐδὲν … ὄφελος ’no use at all’)
glossary.οὐδὸν: οὐδός — threshold; masc. acc. sg., after ἐπί: ’onto the threshold’
glossary.οὐδῷ: οὐδός — threshold; masc. dat. sg., after ἐπί (with γήραος): ’on the threshold (of old age)’
glossary.οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
glossary.οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
glossary.οὐλομένην: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. οὐλόμενος used as adj., ’accursed, ruinous’; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.οὐλομένης: οὐλόμενος — accursed, destructive, ruinous (perf. part. of ὄλλυμι used as adj.); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.οὐλόμενον: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; οὐλόμενος (= ὀλόμενος) aor. part. mid. as adj., ’accursed, baneful, ruinous’; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
glossary.οὐλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.οὐρανιώνων: Οὐρανίων — son of Uranus, god of heaven (Οὐρανίωνες, the heavenly gods); masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the gods of heaven’
glossary.οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
glossary.οὐρανόν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οὐρανός: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐρανῷ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.οὐρῆας: οὐρεύς — mule; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ὀρεῖς)
glossary.οὐρῇ: οὐρά — tail; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic οὐρᾷ), dat. of means: ’with his tail’
glossary.οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
glossary.οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
glossary.οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
glossary.οὔασι: οὖς — ear; neut. dat. pl., epic οὔασι (= Attic ὠσί): ’with (their) ears’
glossary.οὔατα: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
glossary.οὔρεα: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔρεα (= Attic ὄρη)
glossary.οὔρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic οὔρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
glossary.οὔρεσι: ὄρος (epic οὖρος) — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic οὔρεσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
glossary.οὔρεσιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic οὖρος, οὔρεσιν (= Attic ὄρεσιν)
glossary.οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
glossary.οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα) · also ’that’, introducing what was learned (πεύθετο … οὕνεκ’ … ἔμελλον ’learned that they were about to’)
glossary.οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, since; conj., epic (= οὗ ἕνεκα; Attic ὅτι), accented before the enclitic μοι
glossary.οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a messenger is to tell (= ὅτι): ἐρέοντα … οὕνεκα ’to tell that’
glossary.οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’) · also relative, object of ἑλόμην: ’which’ (of horses)
glossary.οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
glossary.οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
glossary.οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, earth, floor; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
glossary.οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
glossary.οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: ’this man’ · also masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τις: οὗτός τις … ἀνήρ ’this is some man’
glossary.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα) · also adverbial acc.: ’in everything’ (πάντ’ αὐτῷ … ἐϊκυῖα ’like him in everything’)
glossary.πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
glossary.πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πάντεσσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πάντη: πάντῃ — on every side, in every direction; adv. (Ionic -η)
glossary.πάντοθεν: πάντοθεν — from all sides, on every side; adv.
glossary.πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’) · also prep. + dat., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’by, beside’ (νηῒ πάρα ’by the ship’) · also prep. + acc., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’beside’ (ποταμὸν πάρα ’beside the river’) · also πάρα = πάρεισι, with a plural subject: ’are at hand’ (πάρα … ἄλλοι ’others are at hand’)
glossary.πάρεστιν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand (παρά + εἰμί); pres. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.πάροιθε: πάροιθε — in front, before; adv. of place
glossary.πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. · also + gen.: ’in front of’
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
glossary.πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πάσῃσιν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πάσαις), agreeing with τῇσιν: ’all (of them)’
glossary.πέλαγος: πέλαγος — the open sea, high sea; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.πέλει: πέλω — be, come to be; pres. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐστί): ’is, exists’
glossary.πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become; of distances, extend, run; pres. 3 pl.: ’they go, extend’ · also pres. 3 pl., copulative with a predicate noun: ’are, become’ (ἤϊα πέλονται ’become food’)
glossary.πέλωρον: πέλωρ — monster, portent; neut. acc. sg., a noun in apposition to a masc. noun (the adjective πέλωρος ’monstrous’ would be masc. here)
glossary.πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπε): ’sent, was sending’
glossary.πέμπον: πέμπω — send, convey; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπον)
glossary.πέμπτον: πέμπτος — fifth; ordinal adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.πέμπτῳ: πέμπτος — fifth; masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’for the fifth (man)’
glossary.πέμψαν: πέμπω — send, send off; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (Attic ἔπεμψαν)
glossary.πένεσθαι: πένομαι — busy oneself about, prepare, work at; pres. inf.
glossary.πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’grief’
glossary.πέντε: πέντε — five; numeral, indeclinable, agreeing with κασιγνήτῃσιν
glossary.πέποιθε: πείθω — persuade; perf. act. trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with present sense: ’trusts’
glossary.πέπον: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πέρην: πέρην — across, on the far side; adv., used as prep. + gen.: ’across from’
glossary.πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its noun: ’around’ (πόλιν πέρι ’around the city’) · also prep. + dat. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ᾧ πέρι ’around which’)
glossary.πέρσης: Πέρση — Perse, an Oceanid, mother of Circe; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης
glossary.πέτρας: πέτρα — rock, crag, cliff; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πέτρην: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην (= Attic πέτραν), goal of the verb of flying in: ’rock’
glossary.πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πέτρῃ: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πέτρῃσι: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
glossary.πήξας: πήγνυμι — fix, plant, make fast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fixed’
glossary.πίθηται: πείθω — persuade; mid. be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (αἴ κε πίθηται ’if he may be persuaded’)
glossary.πίθοιο: πείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., in a polite request: ’you might obey’ · also in a condition after εἰ: ’if you would obey’ (εἴ μοί τι πίθοιο)
glossary.πίλνατο: πίλναμαι — draw near, come close; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπίλνατο), + dat.: ’drew near to, came down on’
glossary.πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πίονι: πίων — fat, rich, wealthy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πίσυνος: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παίδεσσι: παῖς — child, son; dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic παισί)
glossary.παίδεσσιν: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic παισίν)
glossary.παθοῦσα: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
glossary.παθόντες: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having suffered’
glossary.παθὼν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
glossary.παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg., after ξύν · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of δόμεν: ’to her child’ · also masc. dat. sg., after περί, of place or concern: ’around’ (φίλῳ περὶ παιδί ’around his dear son’)
glossary.παιδὸς: παῖς — child, son; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.παισὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.παλάμῃσιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’in the hands’
glossary.παλλάδ: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena; fem. acc. sg., elided (Παλλάδ’ = Παλλάδα)
glossary.παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παμφαίνων: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gleaming’
glossary.παντοίην: παντοῖος — of every kind, all sorts of; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.παντὸς: πᾶς — all, whole; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with στρατοῦ: ’the whole (army)’
glossary.παπταίνων: παπταίνω — look about, peer around; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’ · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond, out of the way of’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
glossary.παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg., predicate · also fem. nom. sg., subject in apposition: ’consort’ (Διὸς αἰδοίη παράκοιτις ’Zeus’ revered consort’)
glossary.παρασχεῖν: παρέχω — provide, furnish, give; aor. inf. act.
glossary.παρελέξατο: παραλέγομαι — lie beside, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic
glossary.παρεόντος: πάρειμι — be present, be by; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντος), in a genitive absolute
glossary.παρθένος: παρθένος — maiden, unmarried girl; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
glossary.πασέων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl. πασέων, epic (= Attic πασῶν)
glossary.πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
glossary.πατρός: πατήρ — father; masc. gen. sg.: ’(my) father’s’ (πατρός τε μέγα κλέος ’my father’s great glory’); also gen. of comparison after ἀμείνων: ’than his father’
glossary.παχὺν: παχύς — thick, stout; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter, son; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα): ’child, daughter’ (παῖς is common gender) · also masc. acc. sg., elided: ’boy, son’ (παῖδ’ ὀρφανικόν ’the boy an orphan’) · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε): ’(two) boys’ (Μολίονε παῖδ’ ’the two Molions, boys’)
glossary.παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παῖς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παῦρα: παῦρος — few, little; neut. acc. pl.: ’few things’
glossary.παῦροι: παῦρος — few, small; adj., masc. nom. pl.: ’few’
glossary.πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.πείρασι: πεῖραρ — limit, end, boundary; neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πέρασι, from πέρας)
glossary.πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
glossary.πείρατα: πεῖραρ — end, limit, boundary; neut. acc. pl. (πείρατα γαίης ’the ends of the earth’)
glossary.πεδόθεν: πεδόθεν — from the ground, from the bottom; adv. (πέδον ’ground’ + -θεν): ’from the foundations, through and through’
glossary.πελίης: Πελίας — Pelias; masc. nom. sg., epic Πελίης
glossary.πελεμίζετ: πελεμίζω — shake, make tremble; impf. 3 sg. pass., elided (πελεμίζετ’ = πελεμίζετο), unaugmented: ’was shaken’
glossary.πελώριον: πελώριος — huge, monstrous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα: ’huge’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’huge’
glossary.πελώρου: πέλωρον — monster, portent (adj. πέλωρος ’monstrous’); neut. gen. sg. πελώρου
glossary.πενίῃ: πενία — poverty, need; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ίῃ (= Attic πενίᾳ), dat. after εἴκων
glossary.πεπαρμένη: πείρω — pierce through, transfix; perf. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’pierced through’
glossary.πεπείρημαι: πειράομαι — try, test, make trial of; perf. 1 sg., Ionic η for Attic long α: ’I have had experience (of)’
glossary.πεπνυμένα: πέπνυμαι — be prudent, wise (perf. w/ pres. sense, from πνέω ’breathe’); part. neut. acc. pl.: ’prudent (counsels)’
glossary.πεπυκασμένος: πυκάζω — cover closely, shroud; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’covered, hidden’ (+ dat. of means)
glossary.περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
glossary.περί: περί — around, about; adv. ’exceedingly, beyond others’ · also in tmesis with εἰμί + gen. (περί … εἰμί ’surpass’): ’be above, surpass’ · also prep. + acc. of place, with ἀμφί τε following: ’round about’ (περί τ’ ἀμφί τε τάφρον ’round and about the ditch’)
glossary.περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ), agreeing with δίφρον · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with δειρήν: ’very beautiful’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα: ’very beautiful (armour)’
glossary.περικλυτὸν: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.περικλυτὸς: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Hephaestus
glossary.περιπλομένου: περιπέλομαι — revolve, come round; syncopated pres. part. mid. (= περιπελομένου), masc. gen. sg., gen. absolute with ἐνιαυτοῦ: ’as the year rolled round’
glossary.περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — come round, revolve, circle about; aor. part. mid. gen. pl.: ’circling round’ (of years, of besieging foes)
glossary.περσεφονείης: Περσεφόνεια — Persephone, queen of the dead; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.περσεὺς: Περσεύς — Perseus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’) · also + acc., of concern: ’about, busy over’ (περὶ δόρπα πονέοντο ’were busy about the meal’)
glossary.πεσόντος: πίπτω — fall, drop; aor. part. act., masc. gen. sg.: ’having fallen’, i.e. slain
glossary.πετάλοισι: πέταλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πεφραδέμεν: φράζω — show, point out, tell; aor. inf., epic reduplicated (= Attic φράσαι)
glossary.πεφυλαγμένος: φυλάσσω — guard; mid. be on one’s guard; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., with εἶναι: ’on one’s guard’
glossary.πεφύασι: φύω — grow, come to be; perf. 3 pl. act., epic (= Attic πεφύκασι): ’have grown, grow’
glossary.πεύθετο: πεύθομαι (epic by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, hear of; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπεύθετο)
glossary.πη: πη — in any way, anywhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (οὐδέ πη ’nor anywhere’), distinct from interrogative πῇ ’how?’
glossary.πηγαὶ: πηγή — spring, source; fem. nom. pl.: ’springs’
glossary.πηγὰς: πηγή — spring, source; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πηδάλιον: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πημαίνει: πημαίνω — harm, hurt; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’obeying’
glossary.πινέμεν: πίνω — drink; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πίνειν), used as an imperative: ’drink!’ · also complementary inf. after κέλεται: ’to drink’ · also complementary inf. after a verb of pressing or attacking: ἐχράετ’ ἐσθιέμεν καὶ πινέμεν ’you pressed on to eat and to drink’
glossary.πινόντων: πίνω — drink; pres. imper. 3 pl. (Attic πινέτωσαν): ’let them drink’
glossary.πιφαύσκεαι: πιφαύσκομαι — make known, tell, announce; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), + dat.
glossary.πλέον: πλέω — sail; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλεον) · also πλείων — more; neut. acc. sg. (= πλεῖον) · also πλέος (πλέως) — full, + gen.; neut. nom. sg.: ‘full’ (εἰδώλων … πλέον ‘full of phantoms’)
glossary.πλήθωσι: πλήθω — be full, fill; pres. subj. 3 pl., + gen.: ’may be full of’
glossary.πλατέ: πλατύς — broad, wide; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πλατέ’ = πλατέα)
glossary.πλείη: πλεῖος — full, + gen.; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πλέα)
glossary.πλείου: πλεῖος (Attic πλέως) — full; masc. gen. sg. (Attic πλέω), agreeing with κρητῆρος: ’of the full (bowl)’
glossary.πλείους: πλείων (πλέων) — more; masc. nom. pl., comparative of πολύς, contracted (= πλέονες), with gen. of comparison
glossary.πλείστη: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος; fem. nom. sg. πλείστη: ’thickest, most’
glossary.πλείστην: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος, most; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πλεόνεσσι: πλείων — more, more numerous; masc. dat. pl., epic πλεόνεσσι (= Attic πλείοσι)
glossary.πλεόνων: πλείων (comparative of πολύς) — more, greater in number; masc. gen. pl., epic πλεόνων (= Attic πλειόνων): ’of more’
glossary.πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom./acc. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’the greater part’ · also πλεῖος — full; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’a full cup’ (or read as the comparative, ’a larger cup’)
glossary.πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. pl.: ’the most, as much as possible’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with κτήματα: ’the most, the greatest store’
glossary.πλεῖστον: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’most, above all’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’thickest, greatest’ (πλεῖστον ὅμιλον ’the thickest throng’)
glossary.πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πληιάδας: Πληιάδες — the Pleiades, a star-cluster; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πλούτῳ: πλοῦτος — wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ’in (for) wealth’
glossary.πλοῦτον: πλοῦτος — wealth, riches; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πλόον: πλόος — voyage, sailing, course; masc. acc. sg., epic πλόον (= Attic πλοῦν)
glossary.πλῆντο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐπλήντο): ’were filled’
glossary.πνοιῇσι: πνοιή — blast, breath of wind; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ποίη: ποίη — grass, herbage; fem. nom. sg. (distinct from ποῖος ’of what kind’)
glossary.ποίης: ποῖος — of what sort, what kind of; fem. gen. sg. · also ποίη — grass; fem. gen. sg. (ἄνθεα ποίης ’flowers of the grass’)
glossary.ποίησ: ποιέω — make, cause, put; aor. 3 sg., elided and unaugmented (ποίησ’ = ποίησε, Attic ἐποίησε): ’put (a thought) in’
glossary.ποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐποίησαν): ’they made’
glossary.ποίησε: ποιέω — make, create, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησε)
glossary.ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ποθ’); οὔ ποθ’ ’never’
glossary.ποιήσασθαι: ποιέω — make; aor. mid. inf.: ’to make for oneself’
glossary.ποιήσατ: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ποιήσατ’ = ποιήσατο)
glossary.ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for herself’
glossary.ποικίλον: ποικίλος — intricately wrought, many-coloured, dappled; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’dappled, richly wrought’
glossary.ποιμένες: ποιμήν — shepherd, herdsman; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
glossary.πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
glossary.πολέεσσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἀποπαύεο: ’from war’ · also gen. sg. of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after εἶκε: ’from war’ (εἶκε … πολέμου ’withdraw from war’) · also masc. gen. sg. of separation after ἀφεξόμεθ’: ’from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἔραται: ’for war’ (πολέμου ἔραται ’loves war’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἀκορήτω: ’insatiate of war’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἤ, dependent on ἔρον: ’than (desire) for war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ἐρωή: ’(respite) from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on τέλος: ’of war’ (τέλος πολέμου ’the outcome of war’) · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ὀαριστύς: ’of war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on στόμα: ’of war’ (πολέμου στόμα ’the mouth of war’) · also masc. gen. sg., after ἐσσυμένους: ’(eager) for war’
glossary.πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πολεμήια: πολεμήιος — of war, warlike; neut. nom. pl., epic -ήιος (= Attic πολεμικός)
glossary.πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
glossary.πολλή: πολύς — much, many; adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
glossary.πολλήν: πολύς — much, many, great; fem. acc. sg.: ’much, great’
glossary.πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πολλόν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg., epic -λλ- (= Attic πολύ), adverbial: ’by much’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’much’
glossary.πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
glossary.πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
glossary.πολλὴ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
glossary.πολλὴν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κομιδήν: ’great’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέρα: ’much (mist)’
glossary.πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with φῦκος: ’much (seaweed)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱδρῶ: ’much (sweat)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with τρόφι: ’greatly’ (πολλὸν … τρόφι ’greatly swollen’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πυρετόν: ’much (fever)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τύμβον: ’large (mound)’
glossary.πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many, great; fem. dat. sg.: ’thick, great’
glossary.πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
glossary.πολλῷ: πολύς — much, great; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ὁμάδῳ: ’great’
glossary.πολυήρατον: πολυήρατος — much-loved, lovely; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἥβην
glossary.πολυδαίδαλον: πολυδαίδαλος — richly wrought, much-adorned; masc./fem. acc. sg. (two-termination adj.)
glossary.πολυδώρη: Πολυδώρη — Polydora, daughter of Peleus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πολυηράτῳ: πολυήρατος — much-loved, lovely; fem. dat. sg., with Θήβῃ
glossary.πολυκλύστῳ: πολύκλυστος — much-dashed-by-waves, much-surging (κλύζω ’surge, wash over’); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus · also epithet of Mount Ida: ’many-folded’ (Ἴδης … πολυπτύχου)
glossary.πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πολύδωρον: Πολύδωρος — Polydorus, youngest son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
glossary.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’ (πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ’through the great throng’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον: ’much (toil)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄμβρον: ’a great (rain)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κολοσυρτόν: ’a great (uproar)’ · πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀρυμαγδόν: ’a great (din)’
glossary.πονησάμενος: πονέομαι — labour, toil at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laboured, having got through (his tasks)’
glossary.ποντοπόροιο: ποντοπόρος — sea-going, crossing the sea; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νηός
glossary.ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
glossary.ποσειδάωνα: Ποσειδῶν (epic Ποσειδάων) — Poseidon; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
