glossary.ποσσίν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -σσιν (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
glossary.ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
glossary.ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
glossary.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’) · also prep. + gen., ’toward’ (ποτὶ πτόλιος ’toward the city’) · also prep. + acc., ’to, toward’ (ποτὶ γαῖαν ’to the earth’)
glossary.πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
glossary.πουλυβότειραν: πουλυβότειρα — much-nourishing, bounteous; fem. acc. sg., epic (= πολυβότειρα), epithet of the earth
glossary.πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέρα: ’a great (mist)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with στρατόν: ’a great (host)’ · also masc. acc. sg. form beside fem. ὑγρήν, noun unsaid: ’wide (wet)’; construction not quite clear · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’
glossary.πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
glossary.πρέπει: πρέπω — be conspicuous, stand out, be eminent; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.πρήξεις: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, achieve; fut. 2 sg. act., Ionic η: ’you will achieve’
glossary.πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
glossary.πραπίδεσσι: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.πρεσβυτάτη: πρέσβυς — old, aged; superl. πρεσβύτατος, fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’eldest’
glossary.πρεσβύτατον: πρέσβυς — old, elder; superl. πρεσβύτατος ’eldest’; masc. acc. sg., used as a noun
glossary.προλιπὼν: προλείπω — leave behind, abandon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
glossary.προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front of; prep. + gen. (also adv.)
glossary.προρέει: προρέω — flow forth; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic προρρεῖ): ’flows forth’
glossary.προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.προσιόντι: πρόσειμι (πρός + εἶμι) — go toward, approach; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he approached’
glossary.προτέρη: πρότερος — before, earlier, first; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’sooner, first’, Ionic η (= Attic προτέρα)
glossary.προτέρην: πρότερος — earlier, first; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with the object: ’first’, before another
glossary.προτέροισι: πρότερος — earlier, before, first (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ὑμῖν: ’the earlier ones’
glossary.προτέρων: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’of earlier (men)’
glossary.προτέρῳ: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’the day before’
glossary.προφρονέως: προφρονέως — readily, willingly, eagerly; adv. of πρόφρων (-έως = Attic -όνως)
glossary.προφυγεῖν: προφεύγω — flee forth, escape; aor. inf.: ’to escape’
glossary.προχέειν: προχέω — pour forth, discharge; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic προχεῖν)
glossary.προχοῇς: προχοή — outflow, river-mouth; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic προχοαῖς): ’at the mouths’
glossary.προχόῳ: πρόχοος — pitcher, jug (for pouring); dat. sg.
glossary.πρωτογόνων: πρωτόγονος — first-born, first-yeaned; adj., gen. pl., with ἀρνῶν
glossary.πρωτώ: Πρωτώ — Proto (’First’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρό τε παίδων ’for the children’) · also after a locative in -θι, ’in front of’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’in front of Ilios’)
glossary.πρόπαν: πρόπας — all through, the whole; neut. acc. sg., of time (πρόπαν ἦμαρ ’all day long’)
glossary.πρός: πρός — to, towards; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’before, in the sight of’ (of witnesses); accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’ · also adv., elided: ’in front, before him’
glossary.πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
glossary.πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
glossary.πρόσωπα: πρόσωπον — face; neut. acc. pl. (plural for one face)
glossary.πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
glossary.πρόφρονι: πρόφρων — eager, ready-minded, willing; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with θυμῷ: ’ready’
glossary.πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτη: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτην: πρῶτος — first; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with the addressed σέ: ’you first’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄντυγα: ’outermost’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’)
glossary.πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
glossary.πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
glossary.πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form) · also conj. + opt., after a negative in past time: ’before, until’ (πρὶν πειρήσαιτ’ ’until he made trial’) · also conj. + inf.: ’before’ (πρὶν … εἰσαφικέσθαι ’before reaching’) · also conj. + subj., after a negative: ’until’ (πρὶν … πάθῃσθα ’until you suffer’) · also adv., with τό: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρὶν)
glossary.πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)
glossary.πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
glossary.πρῶτ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (πρῶτ’ = πρῶτα): ’first, at first’
glossary.πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’ · also τὰ πρῶτα, neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’the first prize’
glossary.πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
glossary.πρῶτόν: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for the first time’, accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.πτερύγεσσι: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πτέρυξι)
glossary.πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. (nom. pl. also)
glossary.πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
glossary.πτολιπόρθῳ: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities; masc. dat. sg., epic πτολι- (= πολι-)
glossary.πυθμέν: πυθμήν — base, stock, trunk; masc. acc. sg., elided (πυθμέν’ = πυθμένα)
glossary.πυθμένι: πυθμήν — base, bottom, foot; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πυθοῖ: Πυθώ — Pytho, the older name of Delphi, seat of Apollo’s oracle; fem. dat. sg. Πυθοῖ
glossary.πυκάσαι: πυκάζω — cover thickly; aor. inf., after πρίν: ’to cover’
glossary.πυκινοὺς: πυκινός — thick, close-set, stout; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic πυκνούς)
glossary.πυκινὰς: πυκινός — thick, close-packed, dense; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl.: ’thick’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with καρήαθ’: ’thick (heads)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’thickly, in quick succession’
glossary.πυκνὸν: πυκνός — thick, dense, close-packed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πυλέων: πύλη — gate; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.πυρός: πῦρ — fire; neut. gen. sg., partitive: ’a share of fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., with μαλεροῦ, of the means after ἐμπρήσειν: ’with devouring fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on αὐγῇ: ’of the fire’ (ἐν πυρὸς αὐγῇ ’in the glare of the fire’) · also neut. gen. sg., of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from the fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on σέλας: ’of a burning fire’ (σέλας … πυρός ’a gleam of fire’)
glossary.πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
glossary.πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’) · also μή πως, ’lest somehow’ (μή πως συγκύρσειαν ’lest somehow they collide’)
glossary.πόδα: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the foot’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’foot’ of a mountain, after ὑπαί (πόδα νείατον Ἴδης) · also masc. acc. sg., after πάρ: ’beside the foot’ (πὰρ πόδα)
glossary.πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
glossary.πόλεμοί: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. pl. (accented before the enclitic that follows)
glossary.πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόλεμόν: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόλεμός: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg. (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’much, greatly’ (πόλλ’ ἀεκαζομένη ’much against her will’)
glossary.πόνοιο: πόνος — toil, labour, work; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of what is lost after ἀποσφήλειε · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of respect with ἆτα: ’of toil’ (δόλων ἆτ’ ἠδὲ πόνοιο ’insatiate of tricks and toil’) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀντιάσητον: ’(take part in) the toil’ · also masc. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀναπνεύσωσι: ’(get breath) from toil’ · also masc. gen. sg. of separation, after παύω: ’from toil’
glossary.πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
glossary.πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
glossary.πόνων: πόνος — toil, hardship, labor; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
glossary.πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν): ’gave’
glossary.πόροι: πόρον (πορεῖν) — give, furnish; aor. opt. 3 sg. (a defective aorist with no present in this sense)
glossary.πόρον: πόρος — ford, crossing-place; masc. acc. sg. · also πόρον — gave, granted; defective aor. (suppletive of δίδωμι), 1 sg. or 3 pl. act.
glossary.πόσσ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic πόσσι, elided (πόσσ’ = ποσσί; Attic ποσί): ’under the feet’
glossary.πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
glossary.πύλαι: πύλη — gate; fem. nom. pl. (the plural is the usual form)
glossary.πύματον: πύματος — last, final; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δρόμον: ’last’ (πύματον δρόμον ’the last stretch’)
glossary.πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
glossary.πώεα: πῶϋ — flock (of sheep) (= Attic πρόβατα); neut. pl. πώεα, nom./acc.: ’flocks’
glossary.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
glossary.πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἣ (the head): ’all of it’ (ἣ … πᾶσα ’the whole of it’) · πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Τροίη: ’all (of Troy)’
glossary.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
glossary.πῆμ: πῆμα — woe, calamity; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα) · also neut. nom. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα), subject: ’woe’ (πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’woe awaited’)
glossary.πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, bane; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to the whole action · also neut. nom. sg., subject of λίποιτο: ’a woe (be left)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθέντες: ’woe’ (πῆμα τιθέντες ’inflicting woe’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(you are) a woe’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ’(to become) a bane’ (πῆμα γενέσθαι ’to become a bane’)
glossary.πῶμ: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῶμ’ = πῶμα)
glossary.πῶμα: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg. (distinct from πόμα ’drink’)
glossary.σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
glossary.σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’
glossary.σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἄρξομαι: ’from you’ (σέο … ἄρξομαι ’I shall begin from you’) · also gen. sg. after ἕξεται: ’on you’ (σέο … ἕξεται ’will rest on you’) · also gen. sg. after ἐκ: ’from you’ (σέο δ’ ἐκ ’and from you’)
glossary.σίδηρος: σίδηρος — iron; masc. nom. sg., also an iron weapon or tool
glossary.σίνεται: σίνομαι — harm, injure, hurt; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’harms’
glossary.σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the thing one takes one’s fill of · also masc. gen. sg., partitive object of πάσασθαι: ’of food’ · also masc. gen. sg., object of μεμνημένος: ’of food’ (οὔτέ τι σίτου … μεμνημένος ’mindful of no food’)
glossary.σεμέλη: Σεμέλη — Semele, mother of Dionysus; fem. nom. sg., subject of τέκε
glossary.σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also periphrasis for a person, nom. subject: ’the great strength of Eetion’ = mighty Eetion
glossary.σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg., used adverbially: ’in silence’
glossary.σιδήρεον: σιδήρεος — of iron, iron; epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηροῦς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom. sg. in the same adjective, ’iron’
glossary.σιδήρῳ: σίδηρος — iron; masc. dat. sg., also an iron tool or weapon
glossary.σιδηρέη: σιδήρεος — of iron, iron; fem. nom. sg. (κραδίη σιδηρέη ’a heart of iron’, image of an unbreakable will)
glossary.σκάμανδρον: Σκάμανδρος — Scamander, the river of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκαιῇ: σκαιός — left; fem. dat. sg., with χειρί understood: ’with the left (hand)’
glossary.σκιῇ: σκιά — shadow; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic σκιᾷ), with εἴκελον: ’like a shadow’
glossary.σκοπιὴν: σκοπιή — lookout, watch-post; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic σκοπιάν): ’the lookout’
glossary.σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
glossary.σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
glossary.σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
glossary.σπέρμα: σπέρμα — seed; neut. acc. sg. (σπέρμα πυρὸς ’a seed of fire’, an idiom for embers kept alive under ash)
glossary.σπειώ: Σπειώ — Speio (’Grotto’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σπεύδειν: σπεύδω — hurry, press on; pres. inf. act.
glossary.σπῆι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. sg., epic σπῆϊ (contracted σπῆι)
glossary.στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
glossary.στήριξε: στηρίζω — fix firmly, set fast; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐστήριξε): ’set’
glossary.σταθμοῖσι: σταθμός — steading, farmstead, stall; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also σταθμός — door-post; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι: ’at the door-posts’
glossary.σταθμῷ: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. dat. sg., after ἔνι (ἔνι postpositive): ’in the steading’
glossary.στεροπήν: στεροπή — lightning, flash; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἀστραπή)
glossary.στεροπῆς: στεροπή — lightning, flash, gleam; fem. gen. sg. (poetic word; Attic ἀστραπή): ’the gleam (of bronze)’
glossary.στεφάνην: στεφάνη — rim, ring, crown; of a helmet, the helmet itself; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.στεῖχον: στείχω — go, march, walk; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔστειχον): ’went, marched’
glossary.στιβαρῆς: στιβαρός — stout, strong, solid; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with χειρός
glossary.στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα, agreeing with βέλεα
glossary.στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στυγέουσι: στυγέω — hate, abhor; pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic στυγοῦσι): ’they hate’
glossary.στυγερὴ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with νοῦσος
glossary.στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’) · also the point of a weapon: ’tip’ (κατὰ στόμα … χαλκῷ ’at the tip, with bronze’)
glossary.στόματος: στόμα — mouth; neut. gen. sg., genitive of separation: ’out of his mouth’
glossary.συμμάρψας: συμμάρπτω — grasp together, gather up; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gathered’
glossary.σφέτερον: σφέτερος — their own; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄστυ
glossary.σφέων: σφεῖς — they, them (3rd-person pl. pron.); gen. pl., epic σφέων (= Attic σφῶν), possessive: ‘their’
glossary.σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
glossary.σφετέρῳ: σφέτερος — their own; possessive of the 3 pl.; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun
glossary.σφεων: σφεῖς — they; gen. pl. pron., epic σφεων (= Attic σφῶν, αὐτῶν): ’of them’
glossary.σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
glossary.σφοῖσιν: σφός — their own; possessive adj., masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.σχέτλια: σχέτλιος — cruel, dreadful, monstrous; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.σχέτλιοι: σχέτλιος — hard, reckless, wretched; adj., masc. nom. pl., in address: ’reckless ones!’
glossary.σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
glossary.σχετλίη: σχέτλιος — hard-hearted, headstrong, wretched; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), in address
glossary.σός: σός — your, yours; possessive adj. (of σύ), masc. nom. sg.: ’your’
glossary.σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
glossary.σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀμφί: ’around you’ · also acc. sg., object of θῆκεν with a predicate acc.: ’you’ (σὲ λέοντα … θῆκεν ’made you a lion’) · also acc. sg., object of ἑλκήσουσ’: ’you’ (σὲ … ἑλκήσουσ’ ’will drag you’)
glossary.σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
glossary.σῆμ: σῆμα — sign; mound, tomb; neut. acc. sg., elided (σῆμ’ = σῆμα)
glossary.σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’ · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’tomb’ (παρ’ Ἴλου σῆμα ’past the tomb of Ilus’) · σῆμα — sign, tomb; neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’tomb’ (σῆμα τετεύξεται ’a tomb will be made’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τορνώσαντο and χεύαντες: ’the tomb’ · also neut. acc. sg., after περί: ’round the tomb’ (περὶ σῆμα ’round the tomb’)
glossary.σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
glossary.σῖτον: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σῶμα: σῶμα — body, corpse; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
glossary.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
glossary.τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’ · also with a noun: ’these’ (τάδ’ ἔργα)
glossary.τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
glossary.τάρταρον: Τάρταρος — Tartarus, the pit beneath the earth and Hades; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τάφου: τάφος — burial, funeral rites; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
glossary.τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
glossary.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): partitive, ’of these’ · also governed by πρόσθ’: ’before these’ · also fem. gen. pl., antecedent of a relative: ’of those’ (τάων ἃς … ’of those which …’) · also relative, fem. gen. pl.: ’whose’ (τάων ἐν κονίῃσι ’in whose dust’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἠράσσατο: ’of them’
glossary.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated · also accented before the enclitic με (ὅς τέ με), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated
glossary.τέκ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., elided, unaugmented (τέκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore, begot’
glossary.τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
glossary.τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)
glossary.τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο): ’begot’, said of a father · also ’bore’, said of a mother
glossary.τέκτων: τέκτων — craftsman, worker in wood, horn or metal; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
glossary.τέξεσθαι: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; fut. inf. mid. (Attic τέξεσθαι), dependent on ἔμελλε: ’to bear’
glossary.τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’ · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun: ’a portent’
glossary.τέρεν: τέρην — tender, delicate; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυ: ’(a) tender (tear)’
glossary.τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl. (same form)
glossary.τέρπεται: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s pleasure, enjoy; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.τέρποντ: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight (+ dat.); pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (τέρποντ’ = τέρπονται): ’they take delight’
glossary.τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τέταρτον ’the fourth time’ · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
glossary.τέταται: τείνω — stretch; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is stretched out’
glossary.τέτατο: τείνω — stretch, extend; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
glossary.τέτρατον: τέταρτος — fourth; epic by-form τέτρατος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’the fourth time’
glossary.τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made ready, has come to pass’ · also with a predicate noun: ’has been made, has become’ (ταμίης τέτυκται ’has been made steward’)
glossary.τέχνην: τέχνη — craft, skill, cunning device; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τέχνης: τέχνη — craft, skill; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τέχνῃ: τέχνη — skill, craft, art; fem. dat. sg., dative of means
glossary.τέχνῃσι: τέχνη — skill, craft, cunning device; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic τέχναις): ’by (his) arts’
glossary.τήκετο: τήκω — melt, waste away; mid./pass. impf. 3 sg.: ’melted, dissolved (in tears)’
glossary.τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (τήν γε μάχην ’that battle’)
glossary.τήνδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (one); demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
glossary.τίεται: τίω — honour, esteem; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’is honoured’
glossary.τίκτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτικτε): ’bore, begot’ (of mother or father)
glossary.τίκτεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔτικτεν): ’begot’
glossary.τίμα: τιμάω — honour; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτίμα): ’was honouring’
glossary.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’ · also indefinite τίς with a noun, accented before an enclitic: ’some’ (κῆρύξ τίς … ’some herald’) · also indefinite τίς after εἰ, with ἄλλος: ’anyone (else)’ · also indefinite τίς + partitive gen.: ’some one (of the gods)’ (θεῶν τίς)
glossary.τίσαιτο: τίνυμαι — punish, exact payment from; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish: ’may he punish’
glossary.τίσιν: τίσις — retribution, requital, vengeance; fem. acc. sg., object of ἔδεισας: ’(fear) retribution’
glossary.ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; masc. gen. sg. (from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.ταρφέες: ταρφύς — thick, close-set, frequent; masc. nom. pl., epic -έες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ταύτην: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’her, this one’
glossary.ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with γενεῆς: ’of this’
glossary.ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they, those two’
glossary.ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
glossary.ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic · also elided ταῦτ’
glossary.ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
glossary.τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
glossary.τεθαλυῖαν: θάλλω — bloom, thrive, swell; perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ’thriving, flourishing’ (masc. τεθηλώς)
glossary.τεκμαίρεται: τεκμαίρομαι — fix, appoint (from τέκμωρ ’fixed end’); pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’fixes’
glossary.τεκοῦσα: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having borne’
glossary.τελέεσθαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. inf. pass./mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖσθαι): ’to be fulfilled’
glossary.τελέθουσιν: τελέθω — be, come to be, prove (poetic, = εἰμί, γίγνομαι); pres. 3 pl. act.: ’are, prove’
glossary.τελέσαιμι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass; aor. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ’I could accomplish’
glossary.τελέσῃ: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a fear clause after δείδω μή: ’lest he fulfil’
glossary.τελεσφόρον: τελεσφόρος — bringing to completion, full (of a year’s cycle); adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τελευτὴ: τελευτή — end, fulfilment, death; fem. nom. sg.: βιότοιο τελευτή ’the end of life’
glossary.τελευτὴν: τελευτή — end, completion, conclusion; acc. sg. (τελευτὴν ποιῆσαι ’to bring to an end’)
glossary.τερμιόεντα: τερμιόεις — with a border or fringe (τέρμα ’end, edge’; exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τερπικέραυνον: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt; epithet of Zeus, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τεσσαράκοντα: τεσσαράκοντα — forty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic τετταράκοντα)
glossary.τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἦεν: ’would have been fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἐστίν: ’is a thing to be fulfilled’
glossary.τετεύχατο: τεύχω — make, build; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἦσαν τετευγμέναι): ’had been made’
glossary.τετιημένη: τετίημαι — be distressed, be worn down with grief (defective verb, only perf./plup.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τετραμμένος: τρέπω — turn; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned himself’
glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
glossary.τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
glossary.τεύχει: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; pres. 3 sg.: ’brings about’
glossary.τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.τεύχων: τεύχω — make, fashion; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’making’
glossary.τεὴν: τεός — your, thy (epic = Attic σός); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with φθόγγον: ’your’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦτορ: ’your’ (τεὸν ἦτορ ’your heart’)
glossary.τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
glossary.τεῦξε: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευξε)
glossary.τεῷ: τεός — your (sg.); epic possessive (= σός), masc. dat. sg., agreeing with κόλπῳ
glossary.τηθύν: Τηθύς — Tethys, wife of Oceanus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
glossary.τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
glossary.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν after δή: ’some (evil)’ (δή τι κακόν ’some evil’)
glossary.τιμήν: τιμή — honour, esteem; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic τιμήν)
glossary.τιμὴ: τιμή — honour, standing, esteem; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, esteem; fem. acc. sg. · also requital, satisfaction for a wrong: ’redress’
glossary.τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg., partitive after ἔμμορε · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of the thing needed, after χρεώ: ’of honour’ (ταύτης χρεὼ τιμῆς ’need of this honour’) · also fem. gen. sg., with ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of honour’ (ἐμῆς ἕνεκ’ … τιμῆς) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of what one is lord of, after ἀνάσσω: ’of the honour’ (τιμῆς τῆς Πριάμου ’of the honour of Priam’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of μέμνησαι, with its relative ἧς: ’(remember) the honour’
glossary.τιμῶσι: τιμάω — honour, value; pres. 3 pl. act., contracted (-άουσι > -ῶσι)
glossary.τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
glossary.τινάσσετο: τινάσσω — shake; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐτινάσσετο): ’shook’, of a helmet
glossary.τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
glossary.τινι: τις, τι — someone, anyone; indef. pron., masc. dat. sg., enclitic: οὔ τινι ’in no one’
glossary.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
glossary.τιτῆνες: Τιτῆνες — the Titans, the older gods under Tartarus; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’) · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, with γε: ’they’
glossary.τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.: ’such a one’
glossary.τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
glossary.τοκεῦσι: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τοκεῦσιν: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.τοκῆας: τοκεύς — parent; masc. acc. pl., usually plural: ’parents’
glossary.τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’of this man’
glossary.τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of these’
glossary.τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τοὔνεκ: τοὔνεκα — for that reason, on that account (τοῦ ἕνεκα); adv., elided (τοὔνεκ’)
glossary.τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic οἱ · also accented before the enclitic μιν (τοὔνεκά μιν κάλεον ’for that reason they called him’) · also accented before the enclitic τοι: ’for that reason (I tell you)’
glossary.τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
glossary.τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’) · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὶ δ’ ἐλατῆρες ’and the drivers’)
glossary.τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
glossary.τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’ · also masc. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that (old man)’ · also plain possessive gen.: ’his’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἀπό, of separation: ’from him’ (ἀπὸ τοῖο ’from him’) · also masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄνευθεν: ’apart from him’ (τοῖο δ’ ἄνευθεν) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation after ἀπέχω: ’from him’
glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
glossary.τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
glossary.τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’) · also masc. dat. pl. with a noun, demonstrative: ’these’ (τοῖς ἵπποισιν ’these horses’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl., + ἐπεποίθει: ’in whom’ (τοῖς ἐπεποίθει ’whom he trusted’) · also relative, dat. pl. of means, referring to neuter things: ’with which’ (τοῖς ἐπονεῖτο ’with which he toiled’)
glossary.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’) · also neut. dat. pl. of things, after ἐπί: ’besides these, on top of these’
glossary.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl.: ’against whom’ (τοῖσιν κότον ἔθεσθε ’against whom you conceived resentment’) · also neut. dat. pl., of things: ’with these’ · also masc. dat. pl., of advantage: ’for them’ (τοῖσιν … ζεῦξ’ ’yoked for them’)
glossary.τοῖχον: τοῖχος — wall (of a room or house); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοῖό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ), accented before the enclitic τε: ’his’
glossary.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’) · also masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἑλκομένοιο: ’as he was dragged’ (τοῦ δ’ ἦν ἑλκομένοιο κονίσαλος) · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, after ἑκάτερθεν: ’of it’ (τοῦ ἑκάτερθεν ’on either side of it’) · also neut. gen. sg., of comparison: ’than it’ (τοῦ … μελάντερον ’blacker than it’) · also neut. gen. sg., governed by εἵνεκα: ’for the sake of this’
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο): ’this’
glossary.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τοῦτο ἔπος ’this word’)
glossary.τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
glossary.τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’this’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἄνωγας, accented before the enclitic μ’: ’this’
glossary.τρέε: τρέω — tremble, flee in fear; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic τρεῖ): ’be afraid’
glossary.τρέπεται: τρέπω — turn; pass. be turned, changed; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’turns, is changed’
glossary.τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, feed; pres. 3 sg. act., of land or woodland that breeds creatures · also of a man rearing a plant: ’rears’ (ἔρνος … τρέφει)
glossary.τρέψας: τρέπω — turn; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned’
glossary.τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
glossary.τρίποδι: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό: ’under the tripod’
glossary.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; neut. acc. sg., adverbial with the article (τὸ τρίτον): ’the third time’
glossary.τρίτων: τρίτος — third; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the third’
glossary.τρίτῳ: τρίτος — third; ordinal, masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’on the third (day)’
glossary.τρίχες: θρίξ — hair; fem. nom. pl. (stem τριχ-)
glossary.τραφέμεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; intr. aor. inf. τραφέμεν, epic -έμεν (= Attic τραφῆναι): ’to grow up, be reared’
glossary.τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same form)
glossary.τρητοῖο: τρητός — pierced, bored through; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οῖο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.τρηχὺς: τρηχύς — rough, harsh; masc. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic τραχύς)
glossary.τριπόλῳ: τρίπολος — thrice-ploughed, ploughed three times; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νειῷ
glossary.τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
glossary.τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
glossary.τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μ’ (a girl): ’small’ (τυτθὸν ἐοῦσαν ’while I was small’)
glossary.τυτθὸς: τυτθός — small, little; masc. nom. sg., epic
glossary.τυφωέος: Τυφωεύς — Typhoeus, a monster; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’) · also neut. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸ μὲν … τὸ δέ: ’one thing … another’
glossary.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
glossary.τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
glossary.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
glossary.τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
glossary.τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
glossary.τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; masc. nom. pl., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτοι)
glossary.τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’so great’ (τόσσον μένος) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’so long’ (τόσσον χρόνον ὅσσον ’for as long as’)
glossary.τόσσος: τόσος — so great, so much; masc. nom. sg., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτος)
glossary.τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
glossary.τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
glossary.τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)
glossary.τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
glossary.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · ὁ, ἡ, τό — relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which, that’ (τὰ … πεφύκει ’that had grown’)
glossary.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
glossary.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’ · also fem. acc. sg. as a demonstrative for a feminine thing, object of ἔχων: ’this, it’ (τὴν … ἔχων ’holding it’)
glossary.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
glossary.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
glossary.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
glossary.τὼς: τώς — thus, so; epic adv. (= Attic οὕτως)
glossary.τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
glossary.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
glossary.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’) · also fem. dat. sg. relative of possession, with περ: ’she whose’ (τῇ περ … παῖδες ὄλοντο ’she whose children perished’)
glossary.τῇδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative adj., fem. dat. sg. τῇδε, elided (τῇδ’): ’with this’ · also adverbial, fem. dat. sg.: ’in this way’ (τῇδ’ εἴη ’so be it’)
glossary.τῇσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ταῖς): ’to them, among them’
glossary.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’) · also gen. pl., referring to the lands named: ’among these’ (τῶν σε … κεκάσθαι)
glossary.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’) · also neut. dat. sg., object of πίσυνος: ’trusting in it’
glossary.υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἱέες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.υἱέι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic stem υἱε- (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg. · also nom. sg., subject: ’the drug’ (φάρμακον οὐλόμενον … ἔφυσε)
glossary.φάσκε: φάσκω — say, claim, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφασκε)
glossary.φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = ἔφατο): ’said’
glossary.φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
glossary.φέρει: φέρω — bear, carry; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’carries’
glossary.φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.
glossary.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry, bear; mid. carry for oneself, take along; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry (with oneself)’ · also pres. inf. mid./pass. of purpose: ’to be carried’ (φέρεσθαι ’to be borne away’)
glossary.φέρετ: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (φέρετ’ = φέρετε): ’carry!’
glossary.φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might bring’ (ἵν’ … φέροι ’so that she might bring’) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in an indefinite relative clause (ὅς τις … φέροι): ’whoever might carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. with κε, potential in a past unfulfilled condition: ’would have carried off’
glossary.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
glossary.φέρουσά: Φέρουσα — Pherusa (’Bearer’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. act., fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
glossary.φέρουσαι: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’bearing’, ’bearing off’
glossary.φέρτατός: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
glossary.φήμην: φήμη — voice, a chance utterance taken as an omen; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα) · also masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε): ’dear’
glossary.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’own, dear’ (φίλα γούνατα ’my own knees’) · also neut. acc. pl., predicate: ’dear, pleasing’ (φίλα ἀγορεύεις ’say pleasing things’)
glossary.φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
glossary.φίλοισιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις); also as a noun: ’friends’
glossary.φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
glossary.φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
glossary.φίλου: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός
glossary.φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, friends’
glossary.φίλτεροι: φίλος — dear; masc. nom. pl. comparative (φίλτερος), followed by ἢ: ’dearer than’
glossary.φίλῃ: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φίλῃσιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φαέθων: φαέθων — shining, radiant; part. adj. (φαίνω), masc. nom. sg., epithet of the sun
glossary.φαίδιμα: φαίδιμος — shining, splendid (of limbs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.φαίδιμον: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φαίνονται: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, show oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’appear’
glossary.φαεσιμβρότου: φαεσίμβροτος — light-giving to mortals (φάος + βροτός); adj., masc. gen. sg., epic gen. in -ου, with Ἠελίοιο
glossary.φανεῖσα: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. 2 pass. part., fem. nom. sg.: ’appearing, having appeared’
glossary.φανῇ: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear, shine; aor. subj. 3 sg. pass. (ἐφάνην), after ἐπεί κε: ’appears’
glossary.φασι: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. act. (= Attic φασί)
glossary.φασιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl., enclitic: ’they say’ (+ acc. and inf.)
glossary.φαῖνε: φαίνω — show, reveal, bring to light; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφαινε)
glossary.φείδεο: φείδομαι — spare (+ gen.); pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φείδου)
glossary.φειδώ: φειδώ — sparing, restraint, mercy; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φερέμεν: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φέρειν)
glossary.φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φθάμενος: φθάνω — come first, forestall; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φθάς): ’getting in first’
glossary.φθέγξατο: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, call out, speak; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’called out’
glossary.φθείρουσι: φθείρω — ruin, destroy, waste; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.φθινόντων: φθίνω — waste away, wane, dwindle; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’waning’
glossary.φιλέοι: φιλέω — love, treat kindly, entertain; pres. opt. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῖ), in an indirect question: ’whether he would welcome’
glossary.φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
glossary.φιλεῖν: φιλέω — love, treat with kindness, entertain; pres. inf. act.
glossary.φιλομμειδὴς: φιλομμειδής — smile-loving (φιλο- + μειδάω ’smile’); fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Aphrodite
glossary.φιλότητά: φιλότης — friendship, affection; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φιλότητα: φιλότης — friendship, love, kindness; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
glossary.φιλότητος: φιλότης — friendship, love; fem. gen. sg.

glossary.χάρις: χάρις — grace, favour, gratitude, thanks; fem. nom. sg. · also Χάρις — Charis, wife of Hephaestus; fem. nom. sg.

glossary.χαίρετε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’greetings! welcome!’
glossary.χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’

glossary.χαλεπὴν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλεπῆς: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.χαλεπῶς: χαλεπῶς — with difficulty, hardly; adv. from χαλεπός
glossary.χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg. · also Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg. · also χαλκίς — a bird, the gods’ name for it; fem. acc. sg., object of κικλήσκουσι
glossary.χαλκείας: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. acc. pl. (= Attic χαλκᾶς), as a noun-adjective with πτύχας understood

glossary.χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.

glossary.χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’gratifying, pleasing’

glossary.χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
glossary.χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δώματα: ’golden’

glossary.χρὼς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. acc. sg.

glossary.ψεύδεα: ψεῦδος — lie, falsehood; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ψεύδη)

glossary.ψυχρὴ: ψυχρός — cold; adj., fem. nom. sg.

glossary.ἀγέλας: ἀγέλη — herd (of cattle); fem. acc. pl.: ’herds’
glossary.ἀγέραστος: ἀγέραστος — without a prize of honour; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγήνορα: Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan, son of Antenor; masc. acc. sg. (the adj. ἀγήνωρ means ’manly, proud’)
glossary.ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg. · also the proper name Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγήρω: ἀγήρως — ageless, never growing old; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἀγαγὼν: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having led’

glossary.ἀγαθοῖο: ἀγαθός — good, noble; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀγαθοῖσι: ἀγαθός — good; neut. dat. pl. as noun: ’good things’, epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also masc. dat. pl. as noun: ’the good (men of rank)’ (τοῖς ἀγαθοῖσι ’for the good’)
glossary.ἀγαθοῦ: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; masc. gen. sg., substantive: ’of the brave man’ · also masc. gen. sg., adj. agreeing with πατρός: ’good (father)’
glossary.ἀγαθόν: ἀγαθός — good; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδ’ (βίην acc. of respect: ’good in strength’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’(for) good’ (εἰς ἀγαθόν ’for good’)
glossary.ἀγαθὴ: ἀγαθός — good; adj., fem. nom. sg., predicate, agreeing with παραίφασις
glossary.ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαλλόμεναι: ἀγάλλω — glorify; mid. exult, glory (in); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’exulting’ (+ dat., in something)
glossary.ἀγαυοί: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγαυὴ: Ἀγαυή — Agave (’Noble’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg. (from ἀγαυός)
glossary.ἀγαυῶν: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγελείης: ἀγελείη — driver of spoil, spoil-bringer (epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg., epic (= ἀγελείας)
glossary.ἀγκυλομήτης: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Cronus
glossary.ἀγλαΐην: ἀγλαΐη — splendour, beauty (from ἀγλαός); fem. acc. sg.

glossary.ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’splendid (son)’
glossary.ἀγορέων: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν)

glossary.ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, address, say; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’speaking’
glossary.ἀγορεῦσαι: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, proclaim; aor. inf.: ’to speak, to tell’
glossary.ἀγορῆς: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; fem. gen. sg.
