glossary.ἀγρομένοισιν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. mid. part., syncopated (ἀγρόμενος), masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’gathered’
glossary.ἀγῶνα: ἀγών — gathering, assembly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγῶνι: ἀγών — gathering, place of assembly; masc. dat. sg., of place with ἐν
glossary.ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀεθλεύωσιν: ἀεθλεύω — contend (for a prize), compete; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., epic ἀε- (= Attic ἀθλεύωσι), ν-movable, in a purpose clause
glossary.ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl. · also fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with λώβην: ’unseemly (insult)’
glossary.ἀεργὸν: ἀεργός — idle, not working; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀεργὸς: ἀεργός — idle, not working; masc. nom. sg. (Attic ἀργός)
glossary.ἀεῖραι: αἴρω — lift, raise; aor. inf. act., epic ἀεῖραι (= Attic ἆραι): ’to raise’
glossary.ἀθάνατοί: ἀθάνατος — immortal; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’the immortals’ (accent from the enclitic περ) · also adj., masc. nom. pl., predicate, accent from the enclitic τε: ’immortal’ (ἀθάνατοί τε γάρ εἰσι ’for they are immortal’)
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀθάνατον: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc./fem. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθάνατος: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθέσφατον: ἀθέσφατος — immense, prodigious (sense of the word debated); adj., masc. acc. sg., with ὄμβρον
glossary.ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθήνης: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
glossary.ἀθανάτοιο: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀθανάτοις: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. dat. pl., also as a noun: ’(to) the immortals’
glossary.ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτους: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. acc. pl., substantival: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’) · also gen. pl. as a noun, predicate possessive: ’of the immortals’ (ἔργ’ ἔμεν ἀθανάτων ’to be works of the immortals’)
glossary.ἀθανάτῃς: ἀθάνατος — immortal; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= -ῃσι(ν), Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
glossary.ἀιδρείῃσι: ἀιδρείη — ignorance, want of knowledge; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’in ignorance’
glossary.ἀκάκητα: ἀκάκητα — epithet of Hermes, meaning disputed (’kindly, not harming’ or ’giver of ease’); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
glossary.ἀκάμαντι: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Thracian leader; masc. dat. sg. · also ἀκάμας — untiring, tireless; adj., masc. dat. sg., epithet of a river-god: ’the untiring’
glossary.ἀκήριοι: ἀκήριος — spiritless, lifeless (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is taken from the context, and another word of the same shape means ’unscathed’, from κήρ ’doom’); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκαχήμενος: ἀχέω (ἀκαχίζω) — distress, grieve; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved, distressed’
glossary.ἀκηδέα: ἀκηδής — uncared for, neglected; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= ἀκηδῆ) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with an object: ’uncared-for (armour)’
glossary.ἀκούσαντες: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of the thing heard); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having heard’
glossary.ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’listening’
glossary.ἀκροτάτης: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superl. ἀκρότατος, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κόρυθος: ’the very top (of the helmet)’ · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with πόλιος: ’topmost’ (κατ’ ἀκροτάτης πόλιος ’down from the top of the city’)
glossary.ἀκροτάτῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superlative ἀκρότατος, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with κορυφῇ · also fem. dat. sg., with a noun understood: ’on the topmost (part)’ (ἐπ’ ἀκροτάτῃ ’on the very top’) · also fem. dat. sg., agreeing with πόλει: ’topmost’ (ἐν πόλει ἀκροτάτῃ ’in the topmost part of the city’)
glossary.ἀκροτάτῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superl. ἀκρότατος, masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκτήν: ἀκτή — coarsely ground grain, meal; fem. acc. sg. (a different word from ἀκτή ’shore’)
glossary.ἀκτίνεσσιν: ἀκτίς — ray, beam; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι), dat. of likeness after ἔοικα: ’like rays’
glossary.ἀκταίη: Ἀκταίη — Actaea (’Of the Shore’), a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκτὴν: ἀκτή — grain, ground corn (Δημήτερος ἀκτή ’Demeter’s grain’); fem. acc. sg. · also ἀκτή — headland, shore; fem. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’onto the shore’
glossary.ἀλάληται: ἀλάομαι — wander, rove; perf. 3 sg. mid./dep. with pres. sense: ‘is wandering’
glossary.ἀλέασθαι: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid. ἀλέασθαι (Attic φυγεῖν, ἐκκλίνειν)
glossary.ἀλέγοντες: ἀλέγω — heed, care for (+ acc.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., with οὐκ: ’paying no heed to’
glossary.ἀλίαστον: ἀλίαστος — unceasing, relentless (rare; sense traditional); adj., acc. sg. · also adverbial acc. sg.: ’relentlessly’
glossary.ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
glossary.ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., predicate with σθένος
glossary.ἀλεγίζω: ἀλεγίζω — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., usually with a negative
glossary.ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
glossary.ἀλεωρήν: ἀλεωρή — protection, defence; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to the stakes: ’a defence’
glossary.ἀλεύασθαι: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid., epic ἀλεύομαι stem
glossary.ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀληθῆ), as a noun: ’the truth’
glossary.ἀληθείην: ἀλήθεια — truth; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic ἀληθείη)
glossary.ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist, might; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλκμήνη: Ἀλκμήνη — Alcmene, mother of Heracles; fem. nom. sg., subject of τέξεσθαι
glossary.ἀλκμήνης: Ἀλκμήνη — Alcmene, mother of Heracles; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ης)
glossary.ἀλκὴ: ἀλκή — might, strength to resist, defence; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
glossary.ἀλλήλας: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλλήλοις: ἀλλήλων — one another, each other; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl.: ’at one another’ · also masc. dat. pl., of exchange: ’with one another’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
glossary.ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’) · also gen. pl. as object of ἐφικνέομαι: ’of one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἐφίκοντο ’got hold of one another’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἤμβροτον: ’one another’ (ἤμβροτον ἀλλήλων ’missed one another’) · also gen. pl., object of λαβέτην (partitive, with ἀγκάς): ’each other’ · also gen. pl., object of πειράομαι: ’of one another’ (ἀλλήλων … πειρηθῆναι ’to make trial of one another’)
glossary.ἀλλήλῃσιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.ἀλλοτρίων: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, not one’s own; gen. pl. (any gender): ’of others’
glossary.ἀλλότριον: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, another’s; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλφηστῇσιν: ἀλφηστής — bread-eating (of mortal men); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀλωῇ: ἀλωή — plot, orchard, vineyard; threshing-floor (= ἅλως); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμέγαρτον: ἀμέγαρτος — unenviable, wretched, dreadful; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμήχανον: ἀμήχανος — impossible to manage, intractable; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλλο: ’another impossible (task)’
glossary.ἀμαιμάκετον: ἀμαιμάκετος — huge (sense uncertain; ‘huge’ and ‘irresistible’ are the guesses); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστόν
glossary.ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν), agreeing with νύκτα: ’immortal’ · also noun ἀμβροσίη, fem. acc. sg.: ’ambrosia’ (food of the gods)
glossary.ἀμβροσίης: ἀμβροσία — ambrosia, the gods’ food; fem. gen. sg. (partitive, with πλήσασα): ’filled with ambrosia’ · also gen. of source after ἀπορρώξ: ’a trickle of ambrosia’
glossary.ἀμβροσίῃ: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the divine substance of the gods; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), instrumental: ’with ambrosia’
glossary.ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠμείβετο)
glossary.ἀμείνω: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); fem. acc. sg., contracted from ἀμείνονα, with ὀμίχλην · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’better’
glossary.ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός · also fem. nom. sg., predicate of φιλοφροσύνη: ’better’
glossary.ἀμειβόμεναι: ἀμείβομαι — answer in turn, take turns; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’answering one another’
glossary.ἀμηχανίη: ἀμηχανία — helplessness, despair; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.ἀμοιβήν: ἀμοιβή — requital, recompense; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)
glossary.ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it · also adv. in tmesis with ἕπον: ’around’ (ἀμφί … ἕπον ’dressed’)
glossary.ἀμφεκάλυψε: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round, enfold, enclose, shelter; aor. 3 sg. act. (ἀμφί + καλύπτω)
glossary.ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιδάμαντος: Ἀμφιδάμας — Amphidamas, father of a boy killed by Patroclus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψῃ: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἐπήν · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after μηδ’, continuing a condition or wish: ’and may he not cover’
glossary.ἀμφιπολεύειν: ἀμφιπολεύω — attend, serve; pres. inf. of purpose: ’to serve’ · also pres. inf. defining ἀδαημονίη: ’in tending’ (ἀδαημονίη σ’ ἔχει ἀμφιπολεύειν)
glossary.ἀμφιτρίτη: Ἀμφιτρίτη — Amphitrite, Poseidon’s consort; nom. sg.; by extension, standing for the sea and its creatures generally
glossary.ἀμφιτρίτης: Ἀμφιτρίτη — Amphitrite, a sea-goddess, sometimes standing for the sea itself; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also dat. of interest: ’for both’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρωθεν: ἀμφότερος — both; adv. with suffix -θεν: ’on both sides’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
glossary.ἀμφότεροι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
glossary.ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
glossary.ἀμύμονά: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent; adj., masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along, through; prep. + acc.: ’up through, throughout’
glossary.ἀνάγκης: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. gen. sg.: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the lords’
glossary.ἀνάξειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); fut. inf. act., after ἦ μέν in an oath: ’that he shall rule’ · also + gen. of what one is lord of, with dat. of the people: ’to be lord (of)’ (Τρώεσσιν ἀνάξειν … τιμῆς ’to be lord among the Trojans of the honour’)
glossary.ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. inf.: ’to rule over’ · also + gen.: ’to rule over’ (Ἰλίου … ἀνάσσειν ’to rule over Ilium’)
glossary.ἀνάσσων: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’ruling’
glossary.ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνέμοισι: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνέρα: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀνέρα (= Attic ἄνδρα)
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες) · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’men!’
glossary.ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; masc. dat. sg., epic ἀνέρ- stem (= Attic ἀνδρί)
glossary.ἀνήγαγον: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring back; 2nd aor. 1 sg. (or 3 pl.) act.: ’I brought back’
glossary.ἀνήκεστον: ἀνήκεστος — incurable, past healing (ἀ- + ἀκέομαι ’heal’); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνήνορα: ἀνήνωρ — unmanly, spiritless, without manhood; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνίην: ἀνίη — distress, trouble; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic ἀνία), in apposition
glossary.ἀνίπτοισιν: ἄνιπτος — unwashed; adj. (2-term.), fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀναίτιος: ἀναίτιος — blameless, guiltless; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναιδέα: ἀναιδής — ruthless, shameless; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.ἀνδροκτασίας: ἀνδροκτασία — man-slaying, slaughter in battle; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνείλετο: ἀναιρέω — take up, pick up; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up’
glossary.ἀνελόντα: ἀναιρέω — take up, pick up; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having taken up’
glossary.ἀνεφαίνετο: ἀναφαίνομαι — show up, appear, come into view; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was coming into view’
glossary.ἀνθρώποις: ἄνθρωπος — human being; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνθρώπου: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. sg.: ’of a man’
glossary.ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀνιστάμενος: ἀνίστημι — raise up; mid. ’stand up, rise’; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνιόντα: ἄνειμι — come back, go up; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’coming back’
glossary.ἀνιὼν: ἄνειμι — go back, come back, return; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντία: ἀντίος — opposite, against; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, + gen.
glossary.ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
glossary.ἀντιβολῆσαι: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. inf. act.: ’to meet’ · also ἀντιβολέω, the person met in the dative μοι (which may instead go with ἧκεν): ’to meet (me)’ (ὅς μοι … ἀντιβολῆσαι)
glossary.ἀντιφερίζειν: ἀντιφερίζω — vie with, match oneself against (+ dat.); pres. inf. act.
glossary.ἀντὶ: ἀντί — instead of, in place of; prep. + gen., placed after its noun
glossary.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
glossary.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ θυμόν: ’in the heart, in the mind’ · also + acc. of extent: ’along’ (ἀνὰ δρόμον ’along the course’)
glossary.ἀοιδοὶ: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀοιδὸν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀοιδὸς: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
glossary.ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
glossary.ἀπάτην: ἀπάτη — deceit, trick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπέσσυτο: ἀποσεύομαι — rush away, dart off; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σ (Attic would be ἀπεσεύθη): ’rushed away’
glossary.ἀπέχειν: ἀπέχω — hold off, keep away; pres. inf. act., with imperative force, + gen.: ’keep away from’
glossary.ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also of a thing, bringing no harm: ’harmless’ (μῦθος ἀπήμων ’harmless word’)
glossary.ἀπανήνασθαι: ἀπαναίνομαι — refuse, reject, decline; aor. inf. mid. (+ acc.), standing for an imperative after μηκέτι
glossary.ἀπείριτος: ἀπείριτος — limitless, boundless (ἀ- + πεῖραρ ’limit’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; masc. acc. sg., epithet of the sea · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with γαῖαν: ’boundless (earth)’
glossary.ἀπείρων: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἄπειρος)
glossary.ἀπελάμπετο: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. mid. with active sense, augmented: ’shone forth’
glossary.ἀπεμνήσαντο: ἀπομιμνήσκομαι — remember, bear in mind (ἀπο- perhaps ’in return’); aor. 3 pl. mid. (augment inside the compound): ’they remembered’
glossary.ἀπεόντος: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ἀπεόντος (= Attic ἀπόντος), agreeing with ἐμεῖο
glossary.ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
glossary.ἀποαίνυται: ἀπαίνυμαι (ἀποαίνυμαι) — take away, rob of (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀποδοῦναι: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, give up; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἀποθέσθαι: ἀποτίθημι — put away, lay down; aor. inf. mid.: ’to lay down (one’s own)’
glossary.ἀποπέμπειν: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀποπνείουσα: ἀποπνέω — breathe out, blow forth; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic -πνείουσα (= Attic ἀποπνέουσα): ’breathing out’

glossary.ἀποτίσῃ: ἀποτίνω — pay back, atone for; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’he may pay for’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a condition with αἴ κε: ’he pays for’
glossary.ἀποτμήξας: ἀποτμήγω — cut off, sever; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀποτεμών): ’having cut off’
glossary.ἀποφθιμένου: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg.: ’dead’
glossary.ἀποφθινύθουσι: ἀποφθινύθω — perish, waste away; pres. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ἀποφθίνουσι): ’are dying off’ · also transitive, with θυμόν: ’waste away (their life)’ (θυμὸν ἀποφθινύθουσι ’are wasting their lives away’)
glossary.ἀπόλλυται: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’perishes’

glossary.ἀπόπροθι: ἀπόπροθι — far off, at a distance; adv.
glossary.ἀπώλεσεν: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented after the preverb, with ν-movable (= ἀπώλεσε): ’destroyed’
glossary.ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’) · also + a form in -θεν, ablatival: ’from’ (ἀπὸ Τροίηθεν ’from Troy’)
glossary.ἀράχνια: ἀράχνιον — cobweb, spider’s web; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρέσθαι: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. mid. inf. (2nd aor. ἀρόμην): ’to win’
glossary.ἀρίζηλον: ἀρίζηλος — conspicuous, very clear; masc. acc. sg., predicate with θῆκεν: ’conspicuous’
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.

glossary.ἀρίστω: ἄριστος — best; masc. acc. dual, in agreement with ἀνέρε: ’two best’ · also masc. nom. dual, in agreement with ἀνέρε: ’two best’
glossary.ἀργέτι: ἀργής — bright, white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., epic ἀργέτι (= ἀργῆτι), agreeing with δημῷ: ’white (fat)’
glossary.ἀργαλέη: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α), predicate

glossary.ἀργαλέος: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀργαλέου: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, hard; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’grievous’
glossary.ἀργαλέων: ἀργαλέος — grievous, harsh, troublesome; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀργαλέῃ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντην: Ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, traditionally ’slayer of Argus’ though the sense is disputed; masc. acc. sg.

glossary.ἀργυρέῳ: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυρῷ), of a silver bowl
glossary.ἀργυροδίνην: ἀργυροδίνης — silver-eddying; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ποταμόν
glossary.ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, of silver; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν), agreeing with a neuter noun · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τελαμῶνα: ’silver’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα: ’silver’
glossary.ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρετὴ: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is enjoyed after ἀπονήσεται · also fem. gen. sg., object of μιμνήσκεο: ’(be mindful) of excellence’
glossary.ἀρηρώς: ἀραρίσκω — fit; perf. part. ἀρηρώς masc. nom. sg., intransitive: ’fitted, firm’, with dat.
glossary.ἀρθεὶς: ἀείρω (αἴρω) — lift, raise; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having risen, mounted up’
glossary.ἀριάδνην: Ἀριάδνη — Ariadne, daughter of Minos; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀριδείκετον: ἀριδείκετος — very conspicuous, most distinguished; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Περσῆα
glossary.ἀρχόμενος: ἄρχω — lead, rule; mid. ἄρχομαι begin (+ gen.); pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’beginning from’
glossary.ἀρχῆς: ἀρχή — beginning, origin; fem. gen. sg., after ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of the beginning (of the trouble)’
glossary.ἀρῆς: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. gen. sg. · also ἀρά — prayer (also curse, by context); fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀρᾶς)
glossary.ἀσκήσας: ἀσκέω — work skilfully, fashion with art; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having worked with skill’
glossary.ἀστεμφέως: ἀστεμφέως — unyieldingly, unflinchingly, without wavering; adv.
glossary.ἀστεροπητὴς: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἀστεροπῇ: ἀστεροπή — lightning, flash (Attic ἀστραπή); fem. dat. sg., after ἐναλίγκιος
glossary.ἀστερόεντα: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. acc. sg., with οὐρανόν
glossary.ἀστερόεντος: ἀστερόεις — starry, star-spangled; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with οὐρανοῦ
glossary.ἀστράπτων: ἀστράπτω — flash lightning; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’flashing lightning’
glossary.ἀσφαλέως: ἀσφαλής — safe, sure, steady; adv. ἀσφαλέως: ’steadily, unfalteringly’
glossary.ἀσφαλὲς: ἀσφαλής — unshaken, secure; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’securely’
glossary.ἀτάσθαλα: ἀτάσθαλος — reckless, wanton, arrogant; adj., neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’wanton things’
glossary.ἀτάσθαλον: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless, presumptuous; adj. of two endings, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀνέρα: ’wanton’ (ἀνέρα … ἀτάσθαλον ’a wanton man’)
glossary.ἀταλὰ: ἀταλός — tender, playful, childlike; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with φρονέω
glossary.ἀτασθαλίας: ἀτασθαλία — reckless wickedness, wanton folly; fem. acc. pl. (also gen. sg.), after διά: ’through’
glossary.ἀτερπέα: ἀτερπής — joyless, unpleasant; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμήσουσι: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, hold in contempt; fut. 3 pl. act. (ἀτιμήσουσι(ν), ν-movable)
glossary.ἀτιταλλέμεναί: ἀτιτάλλω — rear, nurse; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀτιτάλλειν), as an imperative: ’rear (them)!’
glossary.ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, barren (epithet of the sea; meaning uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρύγετον: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, barren (epithet of the sea; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀυτμὴ: ἀυτμή — breath, blast, hot breath; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ῥῆξε … ἀφ’ ’broke off’)
glossary.ἀφίκεσθε: ἀφικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’come at’
glossary.ἀφίκετο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀφείλετο: ἀφαιρέω — take away, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented; gnomic in a general statement: ’takes away’
glossary.ἀφνειοὶ: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀφνειὸν: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’rich (house)’
glossary.ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφραδίῃς: ἀφραδίη — thoughtlessness, folly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= -ῃσι, Attic -αις): ’through folly’
glossary.ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφροδίτην: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀφρῷ: ἀφρός — foam; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with foam’
glossary.ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’you Achaeans’
glossary.ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω: ’grieving’
glossary.ἀχιλλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
glossary.ἀχνύμενοι: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, sorrow; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀψορρόου: ἀψόρροος — back-flowing; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀψόρρου)
glossary.ἀὴρ: ἀήρ — mist, haze (in Homer; later ’air’); fem. nom. sg., feminine in Homer
glossary.ἀῆται: ἀήτης — blast, gust of wind; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
glossary.ἁμάρτῃ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, err, do wrong; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅτε κέν: ’has erred’
glossary.ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. gen. pl., of comparison after προβέβηκας: ’beyond all’ · also partitive gen. after a superlative: ’of all’ (νεώτατος ἁπάντων ’youngest of all’) · also gen. after προμάχεσθαι: ’ahead of all’
glossary.ἁπασέων: ἅπας — all, the whole; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’ · also ἂμ before φ, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂμ φόνον ’up through the slaughter’)
glossary.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
glossary.ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
glossary.ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. acc. pl.: ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ φρονέων ’thinking his own thoughts’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (ἃ … τετελεσμένα ἦεν ’things that had been fulfilled’)
glossary.ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
glossary.ἄαπτοι: ἄαπτος — irresistible, invincible (sense and origin uncertain); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with χεῖρες
glossary.ἄγγεσιν: ἄγγος — vessel, jar, container; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.ἄγειραν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble, muster; aor. 3 pl.: ’they gathered’
glossary.ἄγεσθαι: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry off for oneself’
glossary.ἄγκεα: ἄγκος — glen, valley, mountain-hollow; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγοντα: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’leading, bringing’
glossary.ἄγραυλοι: ἄγραυλος — living in the fields, out in the pasture; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγρην: ἄγρη — hunting, game, catch; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγριον: ἄγριος — wild, savage; adj., acc. sg., with αἶγα · also masc. acc. sg., with αἰχμητήν: ’wild (spearman)’
glossary.ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι): ’near Ajax’
glossary.ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, take; pres. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε (future-like): ’I shall lead’
glossary.ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
glossary.ἄγωσι: ἄγω — lead, drive; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.ἄεθλα: ἄεθλον — prize, contest; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἆθλα): ’prizes’
glossary.ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), subject: τόδε φαίνετ’ ἄεθλον ’this contest appears’
glossary.ἄεθλος: ἄεθλος — contest, struggle for a prize; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἆθλος)
glossary.ἄειδον: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic ἄειδον (= Attic ᾖδον)
glossary.ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄκουε: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’listen!’
glossary.ἄκρη: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἄκρα): ’the topmost’
glossary.ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun or adverb: ’the top, at the top’
glossary.ἄλαστον: ἄλαστος — unforgettable, not to be forgotten, hence grievous (sense traditional); adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
glossary.ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄλκιμος — Alcimus, a companion of Achilles; masc. nom. sg., a name
glossary.ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl.: ’the other (things)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’some’ (ἄλλα μὲν … πολλὰ δὲ ’some … many’)
glossary.ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.

glossary.ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
glossary.ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl.: ’(to) the others’
glossary.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
glossary.ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
glossary.ἄλλοτ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at other times; adv., elided (ἄλλοτ’); καὶ ἄλλοτ’ ’at another time too’
glossary.ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
glossary.ἄλλου: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
glossary.ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμαξαν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
glossary.ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
glossary.ἄμφεπε: ἀμφέπω — busy oneself about, tend, play about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤμφεπε)
glossary.ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’ · also dual, of two things: ’both (hands)’
glossary.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc. · also with the impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν πω χάζοντο ’would not yet have been giving ground’) · also with the aor. indic. in the main clause of a past unreal condition: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν … ἐρρήξαντο … εἰ μὴ … ὦρσεν) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., purpose: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν … ἐξαγάγοις ’so that you might bring out’) · also ὡς ἄν + short-vowel subj. (δοάσσεται), purpose: ’so that … will’
glossary.ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
glossary.ἄναυδος: ἄναυδος — without voice, speechless; adj., masc. nom. sg., alpha-privative
glossary.ἄνδιχα: ἄνδιχα — in two, apart; adv. (= ἀνὰ δίχα, Attic δίχα)
glossary.ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
glossary.ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
glossary.ἄνθεσιν: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄνθος: ἄνθος — flower, bloom; neut. acc. sg., object of ἔχει: ’the bloom (of youth)’
glossary.ἄνθρωποι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄντ: ἄντα — opposite, face to face; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἄντ’ = ἄντα): ’straight at’
glossary.ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun · also prep. + gen., placed before its noun: ’face to face with’ (ἄντα Ποσειδάωνος ’opposite Poseidon’)
glossary.ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
glossary.ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
glossary.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
glossary.ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
glossary.ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, stronger; comparative; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος: ’stronger’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better’ (ἄρειον ἔπλετο ’was better’)
glossary.ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
glossary.ἄρηαι: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., after ὡς ἄν (= Attic ἄρῃ): ’you may win’
glossary.ἄρηι: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg. (Ἄρηϊ)
glossary.ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
glossary.ἄρισται: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; fem. nom. pl. ἄρισται, predicate (of mares): ’best, foremost’
glossary.ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρκιον: ἄρκιος — sufficing, sure, safe; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject
glossary.ἄρκιος: ἄρκιος — sufficient, assured, ample (cf. ἀρκέω ’suffice’); masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἄρμενον: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; sync. aor. mid. part., ’fitted, fitting’; masc. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρνας: ἀρήν — lamb; acc. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
glossary.ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρουραι: ἄρουρα — ploughland, field; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, ploughland, earth; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρσενες: ἄρσην — male; masc. nom. pl. (= Attic ἄρρενες)
glossary.ἄρτον: ἄρτος — loaf, bread; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρχῃ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’may begin’
glossary.ἄσβεστος: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, unceasing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond measure, boundlessly’
glossary.ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἄτερ: ἄτερ — apart from, without; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἄτη: ἄτη — bewilderment, blind folly (personified as a goddess); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄτην: ἄτη — blindness, bewilderment, folly; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
glossary.ἄτιμος: ἄτιμος — unhonoured, without honour; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄτῃσι: ἄτη — bewilderment, delusion, blind folly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), of means: ’with delusions’
glossary.ἄφενος: ἄφενος — wealth, abundance; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄφθιτα: ἄφθιτος — unfailing, not passing away; neut. nom. pl.: ’unfailing’
glossary.ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θρόνον: ’imperishable (throne)’
glossary.ἄφθιτος: ἄφθιτος — unfailing, imperishable, undying; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἴτυς
glossary.ἄφρων: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄχθος: ἄχθος — burden, load, weight; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄψορρον: ἄψορρος — backward, back again; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’back’
glossary.ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’ · also neut. acc. pl., inner object with ἅ τε: ’such things as’ (ἅ τε … ὀαρίζετον ’such talk as … hold’)
glossary.ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅλαδ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε, elided (ἅλαδ’ = ἅλαδε): ’seaward’
glossary.ἅλαδε: ἅλς — sea (salt); acc. ἅλα + suffix -δε ’to’; adv. ἅλαδε: ’to the sea’
glossary.ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
glossary.ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
glossary.ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τά: ’all (these things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’all (the army)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρημνόν: ’the whole (bank)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χῶρον: ’the whole (place)’ (χῶρον ἅπαντα ’the whole spot’)
glossary.ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅπασι: ἅπας — all, every one, the whole; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
glossary.ἐέλδεται: ἐέλδομαι — long for, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic with prothetic ἐ- (= Attic ἐπιθυμεῖ), + inf.
glossary.ἐέργει: εἴργω — shut in, enclose; pres. 3 sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
glossary.ἐέργων: εἴργω — shut in, hem in, keep back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
glossary.ἐβιήσατο: βιάομαι — use force against, overpower; aor. 3 sg. mid., Ionic (= Attic ἐβιάσατο): ’overpowered’
glossary.ἐγέλασσε: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg. act., epic σσ (= ἐγέλασε): ’laughed’
glossary.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’) · also aor. 3 pl. with a predicate: ’became, fell’ (ἀκὴν ἐγένοντο ’fell silent’)
glossary.ἐγγυάλιξεν: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, deliver; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, with κε in a past unreal apodosis: ’would have put into the hands’ · also without κε, plain aor. 3 sg. act.: ’put into the hands of, gave over’ (ἐμοὶ ἐγγυάλιξεν ’put them into my hands’)
glossary.ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
glossary.ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
glossary.ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’begot’ (of a father)
glossary.ἐγκάτθεο: ἐγκατατίθημι — put in, tuck into; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., apocope of κατά (ἐγκάτθεο = ἐγκατάθου): ’put (it) in’
glossary.ἐγκάτθετο: ἐγκατατίθημι — put in, lay up in; aor. 3 sg. mid., syncopated, epic (= Attic ἐγκατέθετο): ’laid up in’
glossary.ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
glossary.ἐδάμασσε: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασε): ’subdued’
glossary.ἐδίδαξαν: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 pl. act. (+ double acc.): ’taught’
glossary.ἐδίδου: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was giving’ (οὐδ’ … ἐδίδου ’would not give’)
glossary.ἐδωδῆς: ἐδωδή — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐδύναντο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they could’
glossary.ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλητε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 2 pl., after αἴ κ’: ’if you wish’
glossary.ἐθέλουσά: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic γε)
glossary.ἐθέλουσα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’wishing, willing’
glossary.ἐθέλουσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., + inf.
glossary.ἐθέλω: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’willing’
glossary.ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὁππότε: ’is willing’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg., elided (ἐθέλῃσ’ = ἐθέλῃσι), after αἴ κ’: ’if he is willing’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
glossary.ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κ’: ’if he wishes’ · also in a general relative clause after ἥν κ’: ’whichever he wishes’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest … wish’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κεν · also pres. subj. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause, without κεν: ’does not wish’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ὁππότε δή, without κεν: ’whenever … wishes’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὅππως κεν: ’in whatever way he wishes’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause with κ’: ’whoever wishes’
glossary.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
glossary.ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
glossary.ἐκάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable; with περί in tmesis, ’wrapped round’ · also aor. 3 sg., of night over the eyes, with κατά + gen. (no tmesis): ’covered’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν … ἐκάλυψεν ’covered down over the eyes’)
glossary.ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + acc. + inf. · also + dat. + inf.: ’ordered (Cebriones) to …’ (Κεβριόνῃ … ἐκέλευσε … πεπληγέμεν)
glossary.ἐκαρτύναντο: καρτύνω — make strong, strengthen (epic; Attic κρατύνω); aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’they made firm for themselves’
glossary.ἐκγεγαυῖα: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born from; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (ἐκγεγαώς), + gen.: ’born of’
glossary.ἐκλίνθη: κλίνω — bend, lean; aor. pass. 3 sg. with middle sense: ’leaned aside’
glossary.ἐλάσσας: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐλάσας): ’having driven’
glossary.ἐλέγχεα: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. nom./voc./acc. pl., epic (Attic masc. ἔλεγχοι); in address: ’you disgraces’ · also neut. nom. pl., collective subject: ’the disgraces’
glossary.ἐλήλαται: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive along, extend; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’has been driven’
glossary.ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with oil’
glossary.ἐλαφρότερος: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble, easy; comp. ἐλαφρότερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’lighter’
glossary.ἐλαύνοι: ἐλαύνω — drive; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a condition after εἴ κεν: ’should drive’
glossary.ἐλύσατο: λύω — loose, unfasten; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’unfastened (for herself)’ · also ’ransomed, freed for a price’ (ξεῖνός μιν ἐλύσατο ’a guest-friend ransomed him’)
glossary.ἐμήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; aor. 3 sg.: ’contrived’
glossary.ἐμίσγετο: μίσγω — mix, mingle; impf. mid. 3 sg., + dat.: ’lay with’, epic (= Attic ἐμείγνυτο)
glossary.ἐμβασίλευεν: ἐμβασιλεύω — be king in, reign; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν
glossary.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’) · also dat. with μάχομαι: ’against me’ (ἐμοὶ μάχεσθαι ’to fight me’)
glossary.ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμὰς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
glossary.ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’
glossary.ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
glossary.ἐνάτη: ἔνατος — ninth (epic also εἴνατος); fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’ninth’
glossary.ἐνέμοντο: νέμομαι — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἐνέποντες: ἐνέπω — tell, speak, converse; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’telling, speaking’
glossary.ἐνήρατο: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg. mid., with active sense
glossary.ἐναλίγκιοι: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πῦρ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἔην, before ὡς εἰ: ’like (as if)’ (ἔην ἐναλίγκιον ὡς εἰ ’it was like as if’)
glossary.ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐναύλους: ἔναυλος — water-course, stream-bed (sense taken from ἐν + αὐλός ’pipe’, not certain); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐνείκῃ: ἐνείκω (epic aor. stem serving φέρω ’carry, bring’) — bring, carry; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause
glossary.ἐνεῖκαι: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. inf. act., epic -αι (= Attic ἐνεγκεῖν): ’to bring’
glossary.ἐνηέος: ἐνηής — kindly, gentle; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (Attic contraction would be -οῦς), agreeing with ἑτάροιο
glossary.ἐνιαυτοῦ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. gen. sg., gen. absolute with περιπλομένου
glossary.ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., after εἰς, of duration: ’for a year’
glossary.ἐνιαυτὸν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., after εἰς, of duration: ’a year’
glossary.ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνισπεῖν: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. inf.: ’to tell’
glossary.ἐννοσίγαιον: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. acc. sg. as a noun
glossary.ἐννοσίγαιος: ἐννοσίγαιος — ’earth-shaker’, epithet/name of Poseidon (built on γαῖα, distinct from ἐνοσίχθων built on χθών); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐννοσιγαίῳ: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. dat. sg., epic (cf. ἐνοσίχθων)
glossary.ἐννύχιαι: ἐννύχιος — by night, nocturnal; fem. nom. pl., used adverbially: ’by night’
glossary.ἐνοπήν: ἐνοπή — voice, cry, sound; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
glossary.ἐνυώ: Ἐνυώ — Enyo, goddess of war and the sacking of cities; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’ · also ’thought of, devised (a thing)’
glossary.ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
glossary.ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’ · ἐκ — in ἐξ ἄλλων (ἐκ + gen.), ’from among the others, more than the rest’
glossary.ἐξάγαγ: ἐξάγω — lead out; aor. 2 3 sg., elided and unaugmented (ἐξάγαγ’ = ἐξήγαγε)
glossary.ἐξαπάτησεν: ἐξαπατάω — deceive utterly, cheat; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξαπίνης: ἐξαπίνης — suddenly; adv., epic (= Attic ἐξαίφνης)
glossary.ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
glossary.ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
glossary.ἐξεγένοντο: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born from, spring from; aor. 3 pl. dep., augmented after the preverb, + gen.: ’were born of’
glossary.ἐξελάσωσι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), in a fear clause after μή, + acc.: ’and drive us out’
glossary.ἐξελθεῖν: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. inf.
glossary.ἐξελθοῦσα: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come out’
glossary.ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
glossary.ἐξερύσας: ἐξερύω — draw out, tear out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having torn out’
glossary.ἐξετέλεσσαν: ἐκτελέω — accomplish, bring to completion; aor. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐξετέλεσαν): ’would have accomplished’
glossary.ἐξετέλεσσεν: ἐκτελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐξετέλεσεν)
glossary.ἐξεφαάνθη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐξεφάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — backward, behind, to the rear; adv. (of time, ’hereafter’)
glossary.ἐοικότα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. neut. acc. pl., + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
glossary.ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
glossary.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
glossary.ἐπάλμενος: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (ἐπάλμενος = ἐφαλόμενος): ’leaping on (them)’
glossary.ἐπέβησαν: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon; aor. act. (weak) causative: set upon, bring to (+ gen.); 3 pl. · also aor. 3 pl. act., intransitive + gen.: ’stepped upon, went in for’ (ἀναιδείης ἐπέβησαν ’gave themselves to shamelessness’)
glossary.ἐπέβησε: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon; causative aor. act. set upon, make mount (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’set (him) upon’
glossary.ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἐπέθηκε: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist)
glossary.ἐπέθηκεν: ἐπιτίθημι — put upon, lay on; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’laid upon’
glossary.ἐπέρησα: περάω — cross, pass through; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
glossary.ἐπέφραδε: φράζω — point out, tell, show; reduplicated 2nd aor. 3 sg. act. (ἔπεφραδον): ’pointed out’
glossary.ἐπέων: ἔπος — word; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπῶν): ’of words’
glossary.ἐπήρατον: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desirable; adj. of two endings, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they obeyed’
glossary.ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — surname, byname; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by surname’
glossary.ἐπίκλοπον: ἐπίκλοπος — thievish, deceitful; masc. acc. sg.: ’a cheat’
glossary.ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’allies!’
glossary.ἐπίορκον: ἐπίορκος — false to one’s oath; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., as cognate object of ὄμνυμι: ’a false (oath)’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate of a conditional clause: ’a false oath’ (εἴ τι τῶνδ’ ἐπίορκον ’if any of this is a false oath’)
glossary.ἐπίφρονα: ἐπίφρων — thoughtful, prudent; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπίφρονι: ἐπίφρων — sound of mind, prudent, sensible; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπαινῆς: ἐπαινός — dread, awful (traditional gloss, uncertain); fem. gen. sg., epithet of Persephone
glossary.ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
glossary.ἐπερρώσαντο: ἐπιρρώομαι — stream on, rush upon; aor. 3 pl. mid., ἐπερρώσαντο: ’streamed forward’
glossary.ἐπηρεφέας: ἐπηρεφής — overhanging, beetling; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπιβησέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon; causative fut. act. set upon (+ gen.); fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβήσειν): ’to set upon’
glossary.ἐπιβᾶσα: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, step upon (+ acc.); aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having set foot on’
glossary.ἐπιδευὴς: ἐπιδευής — in want, lacking (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιείκελον: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.ἐπικρατέως: ἐπικρατέως — mightily, with mastery; adv. (from ἐπικρατής)
glossary.ἐπιμίσγεται: ἐπιμίσγομαι — have dealings with, mingle with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιμειδήσας: ἐπιμειδάω — smile at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’smiling’
glossary.ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
glossary.ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπιχθόνιοι: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπιόντα: ἔπειμι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as he comes on’
glossary.ἐποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐπώνυμον: ἐπώνυμος — given as a name, by-name; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., predicate: ’as a by-name’
glossary.ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a temporal clause: ’when’ (ἐπὴν τεισαίμεθα ’when we have avenged’)
glossary.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
glossary.ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
glossary.ἐρίσαντε: ἐρίζω — quarrel, strive; aor. part. masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἐρατεινήν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρατὰ: ἐρατός — lovely, desirable; neut. acc. pl., with δῶρ’
glossary.ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; pres. inf. mid. dep.: ’to work’
glossary.ἐρεβεννή: ἐρεβεννός — dark, murky (ἔρεβος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐριγδούποιο: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, loud-thundering; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Zeus, epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐρικυδέος: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, much honoured; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἐρινύας: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, avenging spirit, Fury; fem. acc. pl., Ionic -ας: ’Erinyes’ (the vengeance a wronged parent’s curse calls down)
glossary.ἐρινῦς: Ἐρινύς — an Erinys, an avenging spirit that answers a curse; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρισθενέος: ἐρισθενής — of great strength; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἐρχόμενον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’coming’
glossary.ἐρύκει: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, keep off; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐρύκοι: ἐρύκω — keep off, ward off, hold back; pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε in a relative clause: ’which would keep off’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κεν in the apodosis of a condition: ’would keep (him) away’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε in a main clause: ’could hold back’ (καί χ’ εἷς πάντας ἐρύκοι ἀνήρ ’even one man could hold them all back’)
glossary.ἐρύσαι: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. inf. act. (Attic ἑλκύσαι or ἕλξαι expresses the sense): ’to drag’
glossary.ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (ἐς Πριάμοιο ’to Priam’s’)
glossary.ἐσθίει: ἐσθίω — eat, devour; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐσθλαί: ἐσθλός — good, noble, sound; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσθλοί: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσθλοῦ: ἐσθλός — good, noble; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’good’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’a good man’ (οὐ κακὸν οὐδὲ μὲν ἐσθλόν ’neither a base nor a good man’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’good (cousin)’
glossary.ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.: ’good things, good deeds’
glossary.ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
glossary.ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
glossary.ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; gen. pl., as a noun of persons: ’of the brave’
glossary.ἐσθλῷ: ἐσθλός — good; neut. dat. sg., as a noun, opposed to κακῷ: ’good’
glossary.ἐσθῆτι: ἐσθής — clothing, garment; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐσκέδασ: σκεδάννυμι — scatter; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἐσκέδασ’ = ἐσκέδασε): ’scattered’
glossary.ἐσσεῖται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἐσσεῖται (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἐσσομένοισιν: εἰμί — be; fut. part. mid. ἐσσόμενος, masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’those yet to be’
glossary.ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
glossary.ἐσσόμενα: εἰμί — be; fut. part. neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -σσ- (= ἐσόμενα): ’things to come’
glossary.ἐστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐστ’ = ἐστί)
glossary.ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
glossary.ἐστεφάνωται: στεφανόω — wreathe, encircle (στέφανος ’crown’); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wreathed round’
glossary.ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.ἐτέων: ἔτος — year; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐτῶν): ’of years’
glossary.ἐτελέσθη: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was accomplished’
glossary.ἐτύμοισιν: ἔτυμος — true, real; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’true things’
glossary.ἐτώσια: ἐτώσιος — to no purpose, vain, fruitless; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic, no Attic form (= Attic μάταιος in sense), used as predicate or adverb: ’in vain’
glossary.ἐτώσιον: ἐτώσιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg., adj. agreeing with ἄχθος: ’useless’
glossary.ἐυστέφανός: ἐυστέφανος — fair-crowned, well-garlanded; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’) · also + acc., ’over’ (ἐφ’ ὑγρὴν ’over the water’) · also preverb in tmesis, ἐφ’ … ἔχευε = ἐπέχευε ’poured upon’, + acc. as object (ἐφ’ ὕπνον ἔχευε ’poured sleep upon’)
glossary.ἐφεζομένη: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon, settle on (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. dep. fem. nom. sg.: ’settling on’
glossary.ἐφεζόμενος: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting upon’
glossary.ἐφορμηθῆναι: ἐφορμάω — set in motion against; pass. rush upon, charge; aor. inf. pass.: ’to rush on’
glossary.ἐφράσαθ: φράζομαι — notice, consider, devise; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐφράσαθ’ = ἐφράσατο): ’noticed, made out’
glossary.ἐφράσσατο: φράζομαι (mid. of φράζω) — notice, observe, devise; aor. mid. 3 sg., with geminated σ by metre (= ἐφράσατο): ’noticed’
glossary.ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep in check; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν): ’to hold’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’hold!’
glossary.ἐχθρὸν: ἐχθρός — hateful, odious; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’hateful’
glossary.ἐχθρὸς: ἐχθρός — hateful, hated; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐχόντων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl.: ’of those who hold’ · also pres. imper. 3 pl.: ’let them hold’
glossary.ἐόν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐόν (= Attic ὄν): ’being, as it is’
glossary.ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
glossary.ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
glossary.ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
glossary.ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
glossary.ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος), in a gen. absolute with οὐκέτ’: ’being no more’
glossary.ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’being’ (πολλῶν περ ἐόντων ’though they were many’)
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἐᾶσαι: ἐάω — allow, let; aor. inf. act., used as a command: ’let (me)’
glossary.ἐᾷ: ἐάω — allow, permit; pres. indic. 3 sg., contracted (ἐᾷ): ’allows’
glossary.ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
glossary.ἑβδομάτῃ: ἑβδόματος — seventh (epic = Attic ἕβδομος); fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ῥινῷ: ’in the seventh (hide)’
glossary.ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑκηβόλου: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting, epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
glossary.ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
glossary.ἑλικώπιδα: ἑλικῶπις — quick-eyed (sense disputed: ’lively-eyed’ or ’dark-eyed’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλκέμεν: ἕλκω — drag, haul; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕλκειν)
glossary.ἑλκόντων: ἕλκω — drag, pull, draw; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’with (many) pulling’
glossary.ἑλλάδος: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, the land of the Hellenes; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἑνδεκάτη: ἑνδέκατος — eleventh; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς ’dawn’
glossary.ἑξέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕξειν): ’to hold’
glossary.ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
glossary.ἑοὺς: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); masc. acc. pl.; not the relative
glossary.ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός: ’his own’ (ἑοῦ … πατρός ’of his own father’)
glossary.ἑπταπόδην: ἑπταπόδης — seven feet long; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θρῆνυν: ’seven-foot’
glossary.ἑρμῆν: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes, messenger of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑρμῇ: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes, god of messengers, son of Zeus and Maia; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑσσάμενοι: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ἀμφιεσάμενοι): ’having put on’
glossary.ἑστᾶσιν: ἵστημι — stand; perf. 3 pl. act., intransitive, contracted (= ἑστήκασι): ’stand, are standing’
glossary.ἑτέρη: ἕτερος — the other, second; fem. nom. sg., epic/Ionic -η (= Attic ἑτέρα), with the pronoun ἣ: ’the other’
glossary.ἑτέρην: ἕτερος — other, second (of two); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἑτέραν)
glossary.ἑτέρηφι: ἕτερος — the other (of two); fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φι, instrumental (= Attic dat. ἑτέρᾳ): ’with the other (hand)’
glossary.ἑτέρου: ἕτερος — the other (of two), another; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with τοίχου: ’the other (wall)’
glossary.ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
glossary.ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν; not the relative
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’ · also neut. nom. sg., with the article, of one’s belongings: ’his own’ (τὸ δ’ ἑὸν ’his own’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄγγελον: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πατέρα: ’his own’
glossary.ἑὸς: ἑός — his own, her own (3rd-person possessive adj., epic, = possessive ὅς); masc. nom. sg. (ἑὸς δόμος ’his own house’)
glossary.ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc. dat. sg.: ’her own’
glossary.ἔαρος: ἔαρ — spring; neut. gen. sg. (= Attic ἦρος): ’of spring’
glossary.ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
glossary.ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
glossary.ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
glossary.ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
glossary.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’ · also gnomic aor. 3 sg.: ’learns’ (ῥεχθὲν … ἔγνω ’learns when it is done’)
glossary.ἔγχεα: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἔγχη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’spears’ (ἔγχεα ὀξυόεντα ’sharp spears’)
glossary.ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
glossary.ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἔδοι: ἔδω — eat; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a relative clause of characteristic: ’who would eat’
glossary.ἔδον: ἔδω — eat; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤσθιον): ’ate’
glossary.ἔδουσι: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι): ’they eat’
glossary.ἔδωκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl. augmented (κ-aorist): ’they gave’
glossary.ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
glossary.ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον): ’I spoke’ · also aor. 3 pl., with Ἀχαιοί as subject: ’they said’
glossary.ἔζωον: ζώω — live; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔζων)
glossary.ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἔησθα: εἰμί — be; impf. 2 sg., epic ἔησθα (= Attic ἦσθα): ’you were’
glossary.ἔθεντο: τίθημι — put, set; mid. make for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’made for themselves’ (οἰκία ἔθεντο ’made their homes’) · also aor. 3 pl. mid. + dat., ’laid upon, set on’ (πόνον καὶ δῆριν ἔθεντο ’laid toil and strife upon’)
glossary.ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they made’
glossary.ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl. act., built on ἔθηκε (= Attic ἔθεσαν); with a predicate acc.: ’made (her) priestess’
glossary.ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
glossary.ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
glossary.ἔκθορε: ἐκθρῴσκω — leap out; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐξέθορε), + gen.: ’leapt out of’
glossary.ἔκιον: κίω — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ᾔεσαν): ’went’
glossary.ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
glossary.ἔλαχον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, get as one’s share; aor. 3 pl. (the 1 sg. has the same shape): ’they received by lot’
glossary.ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until … comes’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα (purpose): ’that she may go’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if … should come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅτε κέν: ’whenever … comes’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause after ὅς τις: ’whoever comes’
glossary.ἔλιπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor. (the form is also 3 pl.): ’I left’
glossary.ἔλλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., epic λλ (= Attic ἔλαβε), ν-movable
glossary.ἔλυσε: λύω — loose, undo, untie; aor. 3 sg. act.; with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἔλυσε = ὑπέλυσε): ’loosed beneath’, of the knees
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
glossary.ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
glossary.ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
glossary.ἔμιμνε: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔμενε): ’remained’
glossary.ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔμμορε: μείρομαι — receive a share; perf. 3 sg. ἔμμορε, + gen.: ’has a share of’
glossary.ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
glossary.ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ) · also accented ἔν before the enclitic γε (ἔν γ’ αὐτοσταδίῃ ’in close combat’)
glossary.ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
glossary.ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
glossary.ἔνειμαν: νέμω — distribute, deal out, assign; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they allotted’
glossary.ἔνερθ: ἔνερθε(ν) — beneath, below; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἔνερθ’ = ἔνερθε): ’beneath’
glossary.ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
glossary.ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
glossary.ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
glossary.ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
glossary.ἔξοχ: ἔξοχα — exceedingly, surpassingly; adv., elided (ἔξοχ’ = ἔξοχα)
glossary.ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
glossary.ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα), elided (ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
glossary.ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
glossary.ἔπεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
glossary.ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔραζε: ἔραζε — to the ground, earthward; adv., ἔρα + directional -ζε
glossary.ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
glossary.ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
glossary.ἔργοιο: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with ἔρις: ’a contest of work’
glossary.ἔργοις: ἔργον — deed, work, occupation; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔργου: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. sg., after πειράομαι: ’test oneself at the work’
glossary.ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’ · also after ἐπί: ’task, undertaking’
glossary.ἔρδειν: ἔρδω — do, act, perform; pres. inf.: ’to do’ · also ’offer sacrifice’: ’to offer’ (ἔρδειν ἑκατόμβας ’to offer hecatombs’)
glossary.ἔρεβος: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark of the underworld; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔριδι: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔριν: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρξῃς: ἔρδω — do, work, accomplish (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔρος: ἔρος — love, desire; masc. nom. sg. (beside ἔρως), subject of ἐδάμασσεν
glossary.ἔρυμα: ἔρυμα — protection, defence; neut. nom./acc. sg. (ἐρύομαι ’protect’)
glossary.ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc., accented ἔς before an enclitic
glossary.ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
glossary.ἔσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf.: ’to be, will be’
glossary.ἔσθειν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. inf., epic by-form of ἐσθίειν (= Attic ἐσθίειν)
glossary.ἔσθοντες: ἔσθω (ἐσθίω) — eat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic: ’eating’
glossary.ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative -σκ- form: ’was, used to be’
glossary.ἔσπετε: ἐννέπω — tell, say; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἔσπετε (= Attic εἴπατε): ’tell!’
glossary.ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
glossary.ἔστειχε: στείχω — go, walk, march; impf. 3 sg.: ’went’
glossary.ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
glossary.ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., with movable ν: ’is’ · also with an infinitive, ’it is possible to’ (ἔστιν ἐρίζειν ’it is possible to rival’)
glossary.ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
glossary.ἔσχατα: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at the farthest end’
glossary.ἔσχεν: ἔχω — hold, have; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic ἔσχε), used intransitively: ’held fast, stuck’
glossary.ἔσχον: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. 3 pl. (or 1 sg.), augmented (ἐ- + aor. stem σχ-; unaugmented σχέθον is a different formation): ’they held’
glossary.ἔσω: ἔσω — within, inside; adv. (= εἴσω) · also postpositive adv. with an acc. of goal: ’into’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
glossary.ἔτεα: ἔτος — year; neut. pl., epic uncontracted ἔτεα (= Attic ἔτη), acc. of duration: ’years’
glossary.ἔτεκ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔτεκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore’
glossary.ἔτεκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’bore’
glossary.ἔτεος: ἔτος — year; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους), gen. absolute with περιτελλομένου
glossary.ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
glossary.ἔτικτεν: τίκτω — beget, bear; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’fathered’
glossary.ἔτραπον: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 pl. (2nd aor.), intransitive of the seasons: ’turned, came round’
glossary.ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
glossary.ἔφαινον: φαίνω — show, bring to light; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were granting (the birth of)’ · also impf. 3 pl. with κεν in a relative clause, potential in the past: αἵ κεν ἔφαινον ’who would have given light’
glossary.ἔφασαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., augmented (cf. unaugmented φάσαν): ’they said’, + acc. and inf.
glossary.ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
glossary.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’) · also impf. 3 sg., of a feeling: ’held, gripped’ (θάμβος δ’ ἔχε πάντας ’wonder held them all’)
