glossary.ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
glossary.ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf.
glossary.ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
glossary.ἔχεσκεν: ἔχω — have, hold; iterative impf. 3 sg., -σκ- suffix: ’he would hold’
glossary.ἔχοι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 3 sg.; potential with κε: ’could hold’
glossary.ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
glossary.ἔχοντ: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἔχοντ’ = ἔχοντα)
glossary.ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
glossary.ἔχοντας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’having, possessing’
glossary.ἔχοντε: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two holding’
glossary.ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἔχουσαν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἔχουσιν: ἔχω — have, hold, occupy; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’ · also ’holding, possessing’, of a lord and his land (Πήδασον ἔχων ’holding Pedasus’)
glossary.ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
glossary.ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also ’each’ of a body of men, in apposition to the whole army (’each company’)
glossary.ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
glossary.ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕκητι: ἕκητι — by the will of, thanks to; epic prep. + gen.
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)
glossary.ἕλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. 2 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic εἷλεν)
glossary.ἕληται: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after εἰς ὅ κε ’until’ (= Attic ἕως ἂν …); with ἐκ in tmesis, ’take out’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., with ἀπό in tmesis, in an indirect deliberation: ’should strip off’ (ἀπὸ … ἕληται) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ὁππότε: ’takes’ (θυμὸν … ἕληται ’take his life’) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a temporal clause after ἐπεί κε: ’once he takes’ (θυμὸν ἐκ … ἕληται)
glossary.ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl. · also ἕλιξ as a noun — spiral, coil (an ornament); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
glossary.ἕξει: ἔχω — have, hold; fut. 3 sg. (rough breathing): ’will have, will keep’
glossary.ἕπεται: ἕπομαι — follow; pres. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’follows’
glossary.ἕποιτο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., potential with κε: ’would follow’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it followed’ · also in a condition after εἰ, of a wished-for case: ’if he would follow’ (εἴ τίς μοι … ἕποιτο) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., in a request or wish with no particle: ’let (a herald) follow’
glossary.ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕσπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐ-σπ-ετο, root σεπ-), the augment absorbed: ’followed’
glossary.ἕστηκεν: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’stands, lies at anchor’
glossary.ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕτεροι: ἕτερος — the other, the other of two, a second party; masc. nom. pl.: ’others’
glossary.ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόδα · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a dual noun: ’(the) one’ (ἄρνε … ἕτερον ’of the two lambs, one’) · also neut. acc. sg., ’one thing’ (ἕτερον … ἄλλο ’one thing … another’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πῦρ: ’the one’ (ἕτερον μὲν … ἄλλο δέ ’the one … the other’)
glossary.ἕτερος: ἕτερος — the one, the other (of two); masc. nom. sg. (ὁ ἕτερος … ὁ δέ ’the one … the other’)
glossary.ἕτερόν: ἕτερος — one of two, the other; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’one or the other’
glossary.ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
glossary.ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε, with ὑπό: ’beneath the sun’
glossary.ἠέρα: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα (= Attic ἀέρα)
glossary.ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’ · also masc. dat. sg., of cause, with a second dative: ’from mist’
glossary.ἠγάγετο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. take with oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’brought with him’ · mid. take home as a wife; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented
glossary.ἠγαθέῃ: ἠγάθεος — very holy, sacred (intensive formation); adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
glossary.ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
glossary.ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
glossary.ἠεροειδέα: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dark like mist; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.ἠεροειδέι: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dusky; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
glossary.ἠερόεντα: ἠερόεις — misty, murky, dim (ἠήρ ’mist’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Τάρταρον
glossary.ἠερόεντος: ἠερόεις — misty, murky; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ζόφου
glossary.ἠμάτιαι: ἠμάτιος — daily, by day; fem. nom. pl., epic, predicative with the subject (νῆες): ’day by day’
glossary.ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
glossary.ἠνορέην: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage, vigour; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
glossary.ἠοῦς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. gen. sg. Ἠοῦς: ’of dawn’ · also gen. of time: ’at dawn, next morning’ (ἠοῦς δὴ) · μέσφ’ ἠοῦς ’until dawn’
glossary.ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
glossary.ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἠυκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, with beautiful hair; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of goddesses
glossary.ἠύκομος: ἐύκομος — fine-haired; fem. nom. sg., epic ἠύ- (= Attic εὔκομος), epithet of Leto
glossary.ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
glossary.ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
glossary.ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; fem. acc. sg., with ὑπό: ’beneath the dawn’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ τ’ ἠέλιόν τε ’under dawn and sun’) · also fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ δῖαν φανήμεναι ’that heavenly Dawn appear’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of μίμνω: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ μίμνον ’waited for Dawn’)
glossary.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (ἡ κυνάμυια ’that dog-fly’)
glossary.ἡγεμονεύῃ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, guide; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a simile after ὡς ὅτε: ’guides’
glossary.ἡδεῖα: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡμέρη: ἡμέρα — day; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἡμέρα)
glossary.ἡμετέρης: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with μάχης
glossary.ἡμετέρου: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with οἴκου
glossary.ἡμιόνοισιν: ἡμίονος — mule; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’with mules’
glossary.ἡμιόνων: ἡμίονος — mule; gen. pl., construed as fem. with ἀγροτεράων · also gen. pl., after ἔκδεον: ’(bound) to the mules’ · also gen. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (the wagon of) mules’ (ἐφ’ ἡμιόνων)
glossary.ἡρακληείη: Ἡρακληείη — of Heracles (the might of Heracles, i.e. Heracles); adj., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic Ἡρακλεία)
glossary.ἡρακληείην: Ἡρακληεῖος (Ἡρακληείη) — of Heracles; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἡρακλεία), with βίην: ’the might of Heracles’
glossary.ἡρακληείης: Ἡρακληεῖος — of Heracles, Heraclean; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.ἡρακληείῃ: Ἡρακληεῖος — of Heracles, Heraclean; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -εία)
glossary.ἡρακλῆος: Ἡρακλῆς — Heracles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έους), after περιχώσατο: ’at Heracles’ · also masc. gen. sg., objective gen. with ὀδύνη: ’pain for Heracles’
glossary.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’) · also ’rather than’ after βούλομαι (βουλοίμην … ἢ … ’I would rather … than …’)
glossary.ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
glossary.ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
glossary.ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
glossary.ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
glossary.ἤθεα: ἦθος — accustomed place, haunt; neut. acc. pl. ἤθεα: ’usual places’
glossary.ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl. (ἤθελον)
glossary.ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’ · also ’beat out, hammer (metal)’: aor. 3 sg., ’hammered’
glossary.ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
glossary.ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
glossary.ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly, soothing; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἤπιον: ἤπιος — gentle, kind, mild; masc. acc. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’kind (to you)’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with ἄνακτα: ’so kind a master’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with μῦθον: ‘a gentle (word)’
glossary.ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
glossary.ἤσθιεν: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable (= ἤσθιε)
glossary.ἤσθιον: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 pl.; with κατά in tmesis = κατήσθιον ’were devouring’
glossary.ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
glossary.ἤχθηρε: ἐχθαίρω — hate, be hostile to; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἤχθηρε: ’hated’
glossary.ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’) · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic μιν: ’who, which’ (ἥ μιν ἔτικτε ’who bore him’)
glossary.ἥβην: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἥβη — Hebe, goddess of youth; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
glossary.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
glossary.ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
glossary.ἥρην: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
glossary.ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
glossary.ἥρπασε: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’snatched’
glossary.ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’ · also nom. pl., subject: ’the heroes’ (ἥρωες Δαναοί … διδοῦσιν)
glossary.ἥρωι: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
glossary.ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
glossary.ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
glossary.ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἦκ: ἦκα — gently, softly, a little; adv., elided (ἦκ’ = ἦκα)
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
glossary.ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
glossary.ἦρι: ἦρι — early, early in the morning; adv., epic (from ἦρ): μάλ’ ἦρι ’very early’
glossary.ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
glossary.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’) · also with ἐπί in tmesis: ’set on, put on’ (ἐπὶ … λόφον ἧκε ’set a crest on it’) · also without a preverb, of a throw: ’threw, let fly’ (ἧκε δὲ δινήσας ’and threw it, having whirled it’)
glossary.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., object of ἐέλδομαι: ’for whom (I long)’ · also relative, fem. gen. sg., object of τοξεύειν: ’at which (to shoot)’
glossary.ἧσσον: ἥσσων — less, weaker; neut. acc. sg. as adv. ’less’, Ionic (= Attic ἧττον)
glossary.ἰάνειρά: Ἰάνειρα — Ianeira, a Nereid; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰάνθη: ἰαίνω — warm, cheer, gladden; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was warmed, was gladdened’
glossary.ἰήσονι: Ἰήσων — Jason, leader of the Argonauts; masc. dat. sg., after ὑπό
glossary.ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’ · also aor. mid. inf., after πάρος: ’before seeing’ · also aor. mid. inf. after μένε, expressing what is awaited: ’to see’ (μένε … ἰδέσθαι ’was waiting to see’) · also aor. mid. inf. after δός, expressing what is granted: ’to see’ (δὸς … ἰδέσθαι ’grant to see’)
glossary.ἰδεῖν: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. inf. act.: ’to see’
glossary.ἰδυῖα: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’skilled, wise’
glossary.ἰδυῖαν: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. sg., epic ἰδυῖα (= Attic εἰδυῖα), + acc.: ’knowing, skilled in’
glossary.ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
glossary.ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
glossary.ἰθύνει: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide straight, steer; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’guides straight’
glossary.ἰθύνετε: ἰθύνω — steer straight, direct; pres. 2 pl., short-vowel subj. with ἄν (= ἰθύνητε)
glossary.ἰλαδὸν: ἰλαδόν — in troops, in companies; adv.
glossary.ἰνὼ: Ἰνώ — Ino, sea-goddess (formerly mortal), who earlier gave Odysseus her veil; nom. sg.
glossary.ἰοειδέα: ἰοειδής — violet-dark, deep-coloured (of the sea); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰοειδῆ)
glossary.ἰοχέαιραν: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-shooter, showering arrows (epithet of Artemis); fem. acc. sg., as a title used for the goddess
glossary.ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
glossary.ἰούσῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’as you were going’
glossary.ἰοῦσαι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ἰσοφαρίζοι: ἰσοφαρίζω — match, rival (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’should match’
glossary.ἰσχάνει: ἰσχάνω — hold back, restrain; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰφθίμου: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰφθίμων: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, sturdy; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἰωὴ: ἰωή — sound, cry; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
glossary.ἰόντας: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ἱεράων: ἱερός — holy, sacred; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἱεροῖς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with βωμοῖς · also neut. dat. pl., agreeing with δώμασι: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱεροῖς ἐν δώμασι)
glossary.ἱεροῖσιν: ἱερός — holy; neut. ἱερά, sacrificial offerings; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἱεροῦ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adj., agreeing with τείχεα: ’sacred (walls)’
glossary.ἱερὴ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. nom. sg., epic ἱερή (= Attic ἱερά)
glossary.ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
glossary.ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κνέφας: ’holy (darkness)’
glossary.ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
glossary.ἱεῖσαι: ἵημι — send forth, utter; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’sending forth’
glossary.ἱλάσκεσθαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἱλάσκονται: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. 3 pl., middle deponent
glossary.ἱμείρων: ἱμείρω — long for, desire (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — full of longing, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χορόν: ’full of longing’
glossary.ἱμερόεσσαν: ἱμερόεις — lovely, desirable; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱσταμένοιο: ἵσταμαι — stand; of a month, begin; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’beginning’
glossary.ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
glossary.ἲς: ἴς — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they put out’
glossary.ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
glossary.ἴδ: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἴδ’ = ἴδε = εἶδε): ’saw’
glossary.ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
glossary.ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
glossary.ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
glossary.ἴδοντο: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= augmented εἴδοντο): ’they saw’
glossary.ἴδρις: ἴδρις — knowing, skilled; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴδωσι: ὁράω — see; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., stem ἰδ- (aor. εἶδον): ’may see’
glossary.ἴθυνε: ἰθύνω — make straight, steer; impf. (or aor.) 3 sg.: ’kept on a straight course’
glossary.ἴκελοι: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); neut. acc. sg. (epic, = Attic ὅμοιος)
glossary.ἴρηξ: ἴρηξ — hawk; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἱέραξ)
glossary.ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
glossary.ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
glossary.ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἴσχεν: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, check; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, with movable ν: ’held back’
glossary.ἴφθιμον: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴφθιμόν: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, doughty; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε
glossary.ἵησι: ἵημι — send, let flow; pres. 3 sg.: ’sends forth’
glossary.ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
glossary.ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
glossary.ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο)
glossary.ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
glossary.ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἵκῃ): ’you may reach’
glossary.ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
glossary.ἵκοι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general clause after ὅτε κε: ’came upon’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a concessive condition after οὐδ’ εἰ: ’were to come upon’ (οὐδ’ εἰ … χόλος ἵκοι ’not even if wrath were to come upon him’)
glossary.ἵκοιτ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἵκοιτ’ = ἵκοιτο), in a condition: ’should reach’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect statement after a past verb: ’how he had come’ (ὡς ἔλθοι καὶ ἵκοιτ’ ἐς πατρίδα)
glossary.ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a general clause: ’(whenever) he came’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., of wish: ’may he come’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’might come’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
glossary.ἵλαον: ἵλαος — gracious, kindly, propitious; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ἵλεως)
glossary.ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
glossary.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
glossary.ἵπποις: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., object of ἕπομαι (+ dat.): ’horses’ · also masc. dat. pl., of accompaniment: ’with the horses’ (ἵπποις ἀΐσσων ’darting with the horses’) · also masc. dat. pl., after κέκλοντο: ’called to the horses’ · also dat. pl., indirect object: ’into the horses’ (ἵπποις ἧκε μένος ’put might into the horses’)
glossary.ἵππου: ἵππος — horse, mare; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἶριν: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. acc. sg. · also ἶρις — rainbow; fem. acc. sg. (πορφυρέην ἶριν ’a purple rainbow’)
glossary.ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἶσ: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (ἶσ’ = ἶσα), + dat.: ’equally with’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἀέθλια: ’equal (prizes)’
glossary.ἶσοι: ἶσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
glossary.ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’equal’ (ἶσον θυμὸν ἔχοντες ’with an equal spirit’)
glossary.ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
glossary.ὀίων: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic οἰῶν)
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρης: ὀβριμοπάτρη — she of the mighty father (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. gen. sg., epithet of Athena
glossary.ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
glossary.ὀδυσῆι: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; dat. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆι)
glossary.ὀιζύος: ὀιζύς — woe, misery, hardship; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἔμνησας ’you reminded (me) of’
glossary.ὀιζὺν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλέσσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. inf. act., epic σσ (= ὀλέσαι), in tmesis with ἀπό: ’to lose (his life)’ · also aor. inf. act., of destroying: ’to destroy’ (Τρῶας … πάντας ὀλέσσαι ’to destroy all the Trojans’) · also aor. inf. act., of losing a person: ’to lose (another)’ (ἄλλον ὀλέσσαι ’to lose another’)
glossary.ὀλίγη: ὀλίγος — little, small; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλίγην: ὀλίγος — little, small, scanty; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’short’ (οὐκ ὀλίγον χρόνον ’no short time’)
glossary.ὀλοή: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with μοῖρα: ’deadly’
glossary.ὀλοὴ: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλοὴν: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλοὸν: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὀλέθριον) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆρ: ’deadly’
glossary.ὀλυμπίου: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλυμπιάδες: Ὀλυμπιάς — Olympian, of Olympus; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀλύμπια: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀμεῖται: ὄμνυμι — swear; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will swear’
glossary.ὀμόσσας: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀμόσας): ’having sworn’
glossary.ὀμόσσῃ: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀμόσῃ), with κε in a general clause: ’swears’
glossary.ὀνύχεσσι: ὄνυξ — claw, talon; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι)
glossary.ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
glossary.ὀπάζει: ὀπάζω — make follow, bestow, grant, attach as an attendant; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀπάσσας: ὀπάζω — send along as attendant, add; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having added’
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
glossary.ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
glossary.ὀπωρινῷ: ὀπωρινός — of late summer, of the season of ripening fruit (ὀπώρη); masc. dat. sg., with ἀστέρι · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματ’: ’of late summer’
glossary.ὀπὶ: ὄψ — voice; fem. dat. sg. (ὀπὶ καλῇ ’with a beautiful voice’)
glossary.ὀρέξαι: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. inf. act.: ’to grant’ (+ acc. κῦδος ’glory’)
glossary.ὀρθαὶ: ὀρθός — upright, straight; fem. nom. pl., predicate with τρίχες
glossary.ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
glossary.ὀρνίθεσσι: ὄρνις — bird; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ὄρνισι)
glossary.ὀρνυμένοιο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; mid. rise, start up; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’rising’
glossary.ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
glossary.ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
glossary.ὀφέλλει: ὀφέλλω — increase, strengthen, add to; pres. 3 sg. (distinct from ὀφείλω ’owe’)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
glossary.ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
glossary.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
glossary.ὁδοῦ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁδός: ὁδός — way, path, journey; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁδὸς: ὁδός — road, way; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὁμήλικας: ὁμήλιξ — of the same age, a peer; masc. acc. pl.: ’age-mates’
glossary.ὁμοῖα: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. acc. pl.: ’similar to’
glossary.ὁμοῖοι: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. nom. sg., predicate (epic ὁμοῖος = Attic ὅμοιος): ’alike’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τινά, predicate of an infinitive: ’like (him)’ · also masc. acc. sg. after τόν (pronoun-form, ’that’), used as a noun: ’his equal’
glossary.ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
glossary.ὁμόθεν: ὁμόθεν — from the same place; adv.
glossary.ὁμὸν: ὁμός — same, common; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’the same’
glossary.ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
glossary.ὁπλοτάτην: ὁπλότατος — youngest; superl. fem. acc. sg., with κούρην
glossary.ὁπλότατος: ὁπλότερος — younger; superl. ὁπλότατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’youngest’
glossary.ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
glossary.ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
glossary.ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause · also + aor. subj. in a general temporal clause, with no κε: ’whenever’ (ὁπότε … στυφελίξῃ ’whenever it drives’) · also + pres. indic. in a simile: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὁπότε … κάτεισι ’as when … goes down’) · also + impf. indic. of a single past occasion: ’when’ (ὡς ὁπότε … θάπτον ’as when … were burying’)
glossary.ὁρμηθῆναι: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush forth; aor. inf. pass., in active sense: ’to rush’
glossary.ὁρᾶται: ὁράω — see, look over; pres. 3 sg. mid. with active sense (= Attic ὁρᾷ; a passive ’is seen’ is less likely): ’looks over, surveys’
glossary.ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
glossary.ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
glossary.ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
glossary.ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄζον: ὄζος — branch, twig; figuratively ’scion, offshoot’ of a family; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄιες: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄις: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς)
glossary.ὄλβιοι: ὄλβιος — blessed, prosperous; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄλβιος: ὄλβιος — blessed, fortunate, prosperous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄλβον: ὄλβος — prosperity, good fortune, happiness; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄλβος: ὄλβος — prosperity, happiness, wealth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄλβῳ: ὄλβος — prosperity, wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ’in (for) prosperity’
glossary.ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε · also masc. acc. sg., object of βούλευσαν and of φύγοι: ’destruction’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of μαντεύεαι: ’destruction’
glossary.ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄλυμπος: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄμβρον: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄμβρῳ: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄνειαρ: ὄνειαρ — help, benefit, remedy, boon; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὄνειδος: ὄνειδος — reproach, disgrace; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a name’ (ὄνομ’ εὕρεο ’find a name’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἔστω: ’a name’
glossary.ὄπ: ὄψ — voice; fem. acc. sg., elided (ὄπ’ = ὄπα)
glossary.ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
glossary.ὄπιν: ὄπις, -ιδος — regard, heed, awe (esp. of the gods’ retribution; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
glossary.ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
glossary.ὄρηται: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., without ἄν/κε after εἰ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’may arise’
glossary.ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg. · also Ὄσσα — Ossa, a mountain in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.: ’Mount Ossa’
glossary.ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
glossary.ὄσσετο: ὄσσομαι — forebode, see in the mind; impf. 3 sg. mid., a Homeric word with no Attic equivalent: ’boded, foreboded’
glossary.ὄφελλε: ὀφέλλω — owe (epic = ὀφείλω); impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤφελλε): ’owed’
glossary.ὄφιν: ὄφις — snake, serpent; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
glossary.ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
glossary.ὄχθῃσιν: ὄχθη — bank, river-bank; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
glossary.ὅγ: ὁ, ἡ, τό + γε — he, that one; masc. nom. sg. pronoun with emphatic γε, elided (ὅγ’ = ὅ γε): ’he for his part’
glossary.ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
glossary.ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’ · also ὅς τις in an indirect question, masc. acc. sg.: ’what’ (νόον ὅν τιν’ ἔχουσιν ’what mind they have’)
glossary.ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, implement; pl. arms, armour, gear; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ὅππη: ὅππῃ — where, whither; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
glossary.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’) · also ’so that’ + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν ’so that they might pass through’) · also temporal, ’when, as soon as’ + aor. indic. (ὅπως ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also ’how’ in an indirect deliberation + opt. after a past tense (ὅπως … ἐκπέμψειε ’how he might send out’)
glossary.ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + fut. indic.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … οἴσεται ’whoever will carry off’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + opt.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … πέλοιτο ’whoever should prove’)
glossary.ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
glossary.ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
glossary.ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, of measure: ’about as much as’ (ὅσον τ’ ὄργυι’ ’about a fathom’)
glossary.ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. acc. pl.: ’all that’
glossary.ὅσσαι: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; fem. nom. pl., epic ὅσσαι (= ὅσαι), agreeing with ἐσχάραι: ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
glossary.ὅστις: ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅ τι — whoever; indefinite relative pron., masc. nom. sg., with opt.: ’whoever might’
glossary.ὅτ: ὅτε — when; conj., elided (ὅτ’) · also ὡς ὅτ’, introducing a simile: ’as when’
glossary.ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also ὡς ὅτε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
glossary.ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
glossary.ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, liquid, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’liquid’
glossary.ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑληέσσης: ὑλήεις — wooded, woody; fem. gen. sg. ὑληέσσης: ’wooded’
glossary.ὑμετέρου: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc./neut. gen. sg., standing alone: ’than yours’
glossary.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’) · also + a φιν-form: ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφιν ’under the chariots’)
glossary.ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — exceeding, excessive; neut. acc. sg., used as an adverb: ’exceedingly’
glossary.ὑπέρθυμος: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, of overflowing spirit (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπέροπλον: ὑπέροπλος — arrogant, overbearing (formation not clear); adj., neut. acc. sg., used as an adverb: ’arrogantly’
glossary.ὑπέστη: ὑφίστημι — promise, undertake; 2nd aor. 3 sg. intr.: ’has promised’
glossary.ὑπαὶ: ὑπαί — under; epic lengthened form of ὑπό; prep. + acc. · also adverb, ’underneath, from below’ (ὑπαὶ δὲ ἴδεσκε ’and he would look from under (his brows), downward’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’with’ (ὑπαὶ δείους ’with fear’) · also prep. + gen. of source: ’from beneath’ (ὑπαὶ νεφέων ’from beneath the clouds’)
glossary.ὑπερίονος: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun-god; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὑπερβασίας: ὑπερβασίη — transgression, trespass; fem. acc. pl., Ionic -ίη (= Attic ὑπερβασία)
glossary.ὑπερθύμους: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, proud; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπεριονίδαο: Ὑπεριονίδης — son of Hyperion, i.e. the Sun; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὑποκυσαμένη: ὑποκύω — conceive; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having conceived’
glossary.ὑποσχόμενος: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, undertake; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having undertaken’
glossary.ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’) · also + gen., of entreaty: ’by’ (λίσσομ’ ὑπὲρ ψυχῆς ’I beseech by your life’) · also + gen. of place: ’beyond, across’ (ὑπὲρ ποταμοῖο ’across the river’)
glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent with an active verb: ’at the hands of’ (σῇς ὑπὸ χερσὶν ’at your hands’)
glossary.ὑσμίνας: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ … ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’stirred up’) · also + acc., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἵππους ’from under the horses’)
glossary.ὑφαίνειν: ὑφαίνω — weave; pres. inf. act., of a plan: ’to weave (a scheme)’
glossary.ὑψίζυγος: ὑψίζυγος — sitting on high (ὑψι- + ζυγόν, bench); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὑψηλῆς: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἴδης · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κορυφῆς: ’high (peak)’
glossary.ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὑψικόμους: ὑψίκομος — high-crowned, with lofty foliage; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl., agreeing with δρῦς
glossary.ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
glossary.ὑψόθεν: ὑψόθεν — from on high, from above; adv., -θεν suffix
glossary.ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕβριος: ὕβρις — insolence, outrage, arrogance; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὕβρις: ὕβρις — insolence, violence, outrage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὕδατι: ὕδωρ — water; neut. dat. sg., of means
glossary.ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὕμνον: ὕμνος — song, lay; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
glossary.ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
glossary.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’) · also postpositive + gen. of cause: ’because of’ (ἀνδροκτασίης ὕπο ’because of a slaying’) · also postpositive + dat. of the state one is in: ’in, under’ (ὕπνῳ ὕπο γλυκερῷ ’in sweet sleep’)
glossary.ὕστατον: ὕστατος — last; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τίνα, or neut. acc. sg. as adv.: ’last’
glossary.ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
glossary.ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα), epithet of Iris
glossary.ὠκείῃς: ὠκύς — swift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic ὠκείαις)
glossary.ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὠκεανοῦ: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., with ῥέεθρα: ’of Oceanus’
glossary.ὠκεανόν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκεανῷ: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river around the earth; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὠμῷ: ὠμός — raw, harsh, cruel; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with γήραϊ
glossary.ὠρέξατο: ὀρέγω — reach out, stretch out; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented ὠ- (ὀ- lengthened): ’reached out’
glossary.ὠτώεντα: ὠτόεις — eared, with ear-shaped handles; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic lengthened ὠτώεντα (= ὠτόεντα), agreeing with τρίποδα
glossary.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
glossary.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
glossary.ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’destroyed’
glossary.ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed, lost’
glossary.ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὤρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; aor. or impf. 3 sg. (same form): ’stirred’
glossary.ὤτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur, exhort; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they urged on’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I urged on’
glossary.ὤφελλον: ὀφέλλω (= ὀφείλω) — owe; ought; impf. 1 sg., augmented, + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that I had been’
glossary.ὥρας: ὥρα — season, proper time; fem. acc. pl.: ’(for) the seasons’
glossary.ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time of year; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ᾱ): ’the season’
glossary.ὥρην: ὥρη — season, time (of life); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ὥραν): ’for the time of marriage’
glossary.ὥρια: ὥριος — seasonal, in season; neut. acc. pl., as noun: ’crops of the season’
glossary.ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μευ, ’that’, after a verb of remembering (ὥς μευ ἀεὶ μέμνησαι ’that you always remember me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic σφιν, temporal: ’when, as when’ (ὥς σφιν πρῶτον ἀπήχθετο ’when first it became hateful to them’) · also ὥς before the enclitic περ, ’as, just as’ (τηλίκου ὥς περ ἐγών ’of an age as I am’)
glossary.ὥστε: ὥστε — like, just as; epic particle/conj. (ὡς + τε) introducing a comparison
glossary.ὦπα: ὤψ — face, countenance; acc. sg. ὦπα, after εἰς: accusative of respect, ’in face’
glossary.ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
glossary.ὦρτ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. 3 sg. mid., root aorist, elided ὦρτ’ (= ὦρτο), in tmesis ἐν … ὦρτο: ’arose among’
glossary.ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
glossary.ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
glossary.ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’ · also accented ὧδέ before the enclitic κε (ὧδέ κε ’thus … would’)
glossary.ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.; personified Ὧραι, the Hours, keepers of the gates of heaven
glossary.ᾖσιν: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ᾖ): ’may be’
glossary.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
glossary.ᾗς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὑπεροπλίῃσι · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗς (= ᾗσι, Attic αἷς): ’in which’ (ᾗς ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’) · also relative, fem. dat. pl., referring to φρένες, of cause: ’for which’
glossary.ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
glossary.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. sg., with πέρι: ’around which’
glossary.ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
glossary.ῥέα: ῥέα — easily; adv., epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως, ῥεῖα)
glossary.ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ῥέει: ῥέω — flow; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥεῖ)
glossary.ῥέζουσιν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; pres. 3 pl., + two accusatives: ’are doing (evils to you)’
glossary.ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’doing’
glossary.ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf. act.: ’to offer’ · also ’do, act’; aor. inf. act. (ὧδε δὲ ῥέξαι ’to do thus’)
glossary.ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’
glossary.ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — worse, more grievous; comparative adj. (cf. ῥῖγος ’shudder’), neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ῥίζῃσι: ῥίζα — root; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ῥίζαις)
glossary.ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
glossary.ῥαθάμιγγες: ῥάθαμιγξ — drop, splash; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.ῥηιδίως: ῥᾳδίως — easily; adv., epic ῥηιδίως (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.ῥηξήνορα: ῥηξήνωρ — man-breaking, breaker of men; adj., masc. acc. sg., epithet of Achilles
glossary.ῥινοῦ: ῥινός — hide, skin, leather; fem. gen. sg., of material: ’of hide’
glossary.ῥινῷ: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. sg., a layer of hide
glossary.ῥιπῇ: ῥιπή — rush, onset, force; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by the onset’
glossary.ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
glossary.ῥῖψε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρριψε)
